h7XYuJo63T.title: From Orphan to Regent's Little Princess
h7XYuJo63T.desc: After being framed, her mother gave birth to her and then took her own life, leaving Zhaozhao an orphan. The regent claims her as his daughter, the emperor dotes on her, the empress dowager rejoices, and princes call her sister. She becomes the cherished princess and the empire's lucky star.
h7XYuJo63T.title_id: Dari Yatim Piatu Menjadi Putri Kecil Bupati
h7XYuJo63T.desc_id: Dari Yatim Piatu Menjadi Putri Kecil Bupati. Drama pendek dubbing Indonesia.

rwcCi67MwS.title: A Mother Won't Hold Back
rwcCi67MwS.desc: CEO Wei Shishi, estranged from her daughter Xiaoran due to overwork, secretly works as a cleaner at her kindergarten to rebuild trust. During a parent-child tennis match, she outplays a snobbish mother, overcomes challenges with her husband's guidance, and earns the respect of the parents.
rwcCi67MwS.title_id: Seorang Ibu Tidak Akan Menahan Diri
rwcCi67MwS.desc_id: Seorang Ibu Tidak Akan Menahan Diri. Drama pendek dubbing Indonesia.

Ya8p5nJE5e.title: Lucifer My Boyfriend from Hell
Ya8p5nJE5e.desc: Fragments of Lucifer's soul fall into the unfortunate girl Lilith. To retrieve his soul, Lucifer stays by her side at all times. However, this ordinary girl holds an irresistible attraction for the Lord of Hell.
Ya8p5nJE5e.desc_id: Lucifer Pacarku dari Neraka. Drama pendek dubbing Indonesia.

Q6v1LCeeqc.title: Riding the Waves of the 1980s
Q6v1LCeeqc.desc: n the 80s, Yu & Lu thrived in aquaculture. They used ducks to stop locusts but were poisoned. Choosing forgiveness, they shared knowledge and inspired redemption.

XHwpplhsu2.title: Boss Lady Goes Undercover
XHwpplhsu2.desc: Nan Yiyi, CEO of Dihao Group, goes undercover at Phase Six but is harassed and beaten. On her way home, Nan Hu and Nan Long humiliate her. After the patriarch confirms her identity, she punishes the offenders and finds her father faked illness to arrange a match—her family reunites happily.

nZ8X63ZAFP.title: She Mistook Him for Love
nZ8X63ZAFP.desc: Ruan Zhixia believes in her perfect marriage until her husband Gu Yanfeng fakes amnesia, humiliating and abusing her to force a divorce for his mistress Lu Wei. Heartbroken, she jumps into a river. When he discovers the truth and regrets it, he finds she survived and found new love.

DlZut9JYg3.title: Lies in Love, Truth in Hate
DlZut9JYg3.desc: On her wedding day, Sarah is betrayed by her fiancé, and her best friend Emily causes her mother's death. Childhood friend David proposes, but she discovers the marriage is a trap to save Emily. She embarks on a quest for truth and justice.

fLGCHJFVGx.title: The Mafia Hunter
fLGCHJFVGx.desc: John Smith prepares for a public swearing-in. Fiancée Emily cheats with Russo's Mark Wilson. John infiltrates Wilson's group, complicating his actions. Wilson bribes officials, exploits legal gaps, while John covertly disrupts his activities.

yDTtoDPZ1I.title: Mr. Fu, Your Wife's Secret Identity is Out Again
yDTtoDPZ1I.desc: To escape her father's forced marriage, Lin Nuo, the eldest daughter of the Lin family, goes to the park's matchmaking corner alone to search for a suitable match. Unexpectedly, she enters a contract marriage with Fu Ting'an, who was also forced to come on a blind date. After getting married in haste, they each go their separate ways. On her first day at work, Lin Nuo encounters her half-sister Lin Ran, who pretends to be Lin Nuo and takes over the presidency of the company, using the Lin family's name to bully others. Meanwhile, Lin Nuo mistakes her newlywed husband Fu Ting'an for a waiter at a banquet. Fu Ting'an, decides to keep his identity a secret and protect Lin Nuo in secret, accepts the misunderstanding. Through various unexpected encounters and misunderstandings, their feelings grow deeper and deeper. Eventually, Lin Ran's and Fu Haoran's false identities are gradually revealed. With Fu Ting'an's protection, Lin Nuo defeats Lin Zhentian and his daughter, successfully reclaiming the Lin Group.

PSB7nACDXc.title: Five Love Lines of Fate
PSB7nACDXc.desc: Li Fan, a security guard with a very low salary, goes on a blind date but is humiliated by the arrogant woman Yang Lijuan for his poor background. As she pours water on him and leaves, Li Fan reflects on why he's been single for thirty years and why his love life has been so difficult. Just then, the God of Marriage, Yue Lao, appears and reveals that in his past life, Li Fan was the Boy of Good Karma serving as Yue Lao's assistant. However, due to his playful nature, he cut the marriage lines of five women and was punished by being sent to the mortal world to face trials. To earn true love in this life, Li Fan must find these five women, make them fall in love with him, and help them reconnect their marriage lines.

20EM4hMoMk.title: Reunited to Say I Love You
20EM4hMoMk.desc: To fund Elijah Clark's heart surgery, Isabella Martin is forced to leave him, sparking his hatred, while his mother takes their son. Six years later, a school fight involving Isabella's daughter reunites them, igniting a turbulent, heart-wrenching love marked by passion and resentment.

UxblVGOlCZ.title: Destined for My Secret CEO
UxblVGOlCZ.desc: To escape an arranged marriage with Zhang Ziqiang, Shen Nian accidentally marries Gu Shuo, the CEO of Longchuan Group. Disliking wealthy people, she has no idea that Gu Shuo is a billionaire, so he keeps his true identity hidden. Meanwhile, Zhang Ziqiang creates trouble for them, but Gu Shuo secretly protects her. As time passes, Shen Nian falls deeper in love with him.

KzJ2v3xHzH.title: The Sibling Shuffle
KzJ2v3xHzH.desc: This is a heartwarming family comedy about the daily life of the Jiang family, an ordinary middle-class urban household, filled with trivialities, playful banter, and touching moments. The mother, Gao Ya, is a frugal, strong-willed, and caring housewife. The father, Jiang Yi, makes a living by writing at home, occasionally being tasked by his wife to do household chores he's not particularly skilled at. The older sister, Jiang Duoyu, and younger brother, Jiang Yikun, are a pair of mischievous siblings, one year apart, constantly engaging in playful rivalry. Both siblings struggle with their studies, often worrying their parents. As the college entrance exam approaches, Jiang Yikun spends his days taking online lessons at home, but his results remain unsatisfactory. The family is doing everything they can to help him succeed.

CzYFzonyvA.title: I Once Loved You
CzYFzonyvA.desc: DR Holdings heiress Gu Nuann loses her memory in a crash. Lu Tingchen keeps her as a stand-in for his first love Qin Luo. When the real Qin returns, pregnant Gu Nuann is cast out. Qin tries to kill her, triggering her memories. Gu reunites with fiancé Ling Muyoung for revenge.

fwv9tdDXQA.title: The Bus Was Hell Itself
fwv9tdDXQA.desc: Fleeing her family, heiress Jiang Leyan boards a bus to escape a stalker who accuses her of being a gold-digger. Passengers turn hostile until a mysterious man in black helps her. The driver obeys him, giving her hope—until she realizes the bus is heading straight into danger.

rTesI570yP.title: Marriage Countdown
rTesI570yP.desc: Housewife Shen Zhilan leads a tranquil life but is secretly a star of Daxia Research Institute. When she goes out to honor her ancestors, her in-laws expose her alleged infidelity to her husband. The family gradually uncovers the astonishing truth about her extraordinary background.

Wc7eOdTAOE.title: When the CEO Remembers Everything
Wc7eOdTAOE.desc: Amnesiac Huo Shaoting mistrusts Ji Chenxi who seeks him to save her sick daughter. At the hospital, he bonds with her daughter. During her surgery, he regains his memory, discovers his adoptive father's crime, takes revenge, reconciles with Ji Chenxi, and the family reunites happily.

CzsWhRFeuO.title: I Seduced the Cold Heir
CzsWhRFeuO.desc: Bullied by her stepmother and sister Xia An'an, the illegitimate daughter Xia Jin seduces Si Yan, the man Xia An'an loves, to take revenge. Despite his cold nature, the heir Si Yan is captivated by her, trapping them in an entanglement of desire and hate.

lLkVskFVv6.title: Three Babies' Love Plot, Charming Dad to Spoil Mom
lLkVskFVv6.desc: Six years later, An Yitian returns to her homeland with three adorable kids. On the night of their one-night stand, the man left her a Dynasty diamond ring. As the three kids wore the ring in search of their dad, it was accidentally lost.

N9PDnNjhbx.title: A Sister’s Sacrifice, Silent Struggles
N9PDnNjhbx.desc: 30-year-old Wen Zhixia, the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, gave up her position as heir after her mother’s early death and her younger sister Wen Ruan’s emotional trauma. Choosing a simpler life, she moved to the city with Wen Ruan to live as ordinary people. Years later, Wen Ruan marries An Jiahe, unaware that her sister has been silently enduring long-term domestic abuse in her marriage...

OoBfPol4in.title: The Deadly Bus
OoBfPol4in.desc: College student Fang Xiaorou and her boyfriend Fu Ze board a strange bus she recognizes as the one that went missing a year ago. She begs Fu Ze to get off, but he dismisses the eerie occurrences, insisting they're normal. As the bus travels deeper, they uncover increasingly dark secrets.

SowKlUMgVi.title: Villains Always Leave Crying
SowKlUMgVi.desc: Jiang Li is killed by her half-sister, Song Jiayi, and is reborn. She sleeps with Song Jiayi's fiancé, An Cangzhu, and gains his support. Using her past life's memories, she makes Song Jiayi lose her inheritance. When Cangzhu is injured saving her, she takes over his company and meets Nangong Lin.

7AcJmYOOnk.title: Apartment of Love and Healing
7AcJmYOOnk.desc: Food streamer Meng Na, betrayed by boyfriend Fang Yu and best friend Pei Yuan, is taken in by apartment owner Ouyang Pengpeng. With help from tenants, she rebuilds her career and they fall in love while saving the apartment.

BF4yEalAdR.title: Lawyer by Day, Dad by Night
BF4yEalAdR.desc: Their first encounter was a battle over custody of a child?

HLRW6KxJwa.title: When I Hear My Mom's Thoughts
HLRW6KxJwa.desc: Yan Xi can hear her mute mother's thoughts—yet keeps getting sabotaged through them. Reborn, she dodges every trap and exposes fake heiress Yan Ruolan and doctor Shen Han, who used a hypnotic bracelet to control Mom and steal the fortune. Truth prevails. The villains face justice.

AG7fr0wDEt.title: Against Fate: The Driver's Rise
AG7fr0wDEt.desc: After being laid off, Wang Defa resorts to driving a ride-hail car to make ends meet, while his daughter's leukemia weighs heavily on him. One night, he picks up a couple who begin intimate acts in the car, only to realize the female passenger is his long-missing wife, Li Wan. She mocks him, claiming her actions are for their daughter, while the rich heir Chen Tianyu humiliates Wang and even assaults him. Later, Wang saves an elderly man from a car accident, who turns out to be the billionaire chairman of Gu Group. The chairman's deputy, Chen Zeming, schemes to have his son Chen Tianyu pose as the rescuer and marry the chairman's granddaughter, Gu Yating. When Chen Tianyu tries to forcibly take a drunk Gu Yating, Wang intervenes. Just as Chen's thugs attack Wang, a fleet of ride-hail drivers arrives in a show of solidarity.

6VmBNXipNJ.title: His On-Call Heiress
6VmBNXipNJ.desc: Grace Lewis, Royalton's top socialite, is abandoned on her wedding night. Drunk and heartbroken, she mistakes elite heir Ethan Robinson for a male escort. After their night together, he blackmails her with videos, making her his on-call sidekick while asking her daily, "Divorced yet?"

DgPFiLPacd.title: The Imperial Warrior's Return
DgPFiLPacd.desc: The heroine's daughter is gravely ill, and her last wish is to see her father. Following a long-ago signal, the heroine contacts him. After years of battle, he has become the Supreme War God. For his wife and daughter, he lays down his armor and returns home to protect them.

0Bad4XGgah.title: The Perfect Betrayal
0Bad4XGgah.desc: A devoted husband—secretly responsible for their daughter's murder. A live-in nanny—his hidden lover. Trapped in a web of lies, a grieving mother uncovers the truth and fights back.

KRsue9cShZ.title: Deadly Kiss for My Stepfather
KRsue9cShZ.desc: At her mother's funeral, young actress Violet is "comforted" by her stepfather Maxwell—the perpetrator of her most traumatic night. She tries to escape, but Maxwell controls her career and has infiltrated her mother's life, becoming her would-be stepfather with dark intentions.

mDjc9V5ggs.title: Top Student, Second Chance
mDjc9V5ggs.desc: Top scorer Zhuang Yuan was betrayed by her mother and classmate Jia Qingqing in the 1990s—her enrollment stolen, sold to a butcher, dying in despair. Reborn to results day, she rejects her past admirer, tutors for tuition, outsmarts her family and Jia Qingqing, and reclaims her future.

qDTHqHeXN7.title: Kind Wife Rewarded
qDTHqHeXN7.desc: Wealthy Huo Yong pretends to be poor and sick to test his mute wife Shen Qingwei, but really has terminal tuberculosis. She sells her house to save her husband, gets humiliated, befriends Dr. Wang. Huo Yong dies abandoned by his brother Huo Li. Shen Qingwei inherits, starts new life with Dr. Wang.

y9utuTYglq.title: The Fake Heir
y9utuTYglq.desc: A migrant worker, Lu You, accidentally gets entangled in a wealthy family's scheme due to his resemblance to their president, Lu Hao. Pretending to be Lu Hao, he falls in love with Chen Zhijin, the daughter of another powerful family. Together, they uncover and defeat the mastermind, Ubadah, safeguarding China's peace and revealing Lu You's true identity.

T3YHNjboLu.title: It's Been A While
T3YHNjboLu.desc: Childhood sweethearts Ye Qian & Gu Jingchen reunite after 15 years. Gu obsesses over savior Yuan Bao, unaware she's his wife Ye. Misunderstandings lead to divorce plans. Heartbroken Ye agrees. Truth reveals Yuan Bao=Ye, resolving conflicts as love reignites.

TANN3OeCyv.title: Echoes in the Breeze
TANN3OeCyv.desc: Jiang Yan marries billionaire Shang Chengzhou in a family alliance, but he believes she once tried to kill him and sees their marriage as nothing but a deal. One reckless night leaves Jiang Yan pregnant. Just as his first love returns and the past resurfaces, the two are on the brink of separation.

oUgpC8GXOr.title: Devoted, Yet Betrayed
oUgpC8GXOr.desc: Xie Xubai marries Meng Wan with a huge dowry and helps her run Dongsheng Group. When her assistant Jiang Che, resembling her late first love, manipulates her, she sides with him over Xie Xubai. After their divorce, she discovers Xie Xubai's devotion and Jiang Che's schemes, but it's too late.

VFEBqTl0p0.title: Falling for the Enemy's Daughter
VFEBqTl0p0.desc: Si Qi's family destroyed by father's subordinate Zhong Ming, who used him as test subject causing heart condition. Herbalist Xia Yao saves him with Heartworm but it has limited duration. Si Qi discovers enemy's daughter Zhong Qing might be key to his cure and approaches her.

aHAONU2uKK.title: Only You Can Feel Me
aHAONU2uKK.desc: Abandoned at birth, Yan Nuannuan was raised by a scavenger grandmother. Fleeing the loan shark Hu Ge, she kissed passerby Jiang Sinian to hide. Jiang Sinian, who faints when touched, discovered he could touch her. Brother Hu stabbed her. She awoke as a ghost whom only Jiang Sinian could see.

idUir4UTAE.title: Mummy Loves You
idUir4UTAE.desc:
The young Yang Wenjing and wealthy young master Hua Yunhai fell in love, but when Yang Wenjing became pregnant, Hua Yunhai was forced by his family to return home and marry the daughter of a noble family, Song Meihong. On the day Yang Wenjing gave birth, it coincided with their wedding. After giving birth to a daughter, Yang Wenjing gave her a bracelet as a mement.

Years later, Yang Wenjing raised her daughter until she was 4 years old, but the Hua family, unable to have children with Song Meihong, forcibly took the child. Despite her poor health, Yang Wenjing rushed out of the hospital to chase after her daughter but was kidnapped by Hua family members and sold to human traffickers. Along the way, she was rescued by Liu Shaoqiang, who took her in due to her beauty. However, she ended up living a tragic life under his roof.

A2EuHPVGNi.title: Queen of Vengeance
A2EuHPVGNi.desc: A decade after losing everything to the ruthless tycoon Bruce Levy, Dina returns under a new identity as the chief legal counsel of Levy Group. Driven by revenge, she meticulously plots his downfall. But Bruce isn't easily fooled—he suspects her true motives. As their power struggle intensifies, secrets of betrayal and heartbreak resurface. Caught between vengeance and family, love and hate, they're on a collision course with no way back.

DwWshBbHRp.title: The Matriarch's Justice
DwWshBbHRp.desc: Visiting her son Huo Chengyu and daughter-in-law Lin Wan's new home, Huo Qinglan is mistaken for Lin Wan and insulted by her son's mistress, Shen Weiwei. Learning her son keeps a mistress who bullies his wife, she sends Lin Wan away to relax and personally teaches the arrogant pair a lesson.

ZKm2mGb2Sb.title: Obsessed with Her
ZKm2mGb2Sb.desc: Two years ago, Amy broke off her engagement with the prestigious Wilson family for a man trying to rise socially. After losing her parents and inheritance, she was left with nothing. Unbeknownst to her, Andrew has quietly waited for years, loving her deeply and hoping she'll return.

bpDBvqIuPk.title: Uncles Assemble, Princess Arises
bpDBvqIuPk.desc: Three-year-old fortune-teller Yaya, abused by her uncle and aunt, meets racer Shen Chengye and predicts his accident. He suspects she's his lost niece. Embraced by four powerful uncles, she becomes the Shen family princess. But as the true mastermind emerges, a revenge battle begins.

V2uYVJumXY.title: She Played Along to Win
V2uYVJumXY.desc: Lin YuZhi, oppressed by her husband Jiang JingYu, suffers mental decline from long-term sleeping pills and is driven toward suicide by Jiang JingYu and his mistress. After being rescued, Lin YuZhi's life is reversed.

HEIeBzdJaa.title: Revenge of the Broken Heart
HEIeBzdJaa.desc: Shen Sui, once obsessed with marrying Fu Lingchuan, chose him over being the daughter of the wealthiest family, even hurting her closest relatives in the process. Taking on the alias Shen Yun, she moved to Jiang City. However, three years of marriage brought her no happiness. On their third wedding anniversary, she received a divorce notice. Her husband's cold indifference, her mother-in-law's cruelty, and the mistress's boldness left Shen Sui heartbroken. Seeking revenge for the child she lost, Shen Sui returned to the Shen family, reclaiming her position as the eldest daughter and became a widely recognized figure. To uncover the truth behind the car accident that changed her life, Shen Sui attended a birthday banquet hosted by her ex-husband Fu Lingchuan for his mother.

rJm9H2NM8q.title: From Poor Girl to Top Tycoon
rJm9H2NM8q.desc: To secure 500 dollars for her daughter Jiang Yaniu's college exam fee, Jiang Yongzhong and his wife are humiliated by the local bully. In an attempt to save her parents, Jiang Yaniu makes a bet with the bully: if she doesn't become the world's top student in the college entrance exams, she will willingly marry him. After enduring countless challenges, Jiang Yaniu finally achieves her dream and rises to become the world's wealthiest person.

j2q7Q0C0m1.title: Trapped in Love
j2q7Q0C0m1.desc: Xiao Yao, a girl preparing for marriage, is betrayed by her boyfriend and sold to a violent local gang led by Ta Shan. To escape, she seduces the gang's leader, Lu Wei ,known as Little Master Buddha, but unexpectedly falls in love with him during their time together. As she hesitates, she discovers she’s trapped in an even darker conspiracy…

djKnT64srA.title: Sisterhood Against Scoundrels
djKnT64srA.desc: Lauren Parker, a fierce general's daughter, and Emily Wilson, a noble lady, both died tragically fighting over the deceitful Daniel Cooper. Reborn, they see his true colors and join forces to seek revenge—one commands the army, the other guards the family fortune, together plotting a comeback.

zLTUqJVjIi.title: Goodbye, My Brothers
zLTUqJVjIi.desc: Orphan Nangong Xing was adopted by the Nangong family and once loved by three brothers. After their real daughter returned, Xing was mistreated. She joined the "Star Sleep Project," choosing 30 years of sleep and donating her corneas to her second brother. She awoke decades later, with no memory.

lTydJpnPn8.title: Love Entwined in a Substitute Bride's Heart
lTydJpnPn8.desc: To save her mother's life, Shen Xining agrees to marry Su Ci, the president of the Su's Corporation, in place of her irresponsible sister Shen Muxue, who caused Su Ling, Su Ci's sister, to fall into a coma. Before their marriage, Shen Xining and Su Ci had already experienced an intimate moment. Initially, Su Ci despised Shen Xining, planning to keep her secrets concealed until she fulfills her plan. Yet, as days go by, Su Ci unexpectedly falls in love with Shen Xining, who turns out to be vastly different from the rumors. When Shen Xining finally unveils the truths shrouded under the name 'Shen Muxue,' the two finally unite in love.

WgpIrC8mhs.title: Flash Marriage in the 80s
WgpIrC8mhs.desc: Zhou Yuchen and Zhang Xiuying got married and left home to start their own business right after their wedding night, neither of them having seen each other's faces clearly. Later, Zhang Xiuying gives birth to a daughter. Five years later, they meet again at a factory, but neither recognizes the other. Zhou Yuchen mistakenly identifies his wife, leading to numerous misunderstandings. Zhang Xiuying is bullied at the factory, but Zhou Yuchen repeatedly comes to her rescue. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and the family is reunited.

ks2Q021fe9.title: Golden-Eyed Archer: Legacy Reclaimed
ks2Q021fe9.desc: Emily, a girl plagued by cold poison, inherits the Arrow Emblem from her ancestors and awakens golden eyes with extraordinary archery skills. She exposes her fake grandmother Victoria's treason, saves her real grandmother, wins the international championship, and restores Daxon's glory.

dw2wm0Is32.title: The Serpent God's Bride
dw2wm0Is32.desc: Lin Nian saves a black serpent as a child and jokingly promises marriage. Fifteen years later, her CEO boss Gu Zeming is that snake in gorgeous human form. He spoils and protects her secretly. When crisis strikes, he reveals his serpent-god power and they marry.

dHu5L98ICs.title: Fragrance of Revenge
dHu5L98ICs.desc: During the investigation of his parents' deaths,  Edward got a divorce from his wife, who didn't realize her whole career was relied upon Edward. Diana, Edward's first love, entered into his life at this critical period. Will Edward be ready to step into a new romantic relationship, or only to find out a rather appalling secret?

MFEGBgmyla.title: Love Unveils Past Ties
MFEGBgmyla.desc: Five years ago, Mu Yu was set up and accidentally slept with An Xiaorong. After a car accident, An Xiaorong selectively loses her memory. Mu Yu is then arranged to marry into the Chu family, but Chu Qingrou learns about the Mu family's curse that brings misfortune to their wives and considers calling off the marriage. By coincidence, she meets someone who looks just like her, An Xiaorong. The Chu family offers to treat An Xiaorong's illness on the condition that she substitutes for Chu Qingrou. During their time together, An Xiaorong's cheerful personality attracts Mu Yu, and it is through Xia Lan's provocations that Mu Yu begins to understand his true feelings. Three months later, An Xiaorong is still alive, and Chu Qingrou pretends to be the woman Mu Yu slept with five years ago, threatening An Xiaorong to leave. In the end, Mu Yu realizes that An Xiaorong is the person from five years ago, and they finally open up to each other.

0TSQMsPgdf.title: Two Extras Rewrite the Ending
0TSQMsPgdf.desc: Dr. Molly, a modern-day physician, wakes up as a doomed side character in a novel. Teaming up with fellow transmigrator, Marquis Ryan Murphy, she turns the tables in a deadly house struggle, fights back against the original leads, and finally wins peace and happiness.

4FSIYCtrfs.title: A Billionaire's Rewind in 2000
4FSIYCtrfs.desc: Zhang Ye, a billionaire tycoon, was once a gambling addict whose actions led to his mother's death and his wife leaving him. On the day his company goes public, he's sent back to 2000. Using his past life memories, he's determined to change his fate, rebuild his family, and succeed.

wMV46Zagx5.title: The CEO's Parallel Journey
wMV46Zagx5.desc: CEO Ling Xiao is transported to a parallel world, where he's seen as a failure, manipulated by his family, and disappointing his fiancée, Shangguan Yun. Determined to turn things around, he uses his knowledge from another world to outsmart his relatives and revive his career. Along the way, he uncovers shocking truths about his mother's royal heritage. However, when his brother kidnaps Shangguan Yun, Ling Xiao discovers that only he, Shangguan Yun, and his brother are from different worlds. After sacrificing himself to return to the past and save her, he's shocked to find himself living as a dependent husband...

SHCiKPRiJ9.title: Deceptive Kiss
SHCiKPRiJ9.desc: To save her dying grandmother, Lily deceives Noah—manipulating his heart with calculated schemes. As threats close in, buried secrets and bitter grudges surface. When lies unravel and blood stains her gown, will they drag each other into darkness—or become each other’s light?

7oaUJoDLN3.title: Ashes Burn, She Rises
7oaUJoDLN3.desc: For six years, Sophia's daughter was forbidden from calling Noah Wright "Daddy," while his first love's son was groomed as heir. After being reborn, she divorces immediately, rebuilds her career to its former glory, and starts a happy life with her daughter—leaving her ex drowning in regret.

cc0HTPjJgE.title: From Pawn to King
cc0HTPjJgE.desc: Chen Hu was killed in his past life by his father Chen Shan and half-brother Chen Xiaolong. Reborn before drowning, he seeks revenge, exposing their land's ancient tomb, bankrupting the Chen family, implicating the Ouyang family, and ultimately defeating the Ouyang family by revealing their crimes.

aa0zhlBlGq.title: Soulbound Partners
aa0zhlBlGq.desc: Lin Cancan struggles at the bottom of the entertainment industry and unexpectedly links souls with Li Yi. He helps her escape abuse and get opportunities. They uncover that her father stole her mother's work, and together she achieves her acting dreams and finds true love.

iI8NSdkZRM.title: Escaped My Groom, Married Him Anyway
iI8NSdkZRM.desc: Mia, heiress of Jianyou Group, plans to find a male escort for a fake marriage to avoid wedding the rumored bald CEO Dylan of Fengshang Group. Dylan's assistant also finds him a bride. By mistake, she meets Dylan at a club. Both misidentify each other and accidentally get married for real.

aKGCmxAvPJ.title: One Last Love
aKGCmxAvPJ.desc: Facing a terminal diagnosis, Lin Changwan decides to live for herself. She exposes workplace corruption, cuts ties with her biased parents, dumps her cheating fiancé, and in her final days, accepts Jiang Yuzhou as her last boyfriend.

6Wkv3aOBvx.title: Reward Him For A Marriage
6Wkv3aOBvx.desc: An Ran reborn on wedding day vows revenge on ex & reclaim An Group。Meets Jiang Jingyuan, CEO of Jiang Corp, sparks unexpected romance。Past life: deceived by fiancé Qin Zhe/stepsister, oppressed by stepmom, lost all pregnant。Revenge begins!

LffdwlPmrA.title: Why Is Secretary Qiao Like That
LffdwlPmrA.desc: Secretary Qiao decides to end her private affair with her boss, Mo Xicheng, encountering numerous challenges both inside and outside the company. From being maliciously locked in a restroom by Sun Meng to being sought after by Mo Xicheng and Yin Zeyi, Qiao faces dual dilemmas of career and emotions. The prospect of being headhunted by Yin Zeyi offers new hope, while the news of Mo Xicheng's fiancée, Ni Yun, returning from abroad strengthens Qiao's resolve to leave.

51U1nkVpFt.title: A Love to Embrace
51U1nkVpFt.desc: To repay a debt of gratitude, Xiao Wanwan wants to marry Fu Yanxing but is rejected. After a night of passion arranged by Fu's grandfather, they end up in a whirlwind marriage. Fu Yanxing mistakenly believes she's after his wealth, but when Xiao Wanwan becomes pregnant and faces betrayal, Fu Yanxing comes to her rescue. With her mother trying to sell her off, Fu Yanxing steps in to protect her. As Xiao Wanwan struggles to balance her studies and encounters a gold digger, Fu Yanxing repeatedly comes to her aid. In the end, they both realize their true feelings and embrace love.

ulDflya1AZ.title: The Scapegoat's Final Escape
ulDflya1AZ.desc: Xia Jingyao is betrayed by her sister Xia Chuchu and exiled to the countryside for three years, enduring abuse and being forced to give up a kidney. When her family finally calls her back to donate to her sister who has uremia, they don't know she has none left and is planning to leave.

359jEqc6nT.title: The South Wind Passes, We Are All Guests
359jEqc6nT.desc: Sophia married Edward into hell: jailed, lost leg, died in fire. His satisfaction turned to void. Months later, "Anna" resembling her appears at gala, smilingly controls him for revenge...

gKMv4HROn2.title: From Ashes to His Love
gKMv4HROn2.desc: At a night party, Gu Ci, the eldest daughter of the Gu family, catches her husband Qin Shiyan cheating with her stepsister Gu Li. Heartbroken, she files for divorce. While drunk, she accidentally gets intimate with Qin Mu, Qin Shiyan's half-brother who has secretly loved her for seven years, and is coaxed into marrying him the next day. She later discovers Qin Mu is the newly appointed CEO of the Qin conglomerate. When Qin Shiyan tries to reconcile, Gu Ci realizes her new marriage isn't transactional, it's the fulfillment of Qin Mu's lifelong devotion.

Dfgm2KSet0.title: Star Moon Romance: Rejected And Reborn As Alpha
Dfgm2KSet0.desc: Wolfless Phoebe was wrongly accused of murdering her parents and was ostracized by the whole pack. Even her lover Asta rejected her as his mate. Crushed, Phoebe left her pack and became a rogue. However, in her despair, she awakened the formidable Moonshadow Wolf. Two years later, Phoebe emerged as a renowned female Alpha, just when a distress call from her former lover Asta reached her. As she stared back at her past in the face, the truth about her parents' tragic death began to surface.

WwnJ04mhJz.title: Dragon Lord's Resurgence
WwnJ04mhJz.desc: Li Xiaoyao, the carefree and laid-back heir to the Dragon King, has no interest in power—he just wants to be the best bathhouse scrubber around. Despite mastering ancient illusion magic and being the prophesied savior of Jiuzhou, he rejects the throne without hesitation. Things take a turn when his fiancée from the prestigious Nangong family calls off their engagement, only for his grandfather to arrange another marriage with the prideful and fiery Wei Lan. Though humiliated by the Wei family, Li Xiaoyao falls for Wei Lan at first sight. Unbothered by their insults, he knows they’ll meet again—at his coronation. And he's made up his mind: he's going to win over the hottest girl in Jiuzhou!

tFDm7tHgrx.title: Mad Bride's Revenge
tFDm7tHgrx.desc: Lucas Clark, heiress of the Young family, is imprisoned in an asylum by her greedy father and stepfamily who are seeking her fortune. After three years, she crashes her impostor sister's wedding to Grayson Walker, making a marriage deal. Their contract evolves into genuine affection.

fqDtj9JTa7.title: Living With My Boss
fqDtj9JTa7.desc: To save her grandma, Su Ying asks Fu Chengyan for help and stays at his place—discovering he's her boss. When she becomes pregnant, he marries her immediately. She rescues allies, impresses with wild herbs, cultivates rare mushrooms, and exposes schemes. They find lasting happiness together.

TuSTiYkfiR.title: Every Marriage Makes Him Stronger
TuSTiYkfiR.desc: Lin Feng transmigrates as a 75-year-old soldier. His daughter-in-law sends him a young wife—awakening a system: marriage grants youth and power. He disciplines his rebellious family, dominates both the military and literary worlds, and rises from a lowly soldier to founding emperor amid chaos.

Xceg18OpjN.title: Picked up My Amnesiac Husband
Xceg18OpjN.desc: Su Qiuzhi saves the amnesiac Lu Zhengning and falls for him. Amidst dealing with Niu Aihua's false accusations and Song Jiaojiao's schemes, Lu Zhengning regains his memory, reveals his true identity, and chooses Su Qiuzhi. They marry, and she gets pregnant, living happily ever after.

RUzCXKbTuN.title: Ten Thousand Times, Same Day
RUzCXKbTuN.desc: Chu Chen is trapped in the same day for ten thousand years, mastering every skill and spending countless nights with women. One night, he saves Zhang Qingwan but offends a powerful figure. Expecting the usual reset at midnight, he's shocked when the cycle finally ends!

L9liiTjJ42.title: The Stock Prodigy of the 90s
L9liiTjJ42.desc: After being killed by his stepmother, Lin Cong is reborn at the age of eight. With all his memories intact, Lin Cong decides to fight back. He first devises a plan that causes his stepmother's attempt to interfere with his family's affairs to fail. Then, using his keen sense of the financial market, he makes a name for himself in the stock market, bringing wealth to his family while staying low-key. However, his success is eventually discovered by his malicious, impoverished relatives, and a conspiracy targeting the Lin family quietly begins to unfold.

8pmfjzgN3r.title: Don't Mess with the CEO's Darling
8pmfjzgN3r.desc: Shen Xingruo marries Song Hanyu with the help of his grandmother. On their wedding day, Shen defends her best friend, while Song's grandmother gifts them gold bars and property. Song tests Shen by pretending to be poor. At a class reunion, Shen is framed, but Song steps in to clear her name. When Xia Qianxue returns from abroad, Shen misjudges Song, but in the end, the truth is revealed, and they reconcile.

O9nF04vF2s.title: For Her Stepdaughter, She Walked Away
O9nF04vF2s.desc: Fulfilling her dying best friend's last wish, she marries into the wealthy Shen family to become the stepmother of newborn Shen Nuo. However, the Shen family values sons over daughters, and her husband, Shen Tianhao, has an affair that results in a son. To protect Shen Nuo from being mistreated in the household, she decides to leave the Shen family with her stepdaughter, giving up everything to start anew.

eiXVe1n7UK.title: Usurping Empress: Fallen Crown
eiXVe1n7UK.desc: Merchant girl Emma Smith, mistaken for the empress, wreaks havoc in the palace, disrupts the court, and usurps the throne. Defeated and captured, her actions invite invasion. Noah Scott wakes up, restores order, and executes her and her allies Lily and Sophia.

bq96XUJU0H.title: Crown Prince Rivalry
bq96XUJU0H.desc: In a past life, Emperor Xiao Yanqing's son with Empress Xie Huirou was lost. To spare her grief, he adopted an abandoned child and raised him as his own. Fifteen years later, the true prince, Xiao Fan, returns, but the Emperor and Empress favor the adopted son, Xiao Jingyao, neglecting Xiao Fan.

cbiq1bfiZv.title: Rising After the Breakup
cbiq1bfiZv.desc: Michael Brown, once abandoned and working as a butcher, rises to fame and wealth in Tiger Province through relentless effort. As his ex-wife's Parker family falls into business ruin, they blame Michael, convinced he's taking revenge with hidden, underhanded tactics.

tTxjSMMS05.title: The Wedding Escape Plan
tTxjSMMS05.desc: Jessica, neglected and forced to marry William by her family, begs Lord Nightowl to kidnap her on her wedding day—unaware that he is William. He pranks her by making her his maid for a week, hoping she'll give up, but ends up falling for her instead.

KrR9AjwTLh.title: She Plays, She Wins
KrR9AjwTLh.desc: Lin Qingqian endured abuse from Qin Zhou, secretly collecting evidence. She was mistaken for a blind-date partner by Li Tingchen. After Qin Zhou publicly shamed her, she left with Li Tingchen. Li Tingchen tried to claim her, only to realize she'd never been tamed—she used every man who came close.

dU9sCVdjdT.title: Exposed His First Love in Court
dU9sCVdjdT.desc: Jiang Yuan's mother-in-law, Zhao Yuhua, is killed by Lin Xiaoxiao, her husband Lu Zhan's first love. Deceived by Lin Xiaoxiao, Lu Zhan defends her, unaware of the truth, and repeatedly hurts Jiang Yuan. She fights through obstacles to expose the truth and bring justice for her mother-in-law.

mrf5VzdFYV.title: Love Is Never Too Late
mrf5VzdFYV.desc: Fifty-year-old laborer Li Yougen joins the dating show Love Is Never Too Late at his wealthy son's request. Initially humiliated by female contestants for his humble appearance, he shocks everyone when his bank balance is revealed, turning the tables on those who looked down on him.

r174W8P46S.title: From Doorman to Billionaire
r174W8P46S.desc: From a humble doorman to a billionaire, a short series about love, betrayal, and revenge. Watch as our hero uses his unexpected fortune to settle old scores and protect true love. When life gives you a twist, how will you choose?

GjfCvIdUg8.title: Since Got the Wrong Lover
GjfCvIdUg8.desc: Olivia, the cherished daughter of the Owen family, takes a bold step to win the heart of Simon, her childhood betrothed. Disguising her identity, she becomes Simon's mistress for three years, despite her family's objections. During this time, Olivia secretly assists Simon and his family through various financial crisis. Just as Simon's career flourishes and Olivia prepares to reveal her true identity, a misunderstanding occurs. Simon mistakes Nicole, who has just returned, for his long-last childhood sweetheart. Influenced by Nicole, Simon accuses Olivia of conspiring with his business rivals and drives her away. He even goes so far as to reject his arranged marriage with the Owen family to be with Nicole. Little does Simon know that the childhood sweetheart he's been searching for and the Owen heiress he's rejecting are both, in fact, it's Olivia...

GBDvtkuqHw.title: My Cunning Wife
GBDvtkuqHw.desc: Three years ago, due to a frame-up in a construction accident involving the Ji Group, the couple committed suicide, leaving behind their two children. The older brother, Ji Hai, became a vegetative state, while the younger sister, Ji Ning, changed her name to Ji An'an to seek revenge. She approached Zhang Ying, the matriarch of the Qin family, who at that time needed an informant within the family to consolidate her position. Zhang Ying adopted Ji Anan and arranged for her to be engaged to her nephew, Qin Sheng. Thus, Ji Ning entered the Qin family and began her path of vengeance.

mB3SGj6Xg4.title: CEO's Boxing Queen
mB3SGj6Xg4.desc: Shen Xingruo marries Song Hanyu with the help of his grandmother. On their wedding day, Shen defends her best friend, while Song's grandmother gifts them gold bars and property. Song tests Shen by pretending to be poor. At a class reunion, Shen is framed, but Song steps in to clear her name. When Xia Qianxue returns from abroad, Shen misjudges Song, but in the end, the truth is revealed, and they reconcile.

cUScTcQcgF.title: Quantum Rebirth: The Eternal Mind
cUScTcQcgF.desc: Physicist Ma Siqi, reborn as Fang Qianjing via brain-computer interface, develops quantum computers and digital life tech. At Yuanqu Summit, facing doubt and betrayal, he foils Cui Kaiwen and Hopkins' plots, then follows Cheng Bailu into a new dimension, launching a new era for humanity.

fxopIme2HY.title: Invincible Marshal: Special Ops
fxopIme2HY.desc: Chaos erupts in Miaojiang, bringing disaster and suffering—who can restore peace? Only Long Zhan.

Mp3fy6cs79.title: Tiny Matriarch Reborn
Mp3fy6cs79.desc: In the early 20th century, Grace Walker's soul unexpectedly transmigrates into a modern 9-year-old girl. Facing the fallen descendants of the Walker family, she uses her past-life connections to rebuild the clan and restore its former glory!

9Gum781otT.title: Thanksgiving With Mom and Dad
9Gum781otT.desc: A brave girl fights to save her dying father, unaware that the woman who helps her is the mother she has been searching for her whole life.

yAet15aI2Z.title: Crushing My Boyfriend's Crazy Family
yAet15aI2Z.desc: Lin Chuyao visits boyfriend He Nansheng's home, facing constant jabs from his bratty sister and pushy mother demanding marriage. She agrees to move up the wedding, then uncovers their scheme and exposes it. As tensions explode, He Nansheng finally arrives late.

Sn4IxHrXjJ.title: Second Chance With My Old Flame
Sn4IxHrXjJ.desc: Brenna and Kevin split due to misunderstandings. She raises their son Lucas abroad for five years. Reunited, Kevin thinks she's married; Brenna thinks he's about to marry someone else. Despite love and resentment, they can't resist their bond. They resolve misunderstandings and reunite as a family.

JjfxyMSu1s.title: Don't Open Mom's Package
JjfxyMSu1s.desc: At 4:44, a mysterious package arrives for Wen Ni's mother, who forbids her to touch it. Her mother grows younger, transforms from modest to seductive, entertains strange men, and turns cold toward Wen Ni. With rumors of missing girls and dark magic, Wen Ni must uncover the package's secret.

5AwnGQAH15.title: From Secrets to Love
5AwnGQAH15.desc: Ling Xiaoxiao, in debt due to her mother’s illness, is forced to get close to CEO He Ming for trade secrets. He later discovers she’s not a gold-digger and falls for her. After she’s kidnapped, he saves her, and she confesses her secret, becoming his love and winning his heart.

QIB5nQQsN3.title: The Mutant Zone Conspiracy
QIB5nQQsN3.desc: Awakening from a prophetic dream, Lin Xia discovered her boyfriend's betrayal. With a mutant monster lurking and no one believing her warnings, only Zhou Mingye stood by her. Upon learning the truth behind her parents' deaths, she embarked on a path of bloody revenge.

zGPsQRuHLm.title: Mommy's Avengers: The Quad Squad
zGPsQRuHLm.desc: Framed by her family, Shen Qingyan is forced to take the blame for her sister Shen Huan's crimes. After a fateful encounter with Mo Shijun, she gives birth, only to have her child stolen and herself imprisoned by Shen Huan’s schemes. Upon release, Shen Qingyan is sold into a club, but her eldest child seeks out Mo Shijun for help. Despite Shen Huan’s deceptions, including a fake birthmark and paternity test, her malicious plans unravel, and she is exposed and arrested at her engagement ceremony.

RhtyUn8T1i.title: Ancient Princess, Modern Revenge
RhtyUn8T1i.desc: After the downfall of her noble family, the once-powerful princess unexpectedly wakes up in the modern world—only to discover that her domineering CEO husband is actually her greatest enemy from a past life. Now reborn, she's ready to turn the tables, rise to power, and take revenge on the scumbag men and two-faced "innocent" girls who dare to stand in her way.

Q2SuBNEyan.title: My Fierce Mother
Q2SuBNEyan.desc: Ye Muyu, hiding her identity for love, became a housewife and endured countless grievances. After reclaiming her identity, she faced difficulties at a class reunion and during a holiday gathering at her old home. She resolved these crises with her own abilities. At her daughter's classmate's birthday party, she was humiliated again, but she ultimately counterattacked successfully, protecting her family from bullying and achieving a triumphant comeback.

Lp67ynbovD.title: The Peerless Overlord
Lp67ynbovD.desc: Ning Zhe, once the supreme protector of Dragon Nation, had slain seventy percent of the warriors on the Top 100 list. With no more threats to Dragon Nation, he handed over the Supreme Seal to Xing Lie and vanished from the public eye. Three years later, Ning Zhe has transformed into a mere security guard, his glory long gone. After being dumped by his fiancée, Ning Zhe unexpectedly crosses paths with Xing Lie again. It turns out that Dragon Nation has since fallen into the hands of criminals. Now, as a humble “security guard,” how can Ning Zhe simply stand by and watch?

ra9Oek63cH.title: The Swapped Heiress: Truth Revealed
ra9Oek63cH.desc: Twenty years ago, the wealthy Cheng Yun hired Zhao Hui from the countryside to be a nanny for her newborn daughter, Jiang Xiao'er. However, Zhao Hui, filled with jealousy over Cheng Yun's wealth, swapped her own daughter, Zhao Yue, with Jiang Xiao'er while Cheng Yun was away, leading to a mistaken identity. Zhao Yue grew up as the third young miss of the Jiang family, living a life of privilege. Meanwhile, Jiang Xiao'er, renamed Fang Qing and raised by scavenger Fang Zhiyong, excelled academically and entered a top high school. Zhao Yue, also attending the same school, became jealous of Fang Qing's success and tried to get her expelled. Just as Zhao Yue made her move, Cheng Yun discovered that Zhao Yue was not her biological daughter and came to the school in search of her real daughter. The long-lost mother and daughter are about to reunite.

mSpWdWm0gG.title: Bossed and Tossed
mSpWdWm0gG.desc: Sage joins her father's law firm with high hopes, only to be demoted while her scheming half-sister takes the spotlight. A sudden body swap with her father's rival, Charles, forces her into an awkward partnership with the man who might be her greatest adversary—or her closest ally.

BI5X1nCC7O.title: Gods Walk Among Sinners
BI5X1nCC7O.desc: Daniel performs as a god but watches human suffering with indifference. Orphan Emily is forced to marry a tyrant to save her brother Thomas. Daniel gives the tyrant a "fertility wine" that makes him pregnant, plunging his powerful family into chaos. Is Daniel just a performer—or the last true god?

hAvZh13S2U.title: He Always Finds Me(Dubbed)
hAvZh13S2U.desc: Cecilia Walker returns to her 17-year-old self and vows to avoid past mistakes. But as Noah Mitchell keeps closing in, she wants to resist, yet can't escape him. Adapted from the Tomato Novel Heartbeat! A Beam of Moonlight in the Studio Next Door.

gv5RsNGtSW.title: Back to 2002
gv5RsNGtSW.desc: Reborn with a second chance, my life is forever changed by the World Cup! From the stadiums to the heartaches, I relive every thrilling moment and rewrite my destiny.

9fzPEhpwau.title: The Nation's Healer
9fzPEhpwau.desc: Renowned healer Michael cures his daughter's brain cancer, earning national fame. His final surgery is for wealthy Daniel's son. When Daniel's wife Emily insults him, unaware of his identity, she regrets it once the truth emerges.

is4i2OY5jJ.title: The Vengeful Ex-Wife
is4i2OY5jJ.desc: Xu Jiayin discovers that her beloved husband is cheating on her and, to her shock, he attempts to run her over with a car while she is pregnant! After a difficult escape, Xu Jiayin spends two years recovering, undergoing a complete transformation, and returns with a strong resolve for revenge.

hce3taE3dp.title: Reborn: Treasured by the Regent
hce3taE3dp.desc: In her past life, Sophia trusted a deceitful man who is her savior, raising his children and managing the family, only to be betrayed and buried alive by her husband, his mistress, and two illegitimate sons. Reborn, she vows revenge—this time, she'll repay betrayal with ruthless cunning.

1Ri15klSlI.title: Midnight Knock: The Human-Faced Bear
1Ri15klSlI.desc: Deep in the misty Mount Mournfall, hunter Owen fails to return home. At midnight, his daughter Aubrey and son Doug hear a mysterious knock at the door. Quick-witted Aubrey sees through the creature’s disguise, and the siblings narrowly escape.

BDIFsz9IyD.title: Her Highness Fled with Baby Again
BDIFsz9IyD.desc: In her past life, Crown Prince  Lucas Scott was saved by a lowly old woman, and he rewarded her with wealth. Reborn, Sophia Walker plans to marry him, have his child, and then flee with the child. But Lucas Scott developed gynophobia because of her and has been desperately searching for her.

ICSnjL9X1G.title: Emotion System: Crush the Fake Heiress
ICSnjL9X1G.desc: Lin Shiyi, an orphan, learned she was the Jiang family's true daughter. Her mother died, her father married his mistress, doted on his son, and trusted foster daughter Jiang Rourou. Upon dying, she activated a negative-emotion system that grants rewards. Reborn, she fights back.

8v4QSrY21g.title: Post-Divorce Pop Star Revolution
8v4QSrY21g.desc: Pop queen Ye Qiu reincarnates as delivery girl, stuns audience singing。Ex-husband Qiao and star Su frame her。Uses vocal genius to sign with Future Ent., donates ¥1B to reclaim throne

gUx8ZOxWTx.title: Flash Vows
gUx8ZOxWTx.desc: To adopt Sara, Alison advertises for a contract marriage and mistakes Robert for her partner. Robert, a low-key group president, conceals his identity. As they grow closer, Sara's appearance complicates things further and bonds them together, forcing them to confront their true desires.

IwAXQGokbN.title: The Phoenix's Revenge
IwAXQGokbN.desc: On a stormy night, Emily Bennett survives a difficult childbirth, only for her husband to cast their newborn aside. When his pregnant mistress appears, she learns their decade of marriage was a fraud to steal her fortune. Now betrayed, Emily must reclaim her destiny.

4Zd1wiONHQ.title: No More Pawn, Now His Bride
4Zd1wiONHQ.desc: Aria Robinson, infatuated with Noah Lee for years, never imagined he used her to sabotage his true love Charlotte Williams's marriage to Duke of National 's heir, Ethan Martin. Realizing she was just a pawn to make Charlotte jealous, heartbroken Aria marries Ethan, leaving Noah consumed with regret.

aHqAnopVVi.title: I'm Your Exclusive Weapon
aHqAnopVVi.desc: Lily King, a mute victim, secretly plots revenge. Taking her sister's place in a marriage, she escapes and meets the powerful Samuel Miller. Partnering for vengeance—she targets her family, he investigates his parents' death—they find justice and love.

UV0VxWXRPi.title: Immortal Emperor Reclaims His Divinity
UV0VxWXRPi.desc: At Immortal Emperor Chen Ping and Empress Zhao Linghan's wedding, she betrays him with Demon Lord Ji Mie, stealing his immortal bones, blood, and body. Chen Ping descends as a mystic to reclaim them for rebirth, enduring scorn. As everything is prepared, Zhao Linghan strikes again.

FbukCC3moi.title: Chasing My Quiet Crush
FbukCC3moi.desc: In senior year, a misdiagnosis emboldens housekeeper's daughter Xu Xingwan to approach Fu Yanci, whom she's loved for years. Her clumsy confessions are interrupted, but aloof Fu Yanci draws closer via tutoring. A transfer student's pursuit stirs his protectiveness, and they gradually unite.

r55yh69yTE.title: The Major General Wants to Marry Me
r55yh69yTE.desc: Major General Huo Xiyan, heir of the prominent Huo family, adopts an orphan, Shu Yue, secretly the daughter of a Duke from Su Lie Kingdom. After her adoptive parents die in an accident and she's mistreated by relatives, he rescues her and cares for her deeply. The innocent Shu Yue falls for him.

kdTX9LQeCL.title: A Couch Potato's Royal Rebirth
kdTX9LQeCL.desc: Chu Ying, a dedicated couch potato and hardcore fan, has spent millions to meet her idol, top star Ye Haotian. But during the fan event, she's humiliated by him for being overweight and falls off the stage, dying without him sparing a second glance. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the body of a historical figure with the same name—a fat concubine who was murdered. As her memories resurface, she learns that the true culprit is Prince Ye Mingli.

KrBJbdnGkx.title: Scaling New Heights in the Second Half of Life
KrBJbdnGkx.desc: The male protagonist was a diligent veteran technician who single-handedly shouldered the entire operation of the machinery plant. After his retirement, the plant collapsed, yet its members ironically ridiculed and alienated the very person who could have saved them. By serendipity, he gained the appreciation of the group's chairman and continued to shine in the corporation, ultimately becoming a legendary figure in the technical field through his unwavering dedication and expertise.

NgEf9drzQG.title: The Innocent Substitute Wife of Mr. Ji
NgEf9drzQG.desc: Wrongfully imprisoned by the man she loved, she thought her future would be one of solitude and separation. But little did she know, the storms of her past would rise again upon her release...

Rpr2aOSNqF.title: The Quest for the National Treasure
Rpr2aOSNqF.desc: Restorer Zhong Xiaoyu at exhibition robbed, hides awakening artifact spirit Shang Jun. He saves her, entrusts returning treasure. They outwit antique dealer Shi Yunzhang in thrilling adventure, finally bring treasure home.

r0ppC2o2Cq.title: The CEO's Wild Wife
r0ppC2o2Cq.desc: Shen Xingruo and Song Hanyu get married with the help of Grandma Song. During their wedding, Shen Xingruo protects her best friend, while Song Grandma gifts them gold bars and property deeds. Song Hanyu tests Shen Xingruo by falsely claiming to be a poor boy. At a class reunion, Shen Xingruo is wrongfully accused, and Song Hanyu comes to her rescue. When Xia Qianxue returns to the country, Shen Xingruo misunderstands Song Hanyu, but in the end, the truth is revealed, and they reconcile.

tKWv5IuIBa.title: Unexpected Bride at Another's Wedding
tKWv5IuIBa.desc: Jiang & Li, top clans in Fengcheng, ally via marriage. On wedding day, bride Jiang's second daughter catches Li Ziyang cheating. Eldest daughter Jiang Zhiwan is forced to replace her. To rebel, she targets Li's uncle.

A579jmLStE.title: Tiny Healer, Great Miracle
A579jmLStE.desc: Grieving his daughter's death, medical sage Theodore is reborn as the frail Sebastian. Using his past-life skills and needle mastery, he protects his sister, battles family and external plots, restores the Clark family clinic, exposes conspiracies, and becomes a legendary doctor.

8Ry8FAjkRW.title: Bound by Love and Betrayal
8Ry8FAjkRW.desc: After divorcing, actress Xie Luoshen faces her ex-husband Liao Minghao’s conspiracy. With the help of her friend Shi Weiwei, she rebuilds her career and gets entangled with CEO Gu Yanshen. After overcoming challenges, she rescues her daughter, seeks revenge, and finds love with Gu.

XABdxOMQGk.title: Working as the Prince's Mistress
XABdxOMQGk.desc: Modern worker Song Qingran transmigrated and signed a "mistress contract" with Prince Ning Zhuo for 500 taels monthly. She navigated among kids, a princess, and villains while eyeing her boss. As power and plots merged, they fell for each other and overcame crises together.

cPgcHVZ4zX.title: Office Rise, From Clerk to Leader
cPgcHVZ4zX.desc: A low-level hospital clerk, bullied by colleagues and betrayed by his wife, works diligently despite it all. By chance, he exposes a colleague's hypocrisy, earning a triple promotion and rising swiftly to surpass those who once looked down on him.

PAcw2EtOLM.title: The Mystery of Marriage
PAcw2EtOLM.desc: Qiao Wanxing, in pursuit of what she believes to be true love, marries and moves far away to Jiangcheng, where she and her husband, He Youwei, have a child. During her postpartum confinement, she begins to suspect that her husband is cheating on her and vows to uncover the mistress. With her husband's subtle emotional manipulation, her mother-in-law's disdain, a baby crying for attention, and the hidden mistress, her marriage turns into a silent battlefield. Watch as she navigates the chaos, breaks the deadlock, and undergoes a rebirth.

DP81oBougX.title: Agent in the Core Storm
DP81oBougX.desc: Ace agent Zhou Xiaoxiao infiltrates Eagle Island to investigate a scientist's death and his missing son. At an Rh-negative blood gala, she approaches chip expert Jack. His unnaturally calm reaction to a stalker alerts her, leading her to suspect his ties to the mystery.

PHuMoNQP1P.title: My Gorgeous Warrior Bride
PHuMoNQP1P.desc: She is a warrior goddess honed through rigorous training, yet unaware that her husband is a supreme warrior standing above all. A vile schemer, using a false identity, approaches her, urging her to distrust her husband. In the end, the hero uncovers the plot and is reunited with his beloved warrior bride.

l35zCuZLKV.title: Ex-Wife Storms Back with Four Kids
l35zCuZLKV.desc: Six years after a car accident and betrayal left her disfigured, Sophia Martin returns with a new face and four children to seek revenge. Disguised as Lily Williams, she hides as a maid in her ex-husband Ethan Walker’s home, where he slowly realizes she never truly left.

GrPWWkuHNL.title: My Dad is a Secret Mech Tycoon
GrPWWkuHNL.desc: Zhang Zhiyuan was once a renowned figure in mechanical engineering, overseeing the development of numerous national key projects. After retiring, he worked as a janitor at his son Zhang Xiaohai's factory, where his son had no idea of his true capabilities, seeing him as just an ordinary old man. During a mechanical technology conference, Zhang Xiaohai felt embarrassed in front of industry veterans, especially by his janitor father. However, he was shocked to see that even the powerful female CEOs and the daughters of industry leaders showed utmost respect to his father. This left Zhang Xiaohai stunned. Could it be... his father is a hidden big shot?

OKEd1yEDqI.title: Forever Bound by Regret
OKEd1yEDqI.desc: Betrayed by husband Xu Huainan, Xie Anning is reborn and refuses to donate her kidney, choosing Lu Zeyuan instead. Young Xu Huainan time-travels to her funeral and sees that his older self caused her suicide. Trying to change fate, he's trapped in a tragic cycle.

ovZ9mZfitX.title: Delivery's Over! I'm Becoming a Big Shot
ovZ9mZfitX.desc: Deliveryman Li Yue lived hard until dramatic change. A beautiful CEO pursued him, tycoons befriended him, underworld protected him. But behind lies a fierce inheritance war over top business empire. Can he reverse fate and reach peak?

mxxCYel9t0.title: Reborn to Riches, From Trash to Tycoon
mxxCYel9t0.desc: Thrown back to the 1990s, our protagonist uses his future knowledge to turn trash into treasure. From humble beginnings as a scavenger, he climbs the ladder of success to become a powerful billionaire tycoon.

7AEx3VTvxf.title: The Silent Bride Meant for Him
7AEx3VTvxf.desc: Yun Xi became mute after her father's severe car accident. Her stepmother Tang Fengyi and stepsister Tang Qianqian abused her. She spent a night with heir Xiao Jin, who had contact allergy but tolerated her. He traced her silver heel, but Tang Fengyi plotted to substitute her daughter.

RfrA59EK3h.title: She Shines for Herself
RfrA59EK3h.desc: Lin Xingyao becomes Ye Jinxuan's antidote and marries him. His first love Lin Ruoruo dies at their wedding, and he blames her. She sacrifices her career but suffers abuse. Reborn, she switches places with her sister at the wedding and pursues her dream as an interpreter.

AsjRRNsxem.title: Reunited Across Time
AsjRRNsxem.desc: Ancient general's daughter Wen Xi time-travels to the modern era, reuniting with Xiao Yunshen who lost his past-life memories. Despite rival Lin Wan'er's schemes, Wen Xi prevails. Xiao Yunshen falls for her. After misunderstandings, they reconcile, united across lifetimes in marriage.

vp6tBy1ED1.title: From Fake Heiress to Billionaire's Darling
vp6tBy1ED1.desc: The elite circles of Haicheng are abuzz with shocking news—Pei family's eldest daughter, Pei Fanyi, turns out to be an imposter! The real heiress chooses the very day of Fanyi's wedding to the heir of the Wei family to expose the truth. Stirred by the revelation, the Pei parents believe Fanyi has known all along, furiously denounce her, and banish her from the wedding and their family, severing all ties. From then on, she takes the surname Sheng. Fortunately, Sheng Fanyi's biological parents are the wealthiest people in the world. Instead of falling into despair, she steps into a dazzling new life—not only as the daughter of a global tycoon but also as the beloved sister of two doting brothers.

SmvBegKGqi.title: Mr. Johnston, Don’t Torment Her
SmvBegKGqi.desc: After 5 years together, Shane abruptly left Anna. That same day, she learned she had 3 months to live due to heart failure. Resolved to spare him pain, her departure ignited a tortuous love...

Witb9pjbWF.title: The Transformation of the Ugly Girl
Witb9pjbWF.desc: Jiang Qingge, who has a beautiful voice, has been inferior to others for a long time because of her fat body and poor appearance. Even her chance to perform on stage was snatched away by a beautiful idol. On the day of the fan meeting, Jiang Qingge accidentally fell out of the backstage and made a fool of herself. She was ridiculed and humiliated by the audience. Only Ji Chuan stood up to protect her. Just when Jiang Qingge thought that Ji Chuan really appreciated her, she found out that Ji Chuan's real purpose was to use her voice for profit, and he looked down on her like everyone else. Jiang Qingge, who was hit, proposed to terminate the contract and then disappeared. Ji Chuan searched for her in vain, but he didn't know that Jiang Qingge had been reborn in a year and became a real beauty.

FYwD1JXUhK.title: Silent Resilience in a Love Tragedy
FYwD1JXUhK.desc: Ye Xingyan marries long-time love Gu Shaocheng but faces neglect. When she nearly drowns saving Su Chuchu, he only cares for Su. At the hospital, she discovers her unexpected pregnancy, but a misunderstanding causes him to push her down stairs, resulting in hurt and divorce.

ctOx9wrHse.title: A Brother's Promise
ctOx9wrHse.desc: After the tragic death of their parents, Wu Yaozu's uncle publicly threatens to sell his younger brother, claiming it will relieve his burden. Refusing to part with his brother, Wu Yaozu promises their parents that he will always care for him. Ten years later, Wu Yaozu and his wife face a financial crisis when she is injured in a car accident and requires surgery. Unable to raise enough money, his brother arrives at the hospital, feeling guilty and expressing his desire to quit school. Wu Yaozu scolds him, urging him to honor their sacrifices. Motivated by his brother's words, Wu Yaozu's brother studies hard, eventually earning a spot at his dream university.

nupttqT2YS.title: Her Stunning Return with Triplets
nupttqT2YS.desc: In college, Lu Yunshen secretly had feelings for the female lead, Nan Xiaoyao, but her senior, Song Yang, won her heart instead. To witness Nan Xiaoyao's happiness, Lu Yunshen arranges for his company's banquet to be held at the same hotel as her engagement party. During the event, he discovers that Song Yang and Nan Xiaoyao's younger sister, Nan Yue, are conspiring to slander Nan Xiaoyao and force her out of the Nan family. Lu Yunshen orders his assistant to monitor them, but mistakenly enters Nan Xiaoyao's room, resulting in a one-night stand. When Nan Xiaoyao learns the truth, she decides to leave. She becomes pregnant and gives birth to triplets abroad. Six years later, Lu Yunshen is still deeply in love with Nan Xiaoyao and searches for her. Xu Mengyao attempts to stop them, using heavy financial means to harm their mother and children. The triplets protect their mother and help their father win back Nan Xiaoyao, and in the end, the family is reunited.

ffGOsqZFxG.title: The Ultimate Dragon-in-Law
ffGOsqZFxG.desc: At his wedding, groom Lin Yang is publicly rejected, humiliated, and forced to act as witness for the bride and her lover. After enduring the shame, the heiress of the wealthy Bai family appears, offering Lin Yang a marriage into her family, leaving the bride and the other man stunned.

ICUjMH6Uwy.title: From General to Radiant Heiress
ICUjMH6Uwy.desc: Brave and skilled General Emily Brown unexpectedly time-travels into the body of the neglected true daughter of the wealthy Jones family. Faced with mockery from the fake heiress Sarah Jones and scorn from the staff, she fights back with wit and courage to reclaim what's hers.

2Mk6np4UT5.title: Blind Love Test
2Mk6np4UT5.desc: General's daughter Emily Wilson lost her mother early and went blind after her father and brothers died in battle. Her vicious relatives scheme to force her into marriage. At the breaking point, she meets the ruthless yet equally scarred Prince Michael Parker—and wagers on love through marriage.

bnjGkBcgsE.title: Missing Child, Buried Lies
bnjGkBcgsE.desc: A car accident shatters businesswoman Zoe Smith's perfect life: her daughter vanishes, her husband Felix Miller changes, and suspicions rise. Sixteen years later, his strange behavior during a village project fuels her doubts. Going there alone, Zoe uncovers the buried truth.

jcm4aQsWpU.title: Frozen Bonds, Bitter Regret
jcm4aQsWpU.desc: Baek Yeo-na, once loved by her foster sons, becomes a bullied "outsider" when their biological mother Choi Ye-rin appears. Heartbroken, she volunteers for her eldest son's research and donates her cornea to restore her second son's sight. After her disappearance, a cruel truth emerges.

EPgoFDweNP.title: The Delivery Man Returns a King
EPgoFDweNP.desc: Qin Feng, originally a delivery man, is noticed by Celestial Lord Xiao Qiancheng after a heroic rescue and becomes his disciple. Framed on a mission, he meets Su Wanqing but leaves. Five years later, now God King, Qin Feng returns, learns Su Wanqing saved him, and begins protecting her.

dnzmAKRZFW.title: Desire She Could Not Escape
dnzmAKRZFW.desc: Betrayed by her boyfriend, Shu Yu meets Gu Zixing on a rainy night. He lifts his umbrella over her head, his gaze openly direct and burning. What begins as a no-strings adult game turns dangerous as he schemes relentlessly, pushing her into a passion that ultimately costs her everything.

6ZtDZdypEW.title: My Billionaire Werewolf
6ZtDZdypEW.desc: After her father's death, her best friend and boyfriend plot against her. However, the female lead meets Mr. Gu, the richest heir. What she doesn't know is that the young and handsome Mr. Gu has another identity: the successor to the Werewolf Leader.

UYlv166toq.title: The Wronged Fiancée Strikes Back
UYlv166toq.desc: Six years ago, the heroine, Qing Xue, was framed by Lu Jiaojiao and sentenced to prison for intentional injury. After serving her sentence, she is released from prison, only to find both her ex-boyfriend and fiancé waiting to take her away. However, Qing Xue is deeply disappointed by their easy trust in her enemies, who had destroyed her family, and chooses to leave alone.

7vbrKtx2WH.title: Grace in the Flames
7vbrKtx2WH.desc: In her past life, Olivia mistakenly identified her savior and was manipulated by the Sixth Prince and Evelyn, causing her family's death. Reborn with memories, she avoids their schemes, helps deposed Prince David rise to power, and discovers he's her true savior.

jZsIqxsSZX.title: A Deal Turned Into Love
jZsIqxsSZX.desc: The male and female leads enter into a marriage of convenience due to family interests. However, as they spend more time together, they begin to develop genuine feelings for each other, leading to a series of emotional entanglements and complications.

676daL90bT.title: This Time, I Choose a New Bride
676daL90bT.desc: Huo Mingxiu is murdered by his wife Zhou Yueyue for his fortune. Reborn, he arranges for Bai Anning to crash his wedding and exposes Zhou's affair. Publicly canceling the marriage, he weds Bai instead. Together they defeat Zhou's schemes and send her to prison.

UWS3eO2p1W.title: She Kissed Danger
UWS3eO2p1W.desc: Elsa, a fallen heiress sold by her mother to the possessive tycoon Noah, makes a desperate escape on her wedding day—only to plunge headfirst into the dangerous world of underground racer Owen, a man of ice who conceals a fiery, darker past. Together, they ignite a thrilling, intoxicating romance.

nC9fLbrXWM.title: Unstoppable at the Class Reunion
nC9fLbrXWM.desc: Lin Miaomiao, a self-made CEO of Tianyu Group, returns home for a classmate's opening and faces humiliation. She exposes Vice President Bai's schemes, teaches her bullies a lesson, confronts more troublemakers, asserts her identity, and decides to move her family and teacher to the city.

Q1sxUqYtbr.title: The Dragon's Secret Sacrifice
Q1sxUqYtbr.desc: Once atop the throne's shadow, the mighty Qing Wushuang, fell to disgrace, branded a traitor by all. On a day lit by national TV screens, he faced judgment and punishment, stripped of his powers, shackled, and reduced to nothing. Yet, this was all a masterful deception, orchestrated by Qing Wushuang and the ruler, where he willingly became the pawn, sacrificing himself to uncover the true betrayer.

188UXUoG50.title: I Am No Master
188UXUoG50.desc: Ye Fei was once the Guardian Lord of the Nation, but after slaying the Eight-Headed Serpent, he was ambushed and cast down a cliff. Losing his memory, he became an ordinary worker. One day, his fiancée came to him, demanding a breakup. She confessed that she had fallen for the son of a wealthy tycoon and insulted Ye Fei in the process. Just as Ye Fei and his parents were left stunned, the National Protector, Feng Qingwu, appeared at their door.

yGrCS7FUIg.title: I Keep Dying, My Fox Keeps Chasing
yGrCS7FUIg.desc: Betrayed by her uncle, Jiang Nuan falls off a cliff and is saved by the nine-tailed fox Yun Qi—who kills her three times. Desperate, she kisses him, swallows his inner elixir, and gains power. She seduces him while reclaiming her fortune, only to learn his killings were meant to save her.

oKs08Ifb12.title: Resurgence of Youth
oKs08Ifb12.desc: Eighteen years ago, Lu Fanghua tangled with rogue Li Jianming, leading her father Lu Zhensheng to abandon her. Pregnant and deserted, she gave birth alone in a fire-trap and saved her baby by pushing him out before dying. Mistakenly believing his daughter dead, Lu Zhensheng raised her grandson.Eighteen years later, disfigured Lu Fanghua encounters her son, Lu Zeyu, but is mistakenly accused of extortion and beaten. Embarrassed by her past, she hides her identity as the family's cook but earns her father's praise. Despite opportunities to reveal her identity, she fears rejection. Framed by others, she is expelled but endures hardships, finally reuniting with her son and father, gaining forgiveness, and guiding her son. A story of resilience and love.

7aXzdKsJbs.title: Mom Wants to Get Married
7aXzdKsJbs.desc: The female protagonist, Su Lizhen, is nearly 50 years old and a laid-off worker. She has been drained emotionally and financially by her son’s family, who constantly belittle her. In desperation, she decides to appear on a matchmaking show. However, she is mistaken for a scammer and is kicked off the stage. Devastated, she contemplates suicide but is saved by the CEO Qiu Shusen, who is secretly participating in the show. The two quickly marry. After the flash marriage, Su Lizhen faces a series of challenges, including mockery and harassment from old classmates, misunderstandings and unreasonable demands from her son's family, and even being forced by her son to appear on a TV show for a confrontation. However, with the CEO’s support, she overcomes each crisis and ultimately finds her long-lost daughter, who has been missing for 20 years.

Fe3XYLT3Zf.title: A Blazing Marriage
Fe3XYLT3Zf.desc: Xia Qing, once believing she had the perfect husband envied by all, faced a stark reality after a car accident left her ill for three years. During this time, her assets were systematically dismantled and transferred away. It wasn't until her husband turned his sights on her parents that Xia Qing began to awaken from her slumber. For the sake of her family and children, she rose up with courage to fight back.

L0j6xJew03.title: Reborn Tycoon: Rising to Wealth
L0j6xJew03.desc: After being poisoned by the vice president, Li Changlin, the CEO of Changlin Group, finds his soul reincarnated into the body of a poor rural man named Li Xiaolin. Li Xiaolin, who owes a large sum due to gambling, is forced to become a live-in son-in-law. Just as he's about to marry, his childhood sweetheart, Li Mingyue, claims to be pregnant, causing the wedding to be postponed. The next day, with the help of the Qingxuan ring and guidance from a mysterious figure, Li Xiaolin defeats the debt collector, Tao Hai, and wins back all his gambling debts. He then wins a sum of money from a lottery at a small shop, which he uses as a dowry. Determined to find a way to become wealthy, Li Xiaolin breaks the monopoly of Tao Hai and his brothers by offering a higher purchase price for goods. Through his efforts, Li Xiaolin meets the heiress of the Lin Group, who invests in his tea plantation, helping him break free from his financial struggles and start his journey to wealth.

vVPzIsKM8c.title: King of the Mahjong Realm
vVPzIsKM8c.desc: The Mahjong Sect's founder is reborn a thousand years later as a disgraced son facing his clan's downfall. Rising from nothing, he crushes arrogant rivals, defeats a once-in-a-century genius, and stuns the realm with his unmatched skills—becoming the new Mahjong God and its ultimate protector.

ZRgAu6Qdhj.title: Secretly Married to the Lucky Wife
ZRgAu6Qdhj.desc: With Li Yao's Grandma's help, Lan Xia marries Li Yao in a flash wedding. At the Li Group, she's bullied for her height and framed by Zhu Mantong. Though Li Junjun first resents her, Lan Xia proves herself, clears the air with Li Yao, and learns Junjun is her lost child, leading to a happy reunion.

zL0Gm3Qwvt.title: Daddy, Can You Hear Me Cry?
zL0Gm3Qwvt.desc: Ava is wrongfully imprisoned and gives birth to Emmie, asking her to find her father, Michael. Olivia switches Emmie with a fake daughter. Michael brings both home, and the real Emmie suffers abuse. Ava returns, posing as a "twin" to expose Olivia, and finally reunites with Michael and Emmie.

DbrtUiD4ot.title: Baby Daddy's Chase for Love
DbrtUiD4ot.desc: Multi-talented Su Manqiu has a one-night stand with CEO Lu Jinnian, leaves money, and disappears. Six years later, a child appears claiming Lu Jinnian as their father. They meet again; Su Manqiu vanishes again. Lu Jinnian transforms into a jealous pursuer on his long journey to win back his family.

uUZ0QiQTzm.title: The Cold-Blooded CEO
uUZ0QiQTzm.desc: During a part-time job, she unexpectedly runs into her ex-husband, the CEO. She turns to run, but he catches her, declaring, "Think you can leave? No way!" From there unfolds a love story between a domineering CEO and his delicate wife. What kind of sparks will they ignite?

oPrWPbLgrq.title: Tempting Beauty
oPrWPbLgrq.desc: Bai Pu, the personal assistant to Lu Zhaohe, the CEO of Chengchuan Corporation, stumbles upon her fiancé Jiang Lin cheating with her half-sister Bai Liu. Enraged by Jiang Lin's betrayal and cruel words, Bai Pu seeks solace and revenge by drawing closer to Lu Zhaohe, her boss and Jiang Lin's uncle. An unexpected intimate encounter between them entangles all four in a complex love quadrangle. Heartbroken by Jiang Lin's betrayal, Bai Pu vows never to trust love again. However, she doesn't plan to end her relationship with Jiang Lin due to her mother's dying wish for them to marry on Bai Pu's 25th birthday. Seeking revenge, Bai Pu continues to flirt with Lu Zhaohe, who, despite his stern exterior and restrained demeanor, secretly indulges her. Their hidden affair gradually blossoms into deep feelings as they exchange tender glances and whispered sweet nothings at work and family gatherings.As time passes, Bai Pu's 25th birthday approaches. Though she's been hurt deeply by love...

vNbfNOs7o4.title: The Twins' Love Struggle
vNbfNOs7o4.desc: Xin Yu and Xin Ya are twin sisters abandoned at an orphanage. As children, they each chose different paths for their futures. The older sister, Xin Ya, was adopted by the wealthy Fang family, while the younger sister, Xin Yu, went to the impoverished Cheng family. Ten years later, the Fang family's fortunes have declined, while Cheng Xin Yu has transformed into a wealthy heiress and is now in a relationship with her childhood friend, Pei Jing, the heir of the Pei family. However, just as Cheng Xin Yu and Pei Jing are about to get engaged, an unexpected car accident leads them down separate paths.

dchiffzmNJ.title: A Mother in Labor, A Violent Clash
dchiffzmNJ.desc: New Year's morning, Lin Qiu goes into labor. Wang Yi rushes to hospital but is blocked by elderly square dancers. Lead dancer Gui Fen demands he kneel and apologize. When refused, she strikes pregnant Lin Qiu's belly, causing hemorrhage. How will Haicheng's richest man handle this?

KBaf3MTdbN.title: Mother-in-Law’s Big Day, Daughter-in-Law’s Big Slay
KBaf3MTdbN.desc: To attend her mother-in-law's wedding, Wu Qianqian, heavily pregnant, goes to the hotel to deliver a wedding gift. However, she is spotted by her mother-in-law's friend, Kong Xueru, who stirs up trouble by accusing Wu Qianqian of seducing Zhao Guopeng. This leads her mother-in-law to mistakenly believe she is a mistress. Though Wu Qianqian clarifies her identity and resolves the misunderstanding, the arrival of reporters escalates the tension between her and her mother-in-law to a breaking point.

sOmd27rMd7.title: Never Mess with My Darling Boss
sOmd27rMd7.desc: College student Emily, working part-time as a bar waitress, accidentally meets a prestigious heir. After a one-night stand leaves her pregnant, her family tries to force her to marry an old man—unaware they've provoked the woman of a powerful heir.

JJvtXpPNEv.title: Accidentally Divorced the One
JJvtXpPNEv.desc: After three lukewarm years, Lu Linyuan divorces Sang Wanyi when his first love, Su Enyue, returns from abroad. Sang Wanyi sets a trap to catch him cheating. Only then does he realize he never truly knew her. Post-divorce regret consumes him as the chase begins.

RQNOnmKELq.title: Ice King and Runaway Bride
RQNOnmKELq.desc: After a drunken night, Gu Yunting, the heir to the Gu family conglomerate, accidentally spends the night with his intern secretary, Jiang Yining. Fearing retaliation, Jiang Yining quickly escapes the scene. However, in the process, her best friend Lin Xiaoxiao's resume is left behind in the room. When Gu Yunting wakes up and finds the resume, he mistakenly believes that Lin Xiaoxiao is the one he spent the night with.

VcNGBrUqX0.title: Divorced My Ex, Married His Boss
VcNGBrUqX0.desc: Five years ago, Yun Qing, the richest in Ninghai, was saved by Lin Yi as part of his plan. She defied her mother to marry him, giving up her heiress status. Unknowingly, Lin Yi later sold her to Chu Huai, a prestigious family head in Jiangbei, for a multi-million-dollar commission.

PQExaFy4kO.title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince
PQExaFy4kO.desc: Prince Philip of Lavinia flees to the U.S. to escape marriage pressure, meets betrayed Anna, and claims to be a royal gardener. They marry and fight her stepfamily, helping Anna inherit her mother's company. Philip reveals his identity, gains parental approval, and they live happily.

fYxXqsdUZt.title: The Girl Who Came from the Wild
fYxXqsdUZt.desc: Yin Tianxing, raised by mountain tribes after being lost, returned to her wealthy birth parents at eighteen. Her adoptive sister Yin Mingyue turned them against her. Forced into marriage, she escaped but was caught. Meanwhile, her tribe discovered gold and came to visit her.

RQRwirFVxT.title: Desired by the Last Alpha
RQRwirFVxT.desc: Alina is heartbroken after finding her boyfriend of three years in bed with another woman. Her best friend pulls her out of her depression to attend a party hosted by the elite couple Logan and Madeline, who hide their true identities. Unexpectedly, Alina becomes the object of their desires.

wAL6r7bkSY.title: She Returned as the Top Scholar
