wAL6r7bkSY.desc: Heiress Liu Qiancheng supports her husband through imperial exams, but he poisons her family to marry a princess. She survives, studies in hiding, and three years later tops the exams to sue him before the emperor, but accidentally uncovers a conspiracy. Can her family's massacre be avenged?

4A5dVCpDwi.title: Pampering by My Cuddly CEO
4A5dVCpDwi.desc: Anna catches her husband Ethan cheating with her cousin and plotting to steal her family fortune, and she vows revenge. One rainy night, she rescues Oliver. Sweet and clingy while amnesiac, he returns as a loyal and calculating CEO, secretly helping her strike back.

PL5rO5BJ9A.title: The Art of Ruining Men
PL5rO5BJ9A.desc: Heiress Lin Wanwan obsessively loved tycoon Bo Yanchen for seven years, during which she was treated as his toy. A "love curse" awakens her self-love, transforming her into a vengeful queen. She orchestrates scandals and schemes, reducing both Bo and her cowardly friend Jiang Yizhou to ruins.

GsYtfe9fg9.title: Villainess's Love Survival
GsYtfe9fg9.desc: Wen Yue transmigrates as a villain doomed to die at the hands of the maniac Shen Yi. To survive, she must raise his -250 affection score. Her desperate efforts spark real feelings, but he doubts her sincerity. When she takes a knife for him, she chooses to stay in the story for love.

qPZYCJGhsI.title: Trash to Treasure: My CEO Husband
qPZYCJGhsI.desc: After being betrayed and killed, He Qingqing is reborn with extraordinary powers. To escape a life of poverty, she must marry a rich heir to neutralize her abilities. However, when she crosses paths with the enigmatic CEO Yan Jinghuai again, their turbulent relationship reignites old memories, revealing a long-lost connection.

N1aN8QHFq6.title: The Forgotten Love
N1aN8QHFq6.desc: Arranged couple Yura and Rama share a drugged night. Rama leaves overseas, leaving Yura to raise their son alone. Years later, he returns to find Yura as his assistant. Jealous of her friend Melvin, Rama doubts their son's parentage. Can their clever son reunite his parents?

1pBNSgbBKm.title: Regret After My Death
1pBNSgbBKm.desc: Olivia’s an ordinary girl who’s secretly loved David, a business elite, for ages—but she only dares approach him after he loses his business and gets betrayed by his girlfriend. Then a witch shows up, saying she’ll help David become the wealthiest man—but Olivia has to trade her own lifespan for it.

rn0FujLyoy.title: The Crowned Phoenix, Switched Destiny(Dubbed)
rn0FujLyoy.desc: In the Phoenix Clan, Emily raised Sarah as the destined Phoenix for rebirth. Meanwhile, Liz grew up abused. During the selection ceremony, they discover that Sarah and Liz were switched at birth. Emily agrees to exchange daughters, admitting she knew all along—and was hiding an even greater secret.

VYTFZqsrJZ.title: A Scholar's Servant Journey
VYTFZqsrJZ.desc: The male lead gets so absorbed in reading a novel that he accidentally breaks his keyboard, only to find himself transported into the story. A top student from the Literature Department, he uses his talent to overcome countless challenges and eventually becomes a second-class servant in the Lin family.

tXHpVXUHNS.title: Silent Blade of Justice
tXHpVXUHNS.desc: Top lawyer Yan Ruqing, in hiding after 131 victories, is drawn into a hit-and-run case. She discovers that the culprit, Lin Shengbin, endangered her family and assaulted them. Standing as plaintiff, Yan Ruqing fights the lawless man with unwavering resolve, defending justice and her loved ones.

TV2ntvg8tq.title: From Farm Girl to Mafia Bride
TV2ntvg8tq.desc: Sophia goes to the city for her grandmother’s treatment, gets caught in a gang war, and saves Oliver. He falls for and pursues her. She’s betrayed—even sold—by her father and fiancé. Oliver rescues her, even taking a knife meant for her. Through their trials, she falls for and marries him.

4kIaOLDsKf.title: I Write My Own Fate
4kIaOLDsKf.desc: Emma Lee wakes as the betrayed heroine of an ancient romance novel! Her husband Oliver Smith abandons her to marry another. Refusing to be helpless, she uses wit and courage to rewrite her fate, break women's chains, and navigate love and intrigue, forging her own legendary path.

92gt8BDFMq.title: The Heiress Unmasked
92gt8BDFMq.desc: When Jiang Siying marries Wu Fan out of misplaced gratitude, she hides her true identity as a powerful heiress. She endures mistreatment from her in-laws while selflessly supporting her husband's career. However, her world turns upside down when she discovers Wu Fan isn't her childhood savior. A chance encounter with Zhou Fang, her actual rescuer, leads to a whirlwind of revelations, confrontations, and unexpected romance. As Jiang Siying's true identity comes to light, she must navigate the treacherous waters of high society, confront those who wronged her, and fight for her newfound love. This captivating tale of hidden identities, revenge, and true love will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very end.

zTahAI1oX5.title: Reborn Heiress Revealed
zTahAI1oX5.desc: Yu Tingwan, a woman abandoned by her wealthy family, is reborn as the rich girl Ting Wan. She decides to focus on her career, fight against family oppression, and uncover the truth behind her mother's death. During this process, Ting Wan reunites with her ex-husband and son, and her relationship with her fiancé Cheng Yanci becomes increasingly intertwined. Faced with misunderstandings and framing by her ex-husband, her relationship with Cheng Yanci deepens through mutual support. After experiencing kidnapping and forced marriage by her family, Ting Wan and Cheng Yanci work together to overcome difficulties and reclaim the inheritance. However, they are unfortunately involved in the extreme actions of her ex-husband. To save her son, Ting Wan is forced to temporarily separate from Cheng Yanci, leaving behind complex feelings and an uncertain future.

VyeVFQb8su.title: Rise of the Silent King
VyeVFQb8su.desc: Mute and deaf Ye Fan has been married to Chen Qingqing for five years, struggling through livestreaming. When he catches her cheating with rich businessman's son Long Aotian, she demands divorce without remorse. Pushed down the stairs by Long Aotian, his lost memory suddenly returns.

G9Y9yd0dJe.title: Restarting Our Love
G9Y9yd0dJe.desc: Eight years ago, Holly Clark broke up with Alexander Martin due to her illness. Eight years later, in despair, she attempts suicide. After her death, Alexander Martin learns the truth, regrets deeply, and is reborn ten years earlier to rewrite fate—ultimately finding happiness with Holly Clark.

IsIeXUn2cg.title: You Loved Me Too Late
IsIeXUn2cg.desc: After three years of abuse, Shen Shu dumps her CEO ex-husband and thrives in her career, surrounded by suitors. While he rages over their lost child, she becomes unreachable. When he finally pursues her desperately, he realizes that winning his ex-wife back is nearly impossible.

hHLvtOH4r0.title: She Walked Away From Fake Love
hHLvtOH4r0.desc: Su Niannian spends four years repaying her boyfriend Lin Chen's debts, only to discover he's a rich heir pretending to be poor for amusement. She leaves for her former senior Shen Qingheng, thrives in her career, and finds new love. Lin Chen regrets it, but she never looks back.

NyrAhuhjVa.title: From Prison to Unstoppable King
NyrAhuhjVa.desc: A poor young man rises to power in prison by defeating the strongest villain, becoming a kingpin. After his release, he attracts the attention of six beautiful CEOs, who vie for his affection, leading to intense rivalry among them. From that moment, he embarks on a journey to the pinnacle of success, where he navigates power, wealth, and love.

iIqYra9KYg.title: Too Lazy for Palace Drama(Dubbed)
iIqYra9KYg.desc: Su Xing divines on her first palace day that staying low-key brings success. She eats, sleeps, and avoids harem conflicts. But after she helps Concubine Liu find her cat, her peace shatters. Determined to remain carefree, she navigates schemes and unexpectedly brings harmony to the palace.

He58m1H2Za.title: Honey, Did You Poison Me?
He58m1H2Za.desc: In a war-torn era, Chen Jie transmigrates into a broke gambler's body. He has a beautiful wife and sister-in-law. His wife Su Yunjin, her face bruised, smiles as she brings him hot porridge. His system warns: Su Yunjin bought arsenic yesterday. Chen Jie eyes the bowl—honey, did you poison this?

XrCkcKu2M9.title: Unparalleled Hero Returns
XrCkcKu2M9.desc: A warrior god returns from battle to marry his fiancée, but faces slander from vulgar individuals and betrayal from his own elders. Relying solely on his own strength, he manages to stabilize the situation and finally proposes marriage to his fiancée as he wishes. However, his fiancée's family are actually greedy and unscrupulous individuals... Seeing the truth, the warrior god decides to take control of the situation completely with his own abilities.

rRwtKIAp8r.title: Back to 2008: The Path to Success
rRwtKIAp8r.desc: In an accident, Jiang Yu finds herself transported back to 2008. With the memories of her present self intact, she takes half of a family heirloom jade pendant and seeks out the wealthiest man, Qin Ming. She boldly claims to be his destined partner and promises to help him navigate through his looming financial crisis.

9X3XE4e2DN.title: Pool Shark Payback
9X3XE4e2DN.desc: Ryan Green, an office worker, loses his fortune and home in a scam at an underground pool hall. His wife Sarah Carter uncovers the plot and, disguised as a novice, joins him to take back their assets. Together, they reclaim their wealth and return to a peaceful life.

kW8EtAl3eC.title: After I Left, She Broke
kW8EtAl3eC.desc: Deaf orphan Noah, starved for love, meets Sophia—who loves him passionately. Before their wedding, he secretly restores his hearing to hear her vows. But he discovers she has been cheating with his assistant Liam—outwardly devoted, secretly craving power and provoking him.

J9c0qmHTDr.title: My Divorce Lawyer Is My Wife
J9c0qmHTDr.desc: Four years ago, Richard fled on his wedding day, leaving bride Nicole. Now he returns, seeking top divorce lawyer Nicole to end his marriage, unaware she's his wife. Nicole doesn't recognize him and takes his case, leading to hilarious encounters as they reunite unknowingly.

gpzVCVg6EE.title: The Secretly Cherished Sinful Wife of Mr. He
gpzVCVg6EE.desc: Ji An's ultimate desire in life was to marry He Chen and bear his children, a love that she was willing to sacrifice her life. Yet, in the end, Ji An, battered and bruised, fell into despair. "He Chen, do you believe that broken mirrors can be mended? In our next life, let's not meet again!"

7RCoJdTd18.title: Prisoner of Love
7RCoJdTd18.desc: Jason, new at Berlin Schwingert High, intrigued Joe. Joe, unaware he fell for a boy, felt drawn to Jason's depth. They discussed freedom and frequented their secret rooftop. Meanwhile, Joe, an avid chess player, bonded with an online opponent, whom he mistakenly assumed was a girl, sharing his feelings with Barron.

fYlAI5Dkfy.title: Mr. Feng, Your Family's Here!
fYlAI5Dkfy.desc: Five years ago, Shen Zhixia and Feng Yu had a one-night stand in a hotel, resulting in the birth of four children. Now, five years later, Shen Zhixia returns with her four children. Meanwhile, Feng Yu, still marked by Shen Zhixia from that night, has been searching for her whereabouts. Fate brings them together again in this heartwarming and emotional tale.

EYdLrLLr2h.title: Bringing Justice to My Mom
EYdLrLLr2h.desc: Tycoon Lucas encounters a madwoman and her daughter Lillian on the streets. She resembles his deceased love Lily and wears an identical ring. Initially he thinks they're frauds, but Lillian begs in the rain. The truth emerges, sparking a storm of reunion, redemption, and revenge.

1Ug7VoSPK2.title: Surviving the No Man's Land(Dubbed)
1Ug7VoSPK2.desc: A desperate college grad needing work gets caught in a revenge plot. Facing dangers and temptations, he encounters all kinds of people. With his principles and sharp mind, he survives, witnessing humanity's extremes, and undergoes a profound transformation.

OLfY6yyvDM.title: Redemption of the Son
OLfY6yyvDM.desc: Once the sole heir to the Chen Group, Chen Yang was betrayed by his scheming stepmother and her son, who drove a wedge between him and his father, forcing him out of the family. After they seized control and drained the family's fortune, his father took his own life in despair. When they come after Chen Yang next, he meets a tragic end—only to be reborn before it all began. This time, he'll stop at nothing to reclaim his mother's legacy and destroy those who tore his family apart.

xx4O8v4qlq.title: A Love That Killed Me Twice
xx4O8v4qlq.desc: Emily loved Michael for years, believing he was hers—until he secretly married another woman. Heartbroken, she gave up on him. When he tried to win her back, she was unmoved—she had died in a crash that night, surviving only by trading her love for a second chance at life.

jopurcGOH9.title: All Along, for You
jopurcGOH9.desc: Su Nian'an and Gu Yanqing, bound by convenience marriage, are both reborn after her tragic death. She seeks divorce, unaware he's also reborn and desperate to win her back. He feigns bankruptcy to stay close while protecting her from Gu Mingze, a vengeful illegitimate family member.

AQIUrKoTPk.title: Reborn: Cinderella's Rise
AQIUrKoTPk.desc: Business legend Emily is framed by a scumbag and reincarnates as Luna, a country girl forced by her stepsister to marry a disabled heir. Despite being scorned, Luna rises in the elite world, takes down her cruel family, defeats her betrayer, and is deeply loved by her husband.

MwihW1h0D5.title: The Substitute Bride Who Became the Cold-Faced CEO's Cure
MwihW1h0D5.desc: The alpha male CEO is plagued by a mysterious illness that strikes with sudden, debilitating attacks, rendering him unable to breathe or move. One fateful night, amidst a severe episode at a dimly lit bar, a girl, unsteady on her feet due to alcohol, accidentally enters his life, marking their first unexpected encounter. Upon waking up, the CEO notices a remarkable improvement in his condition, realizing that the enigmatic girl had somehow played a part in his recovery. Although he couldn't catch a glimpse of her face, he spots a jade pendant she had inadvertently dropped, and promptly sends his assistant on a quest to find its rightful owner. Elsewhere, the girl arrives home to find her mother standing in the hallway's soft glow, upstairs on the landing.

TPHWb74aqN.title: Love Forged in Time, The Heir Returns
TPHWb74aqN.desc: Hua Yao, the 99th descendant of the Hua family, conceals his identity and falls in love with Gu Ran. Upon learning that Gu Ran is pregnant, he decides to reveal his true identity and marry her. However, an accident leaves Hua Yao paralyzed, and he is unable to disclose his background. Gu Ran remains by his side, working hard to care for him and giving birth to their son, Hua Qi. Years later, Hua Yao shows signs of recovery. When Gu Ran goes to visit him, she is humiliated by the director's son and relatives. Hua Yao eventually wakes up and, with the help of his family, seeks revenge on her behalf. Realizing all that Gu Ran has sacrificed for him, Hua Yao decides to give her a grand wedding. However, Gu Ran's relatives strongly oppose, believing Hua Yao has deceived her. In the end, Hua Yao uses his abilities to defeat his enemies, preserve the family business, and successfully marries Gu Ran, leading to a life of happiness.

Ad5aSjoFTI.title: The Hidden Love of Mr. Mo's Wife
Ad5aSjoFTI.desc: Wrongly accused of murder, Zhou Yiran faces an uphill battle to prove her innocence. Brutally beaten and shunned by all, she finds herself entangled in a web of deceit. But little does she know, her fate is soon to intertwine with the enigmatic Mr. Mo, revealing a hidden truth that could change everything.

rC8sOsO1VE.title: Heal Me, Ignite Me
rC8sOsO1VE.desc: By a twist of fate, Su Yin ends up married to Xie Jinyan, the CEO of Xie Group. To fulfill her master's last wish, she visits his room every night to treat his mysterious illness. Xie Jinyan repeatedly rejects her, unaware that Su Yin is the legendary doctor he's been searching for all along.

39RBo9EiX0.title: My Twin Billionaire Husbands
39RBo9EiX0.desc: Heiress Scarlett is forced to marry scarred, crippled tycoon Ryan, deemed a monster by the world. Blindfolded in his mansion, she discovers his tenderness, while his dangerous brother Cole tempts her. Caught between the two men, she fights for love and her father's empire.

0Em9y1Hqz7.title: Wedding Takeover: CEO's Long-Game
0Em9y1Hqz7.desc: Heiress Ye Nansheng hides her identity and works as a delivery rider for three years, helping her fiancé Leng Junheng rise into high society. On the eve of their wedding, she discovers his affair and betrayal, publicly calls off the marriage, reveals who she is, and tears up a billion-dollar deal.

nOUyIyLLra.title: Stolen Life, Cruel Family Secrets
nOUyIyLLra.desc: Fifteen years ago, Gu Chaoyu’s grandmother was brutally killed, and Chaoyu was abducted by human traffickers. Her mute grandfather later found and took in Gu Pancho, a deaf child, and the two have depended on each other ever since. Fifteen years later, Gu Chaoyu is bullied by the arrogant and entitled Gu Pancho. To protect her, her grandfather endures unbearable humiliation and suffering. Everything changes when Gu Chaoyu’s mother suddenly appears, claiming she has been searching for her all these years. But Chaoyu soon discovers the truth: her mother had adopted a boy who resembled her as a replacement — and that boy is none other than Gu Pancho, the very "brother" who wants to humiliate her to death. In that moment, Chaoyu wishes she had never had a mother at all.

f5axdZDAXj.title: My Amnesiac Boy
f5axdZDAXj.desc: The story revolves around Qin Ran, who has been living under a pseudonym and is in a contractual marriage with Bai Jingzhou, the president of the Bai Group, for three years. Due to rumors and misunderstandings, she believes that Bai Jingzhou has always had a the unattainable love in his heart, waiting for that person to return. As a result, throughout the three years of marriage, there has been no progress in their relationship. Qin Ran gradually loses hope in this marriage, and Bai Jingzhou also proposes divorce. Qin Ran decisively chooses to let go, but unexpectedly, on the way to get the divorce certificate the next day, Bai Jingzhou has a car accident and loses part of his memory. When he wakes up in the hospital, he insists that Qin Ran is the person he loves the most.

SGWvbXztIe.title: Vengeance of the Heiress
SGWvbXztIe.desc: At the engagement party of He Yitong, the heiress of the wealthiest family, she was abducted and hit by a truck while desperately trying to escape, leaving her in a vegetative state. Fortunately, Mu Qiubai saved her. During her coma, her soul detached, revealing that the masterminds behind the tragedy were her 20 year best friend and her fiancé. Upon waking, she vowed revenge to reclaim everything stolen from her: her parents' love, envied romance, and bright future. Just as her parents were about to officially adopt Liu Banxue as their daughter, He Yitong made a powerful comeback.

V2JwdyIYfY.title: The Exorcist's Oath: Bloodline Reclaimed
V2JwdyIYfY.desc: The female celestial master descends the mountain to break the calamity of fate, unexpectedly finding her swapped boy and girl twins. Years ago, Xu Ruoyi was framed by her younger sister and tragically lost her babies, but fortunately, she was saved by the celestial master. To resolve the calamity, she descends the mountain seeking answers, determined to reclaim her children and uncover the truth of the past injustices...

8fFwd1F6b4.title: The Low-Key Heir
8fFwd1F6b4.desc: Nine Dragon Group heir Long Haotian is invited to a class reunion. When the butler Jin Duobao offers luxury cars, his father Long Changde advises discretion. Long Haotian chooses his father's old bicycle instead, bringing two bags of homegrown organic vegetables to the gathering.

iXkyKJeDvS.title: Tycoon Swap,My Reversal
iXkyKJeDvS.desc: Financial giant Fu Jingci is poisoned and wakes up to find himself in the body of Bai Zhenxi. Now, he must navigate the challenges of dealing with his stepsister's provocations, the schemes of a despicable man, and the manipulations of a conniving woman. In this new reality, Fu Jingci embraces his inner warrior, taking on all comers and tearing apart the wicked with his sharp wit and courage.

dtudBdg6X5.title: Xiaolin's Fortune Quest
dtudBdg6X5.desc: A college graduate returns home to start a business but is harassed by local gangs. In his backyard, he discovers a rainbow mushroom that grants him special powers. With its help, he defeats the gangs and leads his villagers to prosperity.

1BKDdbMcfs.title: The Healer's Double Life
1BKDdbMcfs.desc: A legendary healer descends to Earth and takes over the body of a comatose man who fell off a cliff. Is he a broken soul or a divine healer? Meanwhile, the heroine’s fiancé seizes the opportunity to try and steal her away. Can the dual-faced healer turn the tide and save the day? A bizarre and captivating story unfolds...

Z3cDV1DCoK.title: The Son's Regret and Revenge
Z3cDV1DCoK.desc: The male protagonist, the world's top martial artist, unknowingly causes his father's death during a competition due to his trust in others. He becomes absorbed in his wife's family, neglecting his parents, and inadvertently misses his father's last chance for survival, leaving his mother devastated. At a celebration hosted by his father-in-law, he learns of his father's death and rushes to the cemetery, only to be prevented from mourning unless he accepts punishment for his past actions. During this time, he uncovers that his father's death is linked to his wife's father and decides to sever ties with her. His wife, trying to save her father, kidnaps his mother. Though guilty, he defeats her, and they divorce. In the end, the protagonist avenges his father, reclaims his martial arts school, reconciles with his mother, and they live peacefully, leaving behind the world of martial arts.

iFToMMXcbg.title: Mrs. CEO Takes Hollywood by Storm
iFToMMXcbg.desc: With her husband Li Yichuan's steadfast support, Lin Qiyue embarks on her journey to become an actress. To bolster her efforts, Li invests ten million in a low-budget film, casting Lin as the lead. During a TV show, he mentions "my wife is in this production," sparking buzz in the media. However, a twist of fate leads the public to mistakenly identify Jiang Yini, the female supporting actor, as Mrs. Li. This misunderstanding results in Lin Qiyue's screen time being drastically reduced, and the originally captivating script is altered beyond recognition. Furthermore, Jiang Yini, who harbors jealousy towards Lin from their college days, exploits her false identity to bully Lin in cahoots with the director and his cronies on the crew. Unwilling to tolerate such misconduct, Lin Qiyue decides to take action and clean up the chaos within the production.

lidJEDNUFV.title: My Nemesis Across Two Lives
lidJEDNUFV.desc: Guard Jon and the Princess escape the rebels but fall into a deadly trap. A time jump thrusts them into the modern world. Now assassin Daniel, as a tycoon, becomes her husband, while Jon serves as her trusted aide. They must face new challenges...

amMKkl9i9c.title: The Underestimated Son-in-Law
amMKkl9i9c.desc: Su Yue, a man with an intellectual disability, marries into the Li family and endures great hardship. His uncle, Su Long, believes he is well cared for and repeatedly sends money—until he discovers Su Yue hasn't eaten for three days, revealing the harsh reality.

2gvagWZt6q.title: Revenge at the Imperial Banquet
2gvagWZt6q.desc: Emily Wilson was framed and killed by her sister Sarah and fiancé at the Emperor's banquet in her past life. Reborn one day before, she gathers evidence of their affair and conspiracy. At the imperial celebration, she's determined to expose their true faces and seek revenge.

4pAjRxVO3o.title: The Nanny Scam
4pAjRxVO3o.desc: Top lawyer Chen Nian has never lost a case since starting her career, but she faces a setback in a nanny fraud case. During the investigation, she discovers that her own father has become the target of the scammers, who plan to marry him and commit insurance fraud. After several failed attempts to stop them and enduring numerous hardships, Chen Nian uses her intelligence and wit to outsmart the fraudulent group. In the end, she successfully sends the fraudulent nanny to prison.

nSuvIJonJn.title: Substitute Bride: Fatal Contract
nSuvIJonJn.desc: The Ji family has a century-old curse: the heir's first bride dies on her wedding night. When the new heir, Ji Rufeng's, bride, Li Qingge, flees before the engagement, Shi Ruanruan, who looks like her, agrees to Li's mother's demand to marry as a substitute to pay for her grandma's medical bills.

Nr8enmL1AB.title: Dark Passion
Nr8enmL1AB.desc: In her past life, Sophia gave up her magic to save her beloved Julian. Reborn as Elena, a farmhand with no memory, fate leads her back to him—now cursed with dark power. As her memories and magic return, Sophia must choose between glory and peace, all for love and herself.

1LDOJQRI06.title: Mommy, Why Does Daddy Hate Me
1LDOJQRI06.desc: To save her husband and son by donating a kidney, the pregnant heroine leaves them behind. Years later, she reunites with her now-wealthy husband, only to find that another woman has claimed credit for her sacrifice and manipulated her son into bullying her and her daughter over their status.

s4FBLx3FOt.title: Mobster's Cinderella
s4FBLx3FOt.desc: Frank saves Angela from a bully and finds that she looks like his late lover, Kelly. They both fall in love at first sight. Angela feels disheartened and runs away from Frank when she learns she is just a substitute for Kelly. Will Angela grant Frank a second chance? Will Frank realize his true love?

WVPN6xxd5g.title: The Master in Disguise
WVPN6xxd5g.desc: Xuan Sect Young Master Ye Chen loses his powers while saving his fated lover, Xu Yao, and becomes the Xu family's ridiculed "fool" son-in-law. When they force Xu Yao to remarry, his powers return. Remembering her care, he keeps playing the fool to protect her and toy with those who scorned them.

unO42b92G8.title: Revenge of the Wronged Wife
unO42b92G8.desc: Ge Yuan and Zhou Cheng have been childless for years. Her mother-in-law, obsessed with superstitions, believes that using realgar wine and silver needles can help her conceive a boy, setting the stage for tragedy. Ge Yuan endures long-term domestic abuse, silently bearing the pain in the name of family harmony. Zhou Cheng has an affair with Shen Manman, and together they plot to swap her medication, causing Ge Yuan's mental breakdown. A hospital checkup reveals the truth, and Ge Yuan decides to fight back. She exploits her mother-in-law's superstitions and Zhou Cheng's paranoid nature to sow distrust between the two. With intelligence and composure, Ge Yuan successfully exposes the conspiracy, making Zhou Cheng and Shen Manman pay the price. In the end, she frees herself from the past, reclaiming her life and embracing a new beginning.

8f869wuZz7.title: The Lady Boss's Love Lessons
8f869wuZz7.desc: After breaking up with her ex-boyfriend, Gu Ruo encountered Lin Bai, a handsome young man. She bravely confessed her love to Lin Bai. However, Lin Bai felt a bit hesitant in front of Gu Ruo, who had achieved great success in her career. After being rejected by him, Gu Ruo still helped him a lot. After going through difficulties, they finally confirmed their love relationship and became the people who trusted each other forever.

EUdgbZLSh3.title: Pretending to Be His Runaway Bride
EUdgbZLSh3.desc: Liu Ziyue's father, Liu Jianguo, deceives the richest man in Jiangzhou, Zhang Zheyuan, out of 5 million dollars, and the father and daughter are pursued by debt collectors. During one of their escapes, Liu Ziyue is mistaken by Zhang Zheyuan's sister, Zhang Qiang, for Su Qingqing, the woman who was once his first love and is now allegedly running away from marriage. Liu Ziyue notices that she and Su Qingqing look alike on the marriage certificate, so she decides to impersonate Su Qingqing and stay by Zhang Zheyuan's side, hoping he will forgive her father. She comes close to revealing the truth several times but cleverly manages to cover it up. Everything changes when the real Su Qingqing returns—only to find she has had cosmetic surgery. The wheels of fate begin to turn…

AAzf4ZgaUf.title: This Time, He Strikes First
AAzf4ZgaUf.desc: In the 1980s, Ethan secretly loves the director's daughter Sophia. Tricked into saving her, he's falsely accused of rape by Sophia, who wants to cover for Brock, ruining him. Reborn to that night, Ethan exposes them, reverses his fate, and finds true love.

WpDLQ6FtHD.title: Mommy Takes Her Life Back
WpDLQ6FtHD.desc: Framed by her half-sister Zhou Qiaomei, Zhou Mu got pregnant and lost her child. Five years later, she returns as Zhao Linlin, meeting her son, Zhao Linlin, and Chen Yixuan, heir to the Chen Group. She uses Chen Yixuan's love to spite Zhou Qiaomei, while she avenges her mother.

3toDLT8D9f.title: Forsaken After His Ascension
3toDLT8D9f.desc: Serena Frost gave her ascension pill to Dorian Perry, fell to the mortal realm, bore him a gifted son, and devoted her life to him. After ascending, he abandoned her. She reached the immortal realm seeking him, only to be bound to the Execution Platform and watch her son order her execution.

p6IYCJ7IP8.title: Hidden Strength
p6IYCJ7IP8.desc: After the power struggle, Shen Luo was severely injured and saved by Su Wan. He stayed at the Su family for five years, recovering and quietly biding his time, preparing for revenge. However, at a birthday banquet for his wife, the carefully prepared birthday gift he had chosen for her was mistaken for a fake. Even the hundreds of billions of funds he had arranged for her were dismissed as lies. This led Shen Luo to start peeling off his layers of disguise, one by one.

lbveD7zvk3.title: The Ultimate Cultivation
lbveD7zvk3.desc: A hundred thousand years ago, Zhang Fan single-handedly defeated the Ten Great Barbarian Gods, wrote the Nine Heavens Law, and became the Creator God of the Nine Provinces. After bestowing the title of Emperor upon his ten followers, including the future Qing Emperor, Human Emperor, and Demon Emperor, he declared his retreat and fell into a deep slumber. A hundred thousand years later, Zhang Fan awakens, but before he can regain his strength, the attacks from the immortals come one after another.

v1dBOL1Ya6.title: Kicked the Trash, Chose My Life
v1dBOL1Ya6.desc: The heroine married a scumbag; he stole her college spot for his first love and secretly supported his first love for 50 years. After his death, he left everything to his first love's daughter. Reborn, she secretly keeps her college spot, ditches the wedding, and starts fresh.

8hzACgCGp2.title: Trapped in Deep Affection
8hzACgCGp2.desc: Song Yuan is brought to the Jiang family villa by Jiang Xingyun to meet Shen Meiyan (Chairman of Mingda Group and mother of Jiang Zhaoyun). Shen Meiyan offers Song Yuan 5 million to seduce her son, Jiang Zhaoyun, who aspires to be an artist. For her mother's medical bills and the Song family's debts, Song Yuan agrees but demands 10 million. After obtaining Jiang Zhaoyun's information from Shen Meiyan, Song Yuan crafts a perfect 'chance encounter' plan, successfully making Jiang Zhaoyun fall for her at first sight. As their love deepens, Shen Meiyan appears, reminding Song Yuan to end the game. Thinking it's over, Song Yuan is devastated when her mother commits suicide out of guilt. Shen Meiyan, fearing further contact between Song Yuan and Jiang Zhaoyun, suppresses Song Yuan's career opportunities. Despite her prestigious education, Song Yuan can only find work as a lowly assistant in an entertainment company. Meanwhile, she hides from Jiang Zhaoyun for two years, until he finally finds her. Jiang Zhaoyun forcefully marries Song Yuan, but their relationship improves over time. However, Shen Meiyan reveals to Song Yuan that she was behind her father's death and the Song family's house fire, and that Jiang Zhaoyun knew all along. Devastated, Song Yuan confronts Jiang Zhaoyun and asks for a divorce. Jiang Zhaoyun, in turn, decides to seek justice for Song Yuan.

v1XyVYMGi6.title: The Consort's Strategy
v1XyVYMGi6.desc: Jiang Qianyu replaced Shen Mingzhu to enter the palace as a concubine, beginning her life within the palace walls. Many years later, now a noble consort, Jiang Qianyu gazes at the sky. She recalls how she once entered the palace in place of Shen Mingzhu, fighting and scheming only to rescue her sister from the cold palace. But now that her sister is dead, she must continue to struggle. For in the depths of this palace, it's a battle to survive—go against the current, or be swept away.

1YWw35ZX19.title: Mistaken Bride: Heart of a Prince
1YWw35ZX19.desc: Neglected Yun Ni is arranged to replace her sister and marry the deposed Crown Prince Xiao Jingze. He treats her cruelly out of resentment toward her adoptive father. Realizing he is not truly evil, the skilled Yun Ni decides to help him reclaim the throne in exchange for her freedom.

2WNb8WIvTn.title: Love in the Darkness
2WNb8WIvTn.desc: After her father's brutal murder, Emma becomes a target when she digs into the truth. Caught in the crosshairs, a bodyguard named Liam steps in to save her. Emma, blind but razor-sharp, senses Liam's connection to her father's death. A deadly conspiracy unfolds, and time is running out.

MMjseQz0C9.title: Code of Desire
MMjseQz0C9.desc: Hacker Jiang Li, implicated in a murder and an inheritance dispute, faces the real culprit seven years later when they kill her father and critically injure her mother. To cover medical bills, she teams up with Zhou's second son to get close to the eldest heir and uncover a greater secret.

7jOU0MCDNm.title: No Love, Only Empire
7jOU0MCDNm.desc: Time-traveler Princess Su Yuci spends ten years building her husband Jiang Chenyuan into a business tycoon and donates her kidney to him. He betrays her with his mistress and illegitimate son at her sister's engagement party. She orchestrates his downfall and returns to her era victorious.

okRoLPUw5N.title: Believing in Love Again
okRoLPUw5N.desc: Zhou Ruoyu is drugged by her scumbag husband Luo Haibin and sent to billionaire Gu Jingdong's bed. Unaware she's his unforgettable love, after the night, she becomes pregnant. As Luo Haibin and her family abuse her and threaten her, Gu Jingdong rushes to her rescue after learning the truth.

glSRjMJLob.title: If I were born to be a debtor
glSRjMJLob.desc: Once, Cheng Hao sacrificed his love for his career and achieved fame and fortune. But soon after, he was diagnosed with a terminal illness. As his life ebbed away, he was unexpectedly given a second chance to return to the year 1998. This time, he embarks on a thrilling journey of self-redemption, determined to make amends for his past mistakes and carve out a different destiny for himself.

6JMPvXnkCO.title: Doomsday: I Become the Savior
6JMPvXnkCO.desc: In 2035, the fifth month of the apocalypse, as his family members turned into zombies one by one, a desperate Li Yuan pulled the trigger on himself. However, he didn't die. When he opened his eyes again, Li Yuan found himself back on the tenth day before the apocalypse began. In the living room, he was reunited with his parents and the Cui family, who had come to discuss the bride price.

8Obh6upWXR.title: Oops, My 99 Exes Reborn
8Obh6upWXR.desc: Ethan, an actor, is thrust into his short drama as the villain—a heartless playboy with 99 exes—and is fated to die. At the aptitude test, he hears his childhood sweetheart Sophia’s thoughts: reincarnated from a past life, she’ll kill him the instant he tries to dump her publicly again.

94GxR4aJ3C.title: Deadly Favoritism(Dubbed)
94GxR4aJ3C.desc: Emily Green, a surgeon, favors her adopted son Thomas over her biological son Daniel. After Thomas injures Daniel in a car accident, Daniel signs a kidney donation agreement that Thomas secretly alters. Emily performs a heart transplant for Thomas—unaware it's her own son's heart...

2lVmMmyqW2.title: The Ultimate Bone's Legacy
2lVmMmyqW2.desc: Born the eldest son of the Dragon Palace, Long Yao fears for his crown due to his half-brother Long Teng's rare Ultimate Bone. Desperate, he threatens Long Teng's mother's life to claim the bone. With the Dragon King in retreat and no help in sight, Long Teng is forced to comply. But Long Yao betrays him, taking his mother's life, erasing his memories, and casting him into the mortal world.

Qw6s5iUf0i.title: Beyond the Cloud
Qw6s5iUf0i.desc: Ye Wushang accidentally enters the immortal realm, but due to unfinished karma with his childhood sweetheart, Zhang Tongtong, who remained on Earth, he returns to Blue Star to resolve their fate. However, he discovers that everything has changed—Zhang Tongtong has long since passed away. To settle the unfinished business, Ye Wushang searches for her reincarnation to fulfill their karmic debt.

vDLV5B8Z85.title: Queen of Law: Sweet Reign
vDLV5B8Z85.desc: Law queen Shen Nanfeng returns to the country, wins her first case, and is celebrated by her powerful CEO husband, Fu Beichen, who even buys her a law firm. At the welcoming banquet, Shen Chengshuang steals the spotlight, falsely claiming to be the CEO's wife. After being exposed, she continues to fake her way into the roles of top lawyer and heiress—until the truth finally catches up with her.

dBGvtoTMZY.title: Marriage at a Breaking Point
dBGvtoTMZY.desc: After marrying Li Jia, kind-hearted Wang Hao finds his mother-in-law difficult, his brother-in-law lazy, and his wife overly obedient to her family. Patient at first, he eventually can't endure the family conflicts and begins to turn his life around.

lkbB2VP5fw.title: CEO Dad, Meet Your Wife
lkbB2VP5fw.desc: After her family's bankruptcy and a broken engagement to Lu Linchuan, Shen Huan had a one-night stand with Bo Yehan. Six years later, she returns with her son Xiaotian, who appears on a TV show seeking a spouse for her, leading to her marriage with Bo Yehan. She pursues revenge while finding love.

lLU974nt2M.title: Sue's God of War wife is not to be messed with
lLU974nt2M.desc: Heaven's warrior goddess possesses meek wife Bai Xiyue. Finding her "playboy" husband Su Yicheng isn't what he seems, they grow from adversaries to lovers, making her choose mortal love over godhood.

iXl6ELpAZ1.title: Betrayed by Love and Lies
iXl6ELpAZ1.desc: Lin Tao discovers his wife, Fang Jingjing, has acute leukemia, but when they desperately need money for her treatment, she blindly trusts the charming conman, Song Shaoyu, giving away all their savings. Lin Tao, fearing the truth will make her illness worse, lies and says he's the one with cancer, hoping to get the money back. But Fang Jingjing, manipulated by Song Shaoyu, joins her parents in belittling him. Lin Tao goes to confront Song Shaoyu, only to uncover a shocking affair. Desperate to keep their family intact, Lin Tao swallows his pride, but Fang Jingjing remains oblivious, even after learning the truth. When Song Shaoyu turns the tables on them, their world unravels as a dangerous loan shark bursts into their home, bringing the ultimate test of survival.

eZgjk2rCOH.title: Wishing You a Life Without Me
eZgjk2rCOH.desc: Young Xie Linyuan was full of ambition and devotion to Lu Zhaozhao. They studied and started businesses together, pledging lifelong love. But time changed everything. When a decade-old love turns into a blade, who will feel the deeper wound?

ePzVMxkwoR.title: Spoiled By My Three Brothers After Divorce
ePzVMxkwoR.desc: After a bitter divorce, Gu Wanqing returns to her wealthy family, only to find herself caught in an unexpected whirlwind of emotions. As she navigates her new life as the Gu family heiress, her relationship with her protective older brother, Gu Huai'an, takes an intriguing turn. Meanwhile, her ex-husband's desperate attempts to win her back and a childhood friend's unwavering support add to the complexity of her journey. Amidst family drama, revenge plots, and blossoming feelings, Gu Wanqing must confront her past and decide her future in this gripping tale of love, loyalty, and self-discovery.

4rTqYsdDNd.title: My Husband Comes from Outer Space
4rTqYsdDNd.desc: Qian Yuchu, an explorer from planet Hacker, falls in love with Earth girl Chu Yu'er. Pursued by his law-enforcing brother, Qian Siqi, Chu sacrifices herself to save Qian. 500 years later, Qian finds Mu Xiaoman, Chu's reincarnation. To win her heart, the cunning Qian fakes a life-threatening injury. As Mu's forgotten memories resurface, she agrees to be his contract girlfriend. Facing dangers and hostility, Mu always finds Qian by her side. Guilt-ridden yet devoted, Qian's love for Mu grows increasingly passionate and unrestrained.

sx3IK0y0ae.title: The Vengeful Relative in Disguise
sx3IK0y0ae.desc: Heiress Luo Ziming's life collapsed: husband Gu Yanchen & half-sister Xia Yueqi betrayed her, ruining reputation & face. Disappeared, years later returned as Gu's mysterious rich relative. With friend Gu Feifei, vows revenge & rebirth.

yTxGqNg3UR.title: Reclaim the Throne With the Princess
yTxGqNg3UR.desc: Reborn after betrayal, Sophia Walker, daughter of the Minister of Revenue, allies with Princess Charlotte Scott to seek revenge against the third prince, Oliver Scott, and uncover the truth behind her family's death. They discover the crown prince's demise may be hiding darker secrets.

HngOp7mXUR.title: When Love Finds Its Way Back
HngOp7mXUR.desc: Huo Sihan and Fang Wan fell in love young, but she left him to save him from brain cancer and secretly gave birth to Niannian. 5 years later, Fang Wan became comatose. Niannian begs on the streets while Huo Sihan, now the city's richest man, searches for Fang Wan citywide until they reunite.

tsxwrOBY8s.title: Emperor Regrets Sending Me Away
tsxwrOBY8s.desc: After Emma's mother dies, her father takes a concubine who bears Sophia. Emma chooses Ethan as her guard and falls for him, but he avoids her. She discovers he's the emperor, serving as a guard only to get close to Sophia. Forced to marry into a neighboring kingdom, Emma lets go of her love.

j9wd6xi19q.title: Fallen Angel：Treasure Huntress Steals Her Victim's Heart
j9wd6xi19q.desc: Controlled by Viper, a crime organization, with a lethal chip planted in her brain, Agent Bertha goes to steal a legendary diamond ring at the wedding of Edward, the richest man in the nation. She surprisingly walks in on Wilde, Edward's best friend, making out with Cynthia, the bride. Just when she think she's busted by Edward, who comes in right after her, Edward gets furious at the adultery and declares he will marry Bertha instead...

Fog2cfgZFw.title: Reigning Sovereign of the Realm
Fog2cfgZFw.desc: Abandoned by his father, the young War Emperor and his sister follow their mother to the East Sea in search of a livelihood. Tragedy strikes when his mother is framed and forced to commit suicide. On the brink of death, a mysterious figure saves him and enrolls him in the military. Over ten years of bloody battles, he rises from a humble border soldier to the mighty War Wing God-King, wielding immense power. Leading his iron-clad cavalry, he sweeps through the borders, guards his homeland, drives out the barbarians, and earns unparalleled glory. Decades later, a royal summons brings him back to the capital for a performance review, granting him the chance to make his enemies tremble. The families who murdered his mother, led by the Chen and Sun clans and headed by Shangguan Nalan, will quake in fear.

aST4Hb3MJ6.title: Under One Roof, Double Love Story
aST4Hb3MJ6.desc: Fleeing her sister's abuser, Charlotte Wright meets mercenary Noah Moore. After a one-night stand leaves her pregnant, he proposes marriage. As they live together, she wins his heart, while Noah's brother falls for Charlotte's sister. Through trials and danger, both couples find happiness.

olkHw9UfYS.title: The Phantom CEO and the Private Room Romance with Yan Qingyue
olkHw9UfYS.desc: Yun Sheng divorces missing Chu Ming on 4th anniversary, starts new life with elite Yan Qingyue。Chu returns harassing, Yan's identity causes misunderstandings。Chu frames Yan family heartbreaking Yun。After Yan cleared, reconcile。Chu jailed, Yun demands proper courtship。Overcome trials to unite

aRqDjb6LHU.title: Vengeance Wears Her Face
aRqDjb6LHU.desc: To marry Pei Heng, Tan Lening poisons her bestie Shen Qingruo and steals poor girl Tong Xin’s chance at an education. As she’s dying, Qingruo saves the disfigured Tong Xin by giving her a new face and a billionaire identity. Now, as Qingruo, Tong Xin seeks revenge—starting at Lening’s party.

JBUGMU5xrf.title: The Modern Emperor's Revolution
JBUGMU5xrf.desc: The genius teenager Qin Huai transmigrates into the tyrannical emperor of the Great Xia, despised by all. With treacherous ministers scheming ahead and enemy nations invading from behind, it seems as if heaven wants him dead. But if fate seeks to destroy him, he'll use his modern knowledge to pierce through the heavens...Eradicating corrupt officials, crushing enemy nations, Qin Huai claims his beauties and forges a glorious empire!

8t7ui6rjW4.title: Charming Bodyguard, Wheelchair Boss
8t7ui6rjW4.desc: Bodyguard Emily (Amanda) clashes with wheelchair-bound Michael. As they grow closer, a ten-year-old misunderstanding creates a trust crisis. Caught in family conspiracies, love, and revenge, they struggle until truth emerges, leading to reconciliation.

KMipbxuOUH.title: Spoiled by Her Real Family
KMipbxuOUH.desc: Raised as a Shen for 20 years, Lin Yuxin is ousted when the true heiress, Shen Kerou, arrives. Facing betrayal, she finds her real family, exposes Shen Kerou's schemes with Ji Chuxu's help, and discovers that she's the daughter of Beishi's richest man, finding love and justice.

TkkrOs4966.title: The Mafia King Wants Me
TkkrOs4966.desc: Elena goes to New York to save her grandma but ends up saving mafia king Draven. Her father sells her off, and childhood crush Owen betrays her. Desperate, she makes a deal: marry Draven to save her grandma. Amid love and danger, she learns the man who won't let her go once saved her life.

ffXaY56ciw.title: Falling by Design
ffXaY56ciw.desc: Huo Mingxiu, ruined in his previous life by Zhou Yueyue, the Zhou family, and Wen Dongcheng, is reborn and vows revenge. With Bai Anning, he exposes schemes, cancels a wedding, topples the Zhou family and Wen Corporation, and rises as a business magnate. Eventually, he reunites with Bai Anning.

ahRcVgJbY6.title: She Was Never Just His Wife
ahRcVgJbY6.desc: Orphaned at ten, Yang Lihua was saved by Zhang Yaozhu. She became the Crimson Flame War God and helped him succeed, but he cast her aside for his first love. She exposes her identity and bankrupts him. His son's scheme backfires fatally. She finds love with Song Jiyuan.

x9zc1Y1lhg.title: The Ugly Wife's Glamorous Return
x9zc1Y1lhg.desc: Li Xingyue is betrayed by her father and stepsister, losing her memory and having her appearance destroyed. However, on her wedding day, she regains her memory and pretends to be foolish in order to seek revenge on her fiancé and stepsister. Gu Mohan, mistakenly brought to the wedding by his grandmother, is thought to be the groom. As they spend time together after their marriage, Gu Mohan notices that the necklace she wears is connected to a girl he once saved in his childhood, the one he had always considered his first love.

JXjRhiUufm.title: Hacking the Crime Machine
JXjRhiUufm.desc: Programmer Yang Ye is betrayed by his girlfriend, Fang Rou, into Myanmar drug lord Cha Cai's trap. He allies with tycoon Uncle Li and officer Ye Lin, infiltrates using his tech skills, exposes Fang Rou, and escapes to dismantle Cha Cai's empire before starting anew with Ye Lin.

6nMzafaIa3.title: His True Love in the Delivery Room
6nMzafaIa3.desc: Lin Mo, the grandson of the head of the most powerful Lin family in the country, had no knowledge of his true identity and lived like an orphan. One night, after getting drunk, he saved the most popular girl on campus, Su Yuting. To resist the arranged marriage with the Lin family, Su Yuting had a one-night stand with Lin Mo. However, Lin Mo, drunk, forgot about it. Later, Lin Mo started dating Chen Xiaotong, but their relationship ended when she met a wealthy heir, Gu Pengfei. When Lin Mo confronted them, he received a call from Su Yuting, who revealed that she was about to have his child. Lin Mo rushed to the hospital and took care of Su Yuting, but they were maliciously attacked by Chen Xiaotong and Gu Pengfei. To protect his wife and child, Lin Mo was severely injured. Ultimately, the old Lin family patriarch appeared in time to help Lin Mo fight back, and Chen Xiaotong and Gu Pengfei received their just punishment.

cCi7WrOhwX.title: My Taboo Crush on My Stepbrother
cCi7WrOhwX.desc: Rebellious heir Aiden and spirited Vivian become step-siblings. From rivalry to a passionate entanglement, they navigate forbidden love amid family trauma, societal pressure, and school bullying.

2r53HRWiZF.title: Seducing My Sister's Boyfriend
2r53HRWiZF.desc: Anna has successfully seduced her sister’s boyfriend. They kiss, they hug, and they prepare for rough sex in the car in the wilderness. But just as the boy is about to fall in love, Anna pulls out a knife and slits his throat. The boy asks why she did this, and Anna replies, "My sister died tragically because of you, so now you’ll rot in hell for me!

MK59lT3RLO.title: The Veiled Heir
MK59lT3RLO.desc: Lin Tian, the heir to the richest family in Southland, is betrayed by his younger brother on the day he's meant to take over the family empire. Pushed off a cliff, he survives but loses his memory, ending up as a beggar on the streets. One night, he comes to the aid of Han Ruoxue, the daughter of a street vendor, when she's harassed by thugs, unknowingly setting the stage for his life to take an unexpected turn.

oEQe08ChFS.title: Mom, My Dad's the CEO
oEQe08ChFS.desc: Shen Qinghe, the only son of the wealthiest family in Beicheng, leaves his engagement party with Song Yue, the daughter of the Song family. He disguises himself as a poor man and joins Song Ting and her children, and they start selling fish together. During their time together, Song Ting discovers the birthmark from an old injury on Shen Qinghe, realizing that he is the man responsible for her unexpected pregnancy. Feeling deceived, she kicks him out. Soon after, Shen Qinghe holds a press conference to apologize, and in the end, the two find happiness together.

7jH2rB8AnZ.title: Behind the Spotlight, Beside My Lawyer
7jH2rB8AnZ.desc: Commoner Jiang Youwei climbs the entertainment industry with her stunning looks, becoming a celebrated actress. Pressured to entertain clients, she leaves the industry but faces threats. Meeting her long-time crush, Qi Yue, now a famous lawyer, she gradually overcomes her struggles with his help.

R0HzA00Uuc.title: The Billionaire's Exclusive Maid(Dubbed)
R0HzA00Uuc.desc: Emma, desperate to pay her brother's hospital bills, is drawn into the orbit of Ethan. By chance, she becomes the Walker family's maid. As fate turns, the eldest son Ethan shows ambiguous affection toward her and wants her as his personal maid, while the second son also confesses his love.

d6aJOzS4Fr.title: Mafia Princess Kicks Ass on Christmas
d6aJOzS4Fr.desc: Mafia princess Lucia Capello, secretly trained by her grandfather for three years, returns home at Christmas to discover that “Mrs. Capello” is an impostor—her real mother has been humiliated. Alone, Lucia takes on everyone, reclaims her family’s power, and finds love with her quiet protector, Noah.

2ZHfYQJPVl.title: Love Found Us Again
2ZHfYQJPVl.desc: Gu Jingdong, heir of the Gu Group, reunites with Zhou Ruoyu, a single mother who once captured his heart, after twenty years. Seeing her humiliated, he protects her from family greed and her ex, enters a contract marriage, and through trials and love, pledges lifelong devotion.

0dNE15AVM5.title: Unmatched Heroine in War
0dNE15AVM5.desc: Reborn genius Ning Wushuang refused marriage to protect her mother, Ning Yun. She won the clan tournament, fought disguised as a man, and befriended Prince Qi Zhaoyu. After her mother's death and Qi Zhaoyu's injury, she broke through, avenged Ning Yun, and shattered gender bias.

RheAptky5Y.title: Christmas Love Tangle
RheAptky5Y.desc: June and Jim are a pair of betrothed individuals who have never met. Due to the matchmaking oftheir elders, the two, who were originally prepared to call off the engagement, ended up sharinganightofpleasure.June, fearingembarrassment, fled without gettingagoodlookatherpartner.Meanwhile, Jim, finding a resume belonging to June's best friend Penny, mistakenlyidentified his fiancée as Penny. At the same time, Jim became June's boss and selected her as hisassistant.Penny, fearing that her impersonation of June's fiancée would be exposed, launched aseries of targeted incidents against June. The intricate relationships among the three unfold thisconvoluted and coincidental story. Fortunately, true lovers eventually find their way to eachother. In the end, Jim and June discover the truth and fall in love genuinely, eventually marryingeach other.

ui7LMKXGHQ.title: Caged In Love
ui7LMKXGHQ.desc: Boss, I'm tired, please leave me alone! It's been three years, and this debt should be paid off. I'm tired, don't bother me!

9Xj7L3z7Jn.title: The Dragon Fox’s Secret
9Xj7L3z7Jn.desc: In a world where demons and humans coexist, Bai Chuqi forms a contract with the demon Lan'er to fight evil. However, he discovers Lan'er is working for the Minghe Old Ancestor. As the heir to seal this dark power, Bai Chuqi must face the truth and fight to save the world.

Vx9WRWLZ0i.title: The Princess Reclaims Her Name
Vx9WRWLZ0i.desc: Bi Mo is the emperor's lost daughter. But neighbor A Yao steals her identity, and she dies by the sword. Reborn, she vows to change her fate, but A Yao strikes again. Facing death, Consort Wan saves her. Bi Mo and Consort Wan investigate together, reveal the truth, and reclaim what's hers.

rDgaUQ2suh.title: Qin Yu's Math Ascension
rDgaUQ2suh.desc: An inspiring short drama follows Qin Yu, an orphaned vocational student bullied by family and expelled from her village. Undeterred, she pursues her love for math, rises with her teachers' guidance, and conquers global competitions—leaving those who wronged her filled with regret.

iDnvIKaJEI.title: I Am Ye Fan
iDnvIKaJEI.desc: A modern-day expert in ancient scripts accidentally travels to a fantastical world during an excavation of an ancient tomb. In this world, cultivation is surprisingly simple: anyone who can recognize ancient celestial characters gains the corresponding powers. The protagonist, widely regarded as a failure, is on the verge of being expelled from their sect. However, at this critical moment, the protagonist realizes that the legendary ancient celestial script is actually just the modern-day Small Seal script. With this discovery, the protagonist's unexpected skill catches everyone by surprise, shutting down those who sought to expel them.

1u3W5SE7mv.title: Guarded by Mother's Love
1u3W5SE7mv.desc: Tang Juan and Su Jinrou are half-sisters. Tang Juan, resentful of being the child of a mistress, plots a car accident to switch her daughter with Su Jinrou's daughter. After the accident, Su Jinrou becomes a vegetative state, but her consciousness exists outside her body, powerless to stop her daughter from facing a tragic fate. Seven years later, Su Jinrou's daughter, Xiao Yu, suffers cruel treatment at the Tao Yong family’s hands, while Tang Juan remains heartless, even attempting to harm Xiao Yu to preserve her own daughter, Xichen's, privileged status. Tang Juan also manipulates a paternity test and kidnaps both children, forcing Gu Yunting to choose. Su Jinrou’s soul desperately protects Xiao Yu. Miraculously, Su Jinrou awakens, stops Tang Juan’s evil actions, and both Tang Juan and Tao Yong are punished. Ten years later, Xiao Yu grows up strong, while Xichen suffers from cognitive impairment due to family turmoil.

6YDrE8EX8H.title: No More Sacrifices, Diva Returns
6YDrE8EX8H.desc: Masked singing star Wen Youning quit six years ago to marry Fu Yanli after he suddenly lost his sight. When he regained vision, a new woman appeared, revealing Wen Youning's sacrifices were in vain. Heartbroken, she divorces and returns to the stage—while Fu Yanli deeply regrets.

mcDqUEfsyA.title: I'm Not a Fortune Heir
mcDqUEfsyA.desc: When Xu Feng, the wealthiest man in Jiangcheng, passes away without any heirs, his second wife, Su Qing, steps in as the interim president of his conglomerate. However, due to her humble background and being Xu Feng's second wife, the board members of the group refuse to acknowledge her and eye the Xu family's fortune with greed. To secure the Xu family's assets, Su Qing hires someone to pose as Xu Feng's illegitimate son. Coincidentally, Gao Yang, who looks exactly like Xu Feng, comes to the Xu family for help. Su Qing offers Gao Yang the role of the pretend heir, promising him unlimited spending during the contract period and a staggering reward of one hundred million yuan upon completion. Tempted by the lucrative offer, Gao Yang agrees and signs the contract, embarking on a one-month journey to experience life as a rich kid.

MvwFwbJBii.title: A Melody of Heartbreak
MvwFwbJBii.desc: Lin Huai, with an extraordinary musical talent, was accepted into the Royal Conservatory of Music alongside his girlfriend, Gu Nian. However, just as they were starting their journey, Gu Nian's family went bankrupt. To help her pay off her debts, Lin Huai made the decisive choice to abandon his studies, working tirelessly every day to support her education and repay the money. On their tenth wedding anniversary, Lin Huai went to the Paris Opera House alone, playing the piano for three months, hoping that the renowned master Lang Lang would hear a piano piece composed by Gu Nian, his beloved. Eventually, Lin Huai's exceptional musical ability convinced Lang Lang to accept Gu Nian into his studio. Eager to share the good news with his wife, Lin Huai rushed home, only to accidentally catch her kissing another man, Su Han.

QPFvaaZOHN.title: Unspoken Hearts
QPFvaaZOHN.desc: Wen Shuyu and Qi Shilin have liked each other since childhood, but Wen Shuyu always thought Qi Shilin liked Lin Si. After growing up, they accidentally have a flash marriage, but neither of them expresses their feelings. Wen Shuyu starts working at Qi Corporation and is repeatedly bullied by Lin Si and others. Fortunately, Qi Shilin appears just in time to protect Wen Shuyu. In the end, the truth comes out, and they confess their feelings for each other.

8hUHVLi9PE.title: Get Fired, Get Rich
8hUHVLi9PE.desc: To save her grandma, Wei Ting needs money, but her boss withholds her pay. A "Get Fired System" offers cash rewards. She gets fired, then targets Xu Group for another. But her kindness gets her hired, and every scheme to get fired brings promotions instead—until she proposes to CEO Xu publicly.

zuXpRDGaFh.title: Falling for Her Bodyguard
zuXpRDGaFh.desc: Fearless news anchor Colette uncovers a deadly secret and becomes a target. Her only protector is Luke, a top agent—and her ex who once broke her heart. Forced to survive together amid danger and buried emotions, their rekindled passion might be their only hope—or deadliest gamble.

kiYo4LOi5M.title: A Bright New Life
kiYo4LOi5M.desc: Xu Shuyao was once a rich young lady, pampered like a princess after marrying Lin Yichen, the CEO of a listed company. However, on the day she gave birth, her husband, Lin Yichen, tragically died in a car accident. For the next year, Xu Shuyao lived in endless sorrow, until she met Li Zhiwei, who treated her and her son, Yangyang, with genuine care. Five years later, in order for Yangyang to grow up in a healthy family with a father, Xu Shuyao married Li Zhiwei. One day, as she was about to take her son out, Xu Shuyao returned home to fetch her forgotten phone and accidentally overheard a phone conversation between Li Zhiwei and a stranger. To her shock, she discovered that Li Zhiwei was the one who had masterminded the murder of Lin Yichen.

vKIywZyXNc.title: Reborn: The Avenger Girl
vKIywZyXNc.desc: Zhu Xiaoxuan suffered relentless bullying at an elite school, all because she crossed Chen Xuanyue, the Chen Group heiress. Her family paid the price: her foster mother fled, and her debt-ridden father attempted suicide, leaving him in a vegetative state. After a decade of torment, her father succumbed to illness, leaving her destitute. In despair, she took her own life. Miraculously, she's reborn as Chen Xuanyue's nemesis, Chen Xuanya, ten years in the past. There, she discovers that her past self also met a tragic end by suicide, and the Chen family callously covered it up, murdering her parents. Now armed with this knowledge, she vows to abandon her former passivity, and instead meticulously plans a ruthless revenge, determined to dismantle the Chen family piece by piece.

3zufDRVJIw.title: No More Sacrifice for My Brother
3zufDRVJIw.desc: Brainwashed to serve her brother, Li Shan sacrificed her own family until her kin discarded and killed her. Now reborn, she severs ties with her toxic family, protects her daughter, and restores her marriage. Finally, Li Shan ensures her greedy relatives pay for their crimes.

y1pFRjv61H.title: A Map of Kindness at Night
y1pFRjv61H.desc: Delivery rider Cheng Ye joins Night Walker Program to save his critically ill mother. Completing special orders, such as rescuing a lost girl, fulfilling a 40-year love promise, and looking for a lost pet, he earns rewards. When he hits rock bottom, the people he helped return to support him.

DMuglWwLQe.title: Knocked by Fortune
DMuglWwLQe.desc: Xue Yan, once a rising star in the business world, lost everything overnight—his wealth, status, and reputation wiped out in an instant. At his lowest point, two enigmatic Gods of Wealth appear, offering him a chance to reclaim his life. But their true motives remain unclear. Will Xue Yan rise from the ashes, or is his fate sealed forever?

bkdxudz0M0.title: Mommy's Secret, Daddy's Love
bkdxudz0M0.desc: Xu Qinghuan gives birth to a child in the hospital, but her sister Xu Yanxi deceives her, claiming the baby was a stillbirth, and spreads rumors that Xu Qinghuan is pregnant out of wedlock. This leads to gossip, and the family faces public disgrace. To avoid further scandal, the family plans to send Xu Qinghuan abroad. Meanwhile, Xu Yanxi uses Xu Qinghuan's child to secure her position as the future Mrs. Mo, the most envied woman in the city. Four years later, Xu Qinghuan returns to the country quietly for business. She narrowly escapes an assault from Boss Li, but in a twist of fate, she runs into her son, An An, whom she thought she lost. Mo Jingyuan, the male lead, is looking for his son and meets Xu Qinghuan. He feels an inexplicable attraction to her. With An An's help, the two eventually come together.

wlUBTdPocS.title: My Wife, the Drama Queen
wlUBTdPocS.desc:
Gao Wenwen isn’t just a brilliant actress—she’s a force of nature. Professionally, she’s the epitome of dedication (meticulous with scripts, generous with co-stars). Personally, she’s a warrior who meets life’s cruel plot twists with unshakable optimism.
When industry politics, family crises, and shattered relationships try to write her off, Wenwen rewrites the script: leaning on chosen family, sharpening her craft in the shadows, and proving that kindness isn’t weakness. Her greatest performance? Transforming every setback into a standing-ovation comeback.

XaElKTinQJ.title: An Unparalleled Lady of Her Time
XaElKTinQJ.desc: Lu Wushuang, a girl with extraordinary culinary talent, faces discrimination from her grandfather and society due to her gender. Raised by her widowed mother, she struggles against prejudice and family indifference. Determined to become a renowned chef like her late father, Lu teaches herself and secretly learns from the imperial kitchen. When her efforts fail to impress her clan, she leaves home, receiving guidance from a legendary chef. Returning as a culinary master, she attempts to save her family from crisis, only to be rejected again for being a woman. Undeterred, she hosts a citywide banquet to prove her worth. As guests flock in, a challenge from rival clans ignites a battle of honor that will define her legacy, her family's reputation, and national pride.

VFbOelM1bv.title: The Emperor of Fengdu
VFbOelM1bv.desc: Fengdu's great emperor, Xiao Feng, returns to the city in low profile to fulfill his marriage contract with his wife, Mu Xue. However, he faces obstacles from all sides and is even falsely accused of being an imposter. Watch as the emperor strikes back, humiliating his enemies and forcing all who doubted him to bow down in defeat!

EFqWcQOyJe.title: Billionaire Heir's Venture
EFqWcQOyJe.desc: An ordinary employee faces workplace setbacks and bullying, leading to his dismissal. In despair, a luxury car stops beside him—he discovers he is the long-lost child of the nation's richest man. Granted immense wealth, his first move is to buy back his former company.

nycZnz53m0.title: The Captive Sparrow of Professor Ji
nycZnz53m0.desc: Learning Ji Huaizhi will marry his first love Shen Nianqing, pregnant Sheng Baichu resolves to break up, hoping to use umbilical cord blood to save her dying father. When Ji Huaizhi discovers her pregnancy after humiliating confrontations, she's finally forced to reveal she's carrying his child.

uvZtazfTxY.title: The Modern Outcast
uvZtazfTxY.desc: Betrayed by his secretary, Ye Hao is reborn in ancient times with his smartphone, as the spoiled heir of the Ye family. Expecting luxury, he discovers the family wealth is gone and a casino boss demands all assets. With only seven days left, he must make money to save his home.

O7GHNStY9C.title: Snow and Swords
O7GHNStY9C.desc: Three years ago, Lin Wan'er was forced to break her engagement to Qi Lingji and marry a prince. Hurt and angry, Qi held a grudge. After the prince's rebellion fails and Lin's family is exiled, Qi ascends the throne and makes Lin his attendant to seek revenge.

vJ80Pezx6S.title: The Last Exam Ticket
vJ80Pezx6S.desc: On exam day, Lu Gaofei leaves his admission ticket at Wan Jiayin's breakfast shop. Racing to deliver it, Wan Jiayin crashes into a Porsche—inside are Lu Gaofei's mother, Wang Lanfang, and her lover, Lin Weida. Wang Lanfang desperately blocks her from leaving. Will the ticket arrive in time?

Uvzgtg56WF.title: The Lost Heiress in Plain Sight
Uvzgtg56WF.desc: The wealthy Liu family has searched 18 years for their lost daughter Ma Yiyan, remembering only her token. Zhen Zhu becomes their maid to support her mentally ill mother and faces constant humiliation. When the butler beats her, a pouch she's worn since childhood falls out. The family panics.

uYVAOFIJS3.title: The Wedding and the Funeral
uYVAOFIJS3.desc: Daisy goes blind saving her fiancé, Joseph. After regaining her sight, she discovers his affair with Emily. Crushed, she plans to expose them at the wedding and fake her death—making Joseph live with the guilt. But Michael, who's always loved her, also shows up…

jPMz7P3Grc.title: One Night Mistake, Forever Mine
jPMz7P3Grc.desc: Fu Yechen has a one-night stand with Tang Xing but mistakes Tang Rou for his partner. As his secretary, Tang Xing develops feelings for him while fending off Tang Rou's schemes. She exposes Tang Rou's conspiracy at the wedding, winning Fu Yechen's heart and his love.

nc1Ybwy7YI.title: Love Found in the Depths of Fate
nc1Ybwy7YI.desc: In her past life, Lu Youyou was betrayed by a scumbag and hurt her beloved older brother. Reborn, she resolves to follow her heart, free from societal constraints, and win the love of her non-blood-related brother, embarking together on a new journey of love and happiness.

0h3BGbAXZD.title: Champion, She is Not the One
0h3BGbAXZD.desc: Intern reporter Anya, while replacing her good friend Nancy, accidentally meets the most sought-after swimming star athlete Michael. One night later, Anya is worried that the events of that night will have an impact and decides to keep it a secret, while Michael mistakes Nancy for Anya...

4WgbMemGpl.title: Tell Me What You Want
4WgbMemGpl.desc: A young wife in her unhappy marriage meets a top billionaire and becomes his BDSM partner, embarking on a romantic journey of redemption that progresses from sex to love.

ju2izPj0od.title: Sister's Fierce Revenge
ju2izPj0od.desc: Jiang An is betrayed and murdered by her fiancé, Song Chen, who plans to take over her family business. Her sister, Jiang Lai, believes the death is suspicious and embarks on a path of revenge, uncovering a dark conspiracy.

jrxfuUQR2n.title: The Invincible Mad Husband
jrxfuUQR2n.desc: The Duan family is wiped out, leaving only an adopted son missing. Great clans fear the killers' power and won't intervene. Even his fiancée Miss Fang is punished for attempting to hold the wedding. When the lost son returns, he crushes a vassal family, declaring a vengeance war.

rFtB9AoVKZ.title: A Glimpse of Heaven
rFtB9AoVKZ.desc: After a one-night affair with Jin Wuchen at a nightclub, Chu Xinlian left pregnant and raised her daughter alone. When the child was injured, Jin's mother recognized a dragon buckle, revealing the child's true identity. Jin Wuchen found the child and took care of both mother and daughter. During this time, Chu Xinlian faced betrayal from Chen Xingling and struggles with her family, but Jin Wuchen remained by her side, protecting her throughout.

w1lzZkZ6tA.title: The Tycoon Who Rose Again
w1lzZkZ6tA.desc: Five years ago, Ling Xiao was injured and lost his memory, seen by others as a failure. Refusing to give up, he gained the trust of the company's tourism partners and leveraged his corporate authority to seize opportunities, using his intelligence and talent to achieve a remarkable comeback.

NV62ejDhOk.title: I Rule the Empress's Harem
NV62ejDhOk.desc: The story follows modern military archaeology PhD Xu Chen, who, while surveying the tomb of the Emperor of the Great Qian Dynasty, accidentally travels back in time to the Great Qian era and becomes a eunuch. It is then that Xu Chen remembers the true identity of the original person whose body he has inhabited: he was originally the son of the Northern Marquis' family, Xu Chen. However, the Northern Marquis was falsely accused of treason, and his entire family was executed, leaving only Xu Chen alive to enter the palace as a eunuch. The elderly eunuch who was responsible for Xu Chen's castration, out of gratitude for the Northern Marquis' past kindness, deliberately spared Xu Chen's life. Xu Chen is suddenly summoned by the Emperor. Thinking the Emperor, who has executed 28 eunuchs, is a cruel tyrant, Xu Chen, now occupying the body of the son of the Northern Marquis, plans to take revenge for his family.

RBSLPRij09.title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Wife
RBSLPRij09.desc: Elise hides her identity and secretly helps her husband Ryan become company president. At his mother's birthday party, Ryan hurts her over Alyssa, his late friend's wife. Heartbroken, Elise divorces him and reveals she's a billionaire heiress. Ryan regrets it and tries to win her back.

NaVOZUMqY3.title: Between Honor and Desire
NaVOZUMqY3.desc: Martial artist Michael Collins saves David Cooper and moves into his estate. David, unable to have children, risks losing his fortune unless he produces an heir soon. He asks Michael for help, but Michael is torn between his attraction to David's wife, Emily, and his own morals.

YtWbO0WEpm.title: Villainess Turned Favorite(Dubbed)
YtWbO0WEpm.desc: Emily becomes the villainess in a novel with three ruthless brothers. On the first day, she offends the male lead, Michael, then meets Thomas in an elevator, bows to him, and sleeps with him. Later, at a birthday banquet, Thomas appears as a feared villain and wealthy heir.

NjkJE6k2Xl.title: Every Lie Backfired
NjkJE6k2Xl.desc: Paralyzed CEO Zheng Shu is mistreated by caregiver Qin Yue, who claims to carry her son Gu Tianrui's child. Forced into a fake coma, Zheng Shu discovers "her son" is actually Gu Tianrui's vengeful twin Gu Tianjun. She exposes their conspiracy, and they face justice. She reconciles with both sons.

Tol66PKyOG.title: Rearranging Her Life I
Tol66PKyOG.desc: After discovering her husband Chu Guinan's infidelity, 30-year-old full-time mom Zheng Qi joins the second-hand luxury store where his misstress Xiao Shan works, seeking revenge. There, she encounters other struggling moms and forms a complex bond with Xiao Shan, helping redeem each other's lives.

HxswiYh9QA.title: When Favoritism Turns Fatal
HxswiYh9QA.desc: A girl and her mother live in hardship, rejected by her grandmother. When she prevents her half-brother from getting hurt, her grandmother misunderstands. As they rush the injured boy to the hospital, her grandmother obstructs them, wrongly thinking that her granddaughter is hurt instead.

DjjULdyW8K.title: Misjudged Mother, Divine Strategist
DjjULdyW8K.desc: Lena, Athena's heir and ex-High Strategos of the Order of Aegis, saved seven babies from a fire years ago. On her 50th birthday, her sons, swayed by their birth parents, denounce her as a trafficker. She reclaims power, reveals her identity, and earns her sons' respect through her leadership.

CVS1x0vZBW.title: The Warrior's Awakening
CVS1x0vZBW.desc: Qin Mu, a legendary warrior, hides his identity and becomes a son-in-law to the Yang family for five years to repay a debt. When the Yang family gives his sister to the governor's son, he learns that the woman who saved him is Xia Ruyue, and they have a daughter. He vows to repay his debt.

B5Z3co6XW1.title: The Wrath of the War God
B5Z3co6XW1.desc: The war god Qin Yao, who has guarded the borders of the Great Xia, returns to Mingzhu only to find his wife and daughter persecuted. His wife is forced into the arms of a rich young man for entertainment, and his daughter is injected with a virus unlike any he's ever seen. Furious upon learning the truth, Qin Yao leads his 100,000-strong Longxiang Army into the capital, heading straight for the imperial palace to exact his revenge!

zpgjf9JGuj.title: The Secret of Love
zpgjf9JGuj.desc: After an accident, the heroine ends up in an affair with the hero. When her boyfriend catches them, a fight in the car leads to a crash, killing the hero’s sister, who was on her way to celebrate their father’s birthday. The boyfriend begs the heroine to take the blame to protect his future, promising to marry her once she’s out of prison. Soft-hearted, she agrees. However, when the hero learns the truth, he embarks on a ruthless quest for revenge against her.

g24C6QXu1z.title: The Return of the Gene Master
g24C6QXu1z.desc: Eminent geneticist Xia Zhongjie returned secretly but was publicly humiliated by institute director Su Xinyu, causing severe injuries. His daughter Xia Siya avenged him by punishing Su's group at the welcome banquet for destroying his research.

15KYGa4tdT.title: Disabled Prince and Healer Consort
15KYGa4tdT.desc: The fallen young lady quietly dies in her wedding sedan. When she opens her eyes again, Fu Zhaoning, a genius in the medical field, discovers that she has traveled into the body of the young lady...

CMgy6qbxHk.title: Fed Up, I Refuse to Marry
CMgy6qbxHk.desc: Sebastian Wright is injured saving his first love, Aria, only to be rejected and disowned. With childhood friend Sophia's seven-year care, he heals. Rising to the top, he pursues Aria, betraying Sophia, who eventually marries another, leaving him to lifelong regret and loneliness.

6YHeS3Tb7F.title: Love Through the Mist
6YHeS3Tb7F.desc: Scarlett Nelson (Sophia Walker) brings her daughter to the hospital and meets her ex-boyfriend Ethan Mitchell. Forced into a secret romance years ago, she left after bearing twins, keeping only her daughter. Seven years later, Ethan recognizes her and pursues her, and they finally reunite.

i1Fj1mt5xd.title: The Regent's Heart Belongs to Me
i1Fj1mt5xd.desc: Qin Wanxing fought for five years disguised as her weak brother Qin Lin, earning great military honors. Her brother Qin Lin and their mother tried to murder her and stole her War God title. After being framed by the emperor, she and Gu Yunshen overthrew him and stayed together forever.

f5Dc6DRNzb.title: The Light of Vengeance
f5Dc6DRNzb.desc: Zhao Xiaoxiao, abandoned by her grandfather in the wilderness due to being deemed a "mother-killer," is taken in by the driver Zhao Yongqiang as his adopted daughter. Years later, when Zhao Yongqiang is diagnosed with cancer and needs money for treatment, he turns to the Lin family for help. However, her grandfather coldly prevents her from seeing her adoptive father one last time. Filled with resentment, Zhao Xiaoxiao seeks revenge by becoming a private tutor in the Lin family.

YxV6wcVEm3.title: Boss, I Have a Love Affair for You
YxV6wcVEm3.desc: Betrayed by her sister, Du Qinghuan finds herself at her wit's end. Suddenly, a love contract falls into her lap, tasking her with helping the handsome and wealthy boss, Xiao Jinyan, find love within a month. As his love mentor, Du Qinghuan unveils her unique three-part love strategy, but her matchmaking skills lead to a series of comical mishaps. What she never expected, however, was that Xiao Jinyan’s heart was set on someone completely unexpected for her.

twMfR33OqV.title: The Rose's Secret Kiss
twMfR33OqV.desc: Five years ago, Lin Ruge was framed by her stepsister and became pregnant after an encounter with Huo Jingshen, leading to her being kicked out of her home. Five years later, Lin Ruge approaches her cheating ex-husband's younger uncle, Huo Jingshen, in a bid for revenge, and they end up getting married. After their marriage, Huo Jingshen's mother designs a test to challenge Lin Ruge, but Huo Jingshen stands by her. Over time, he realizes that Lin Ruge is the woman he has been searching for all these years—the mother of his children and his true love.

GOsjZ4VZ30.title: She's the One He Loves
GOsjZ4VZ30.desc: Gu Cinian and Ning Chuxue met during childhood, but due to misunderstandings and Ning Yan's lies, they failed to recognize each other when they grew up. Gu Cinian mistakenly believes Ning Yan is Ning Chuxue, and Ning Yan takes advantage of the situation. Gu Cinian gradually becomes captivated by Ning Chuxue's talents, and the two develop feelings for each other, but they are unable to confess due to Ning Yan's interference. Eventually, Ning Yan's lies are exposed, and the two finally become a couple.

AlOOTkmOpO.title: I gave birth to a little God of Wealth
AlOOTkmOpO.desc: One-night stand pregnancy. Planned abortion till winning $3M lottery. Fortune teller: "Baby is God of Wealth!" Pregnancy brought endless luck. 5yrs later, kid picks his bio-dad from dates - the now-poor one-night stand man.

UvKBg5MsA7.title: Don't Mess with the Ex-Wife
