UvKBg5MsA7.desc: After three years as a devoted housewife, the gentle and beautiful Duan Wei is betrayed—her best friend causes her miscarriage, her in-laws throw her out, and her husband pushes her off a bridge. Everyone she once loved wants her dead. A year later, she returns—stunning, wealthy, and out for revenge. As her ex-husband falls for her all over again, she vows to make those who wronged her pay—in blood.

EiFPQHvFfa.title: Mr. Li's Beloved Little Wife
EiFPQHvFfa.desc:
Li Shenxing secretly admired Wen Chuchu in college but lost contact when he went abroad. Later, he learned his grandfather had arranged for her to be his fiancée and returned to China, only to see her with an older man. Misunderstanding her behavior, he grew conflicted.
A year later, Li was drugged and, due to a scheme by Wen Chuchu’s sister Wen Beibei, ended up in a hotel room with Wen Chuchu. After an intimate encounter, Li mistakenly thought it was Beibei. He promised to take responsibility if she lost her purity for him.
Li’s grandfather secretly had them registered as a couple. Over time, Li realized Wen Chuchu was not what he thought and uncovered Beibei’s deceit. In the end, Li and Wen Chuchu exposed Beibei’s schemes and built a happy life together, raising their daughter in harmony.

1y18gk9iIm.title: The High Priestess's Sweet Love
1y18gk9iIm.desc: Gu Shiyan falls into a coma, so his grandfather arranges a marriage with Ye Qingqing. Using her priestly skills, she awakens and heals him. Amid schemes by Gu Linci and Ye Lingling, she exposes the truth with her medical skills, and they finally unite.

hzE0IC7aM9.title: Pampered by My Rich Husband
hzE0IC7aM9.desc: The wealthiest man in Fengcheng is forced to have a flash marriage with a spoiled young woman. Everyone eagerly waits to see the jokes about the wife, but to their surprise, the woman who married into the prestigious Shen family becomes a force to be reckoned with, commanding attention and respect, and is pampered by every member of the Shen family!

19x15hXImM.title: Replace My Husband By A Boss
19x15hXImM.desc: Ji Rao & disabled heir Fu Yuanchen both fled wedding but had one-night stand. Married while hiding identities: she's a CEO, he has special physique. When truth surfaces, unexpected obstacles threaten their union.

XaNzBySk16.title: No Exit for Love
XaNzBySk16.desc: Five years ago, Wen Qianyue was saved by Wen Yanzhou during a family crisis. She became his assistant and lover. When his fiancée returns, Wen Qianyue decides to leave, but Wen Yanzhou refuses to let her go. Misunderstandings grow, and it's only then that they both realize their true feelings. Wen Qianyue learns that Wen Yanzhou has always loved her but was held back by his own doubts. In the end, they finally confess and come together.

74IEi9nigg.title: Blossom Again
74IEi9nigg.desc: In her previous life, the legitimate eldest daughter of the family, Marry Brown, was constantly bullied by her younger half-sister, Emily Brown. Not only was her engagement to the Crown Prince snatched away, but she was also forced to marry a poor scholar. In the end, both of them died together. After both were reborn, Marry Brown and Emily Brown chose to switch their identities. Marry Brown, while enjoying a sweet relationship with the Prince of the North, David Wilson, also fought against the scheming concubine and the vicious empress. Meanwhile, Emily Brown and the poor scholar fell into a deep abyss. Marry Brown faced numerous dangers in the palace intrigue but eventually, together with David Wilson, she achieved her ideals and lived a loving life.

EkU1vR2RaE.title: Cold Beauty Reborn
EkU1vR2RaE.desc: Her parents divorced; her mother remarried a tycoon. Her greedy sister followed their mother, while she helped her father and brothers succeed—only to be betrayed and killed. Reborn on the day of the divorce, she watches her sister choose their father and realizes she has also been reincarnated.

s4X3R21ajq.title: The True Bride's Silent Revenge
s4X3R21ajq.desc: Fake Su Ying (Su Lan) forces mute Shen Wanyin into a plan, unaware she's the real Su Ying seeking revenge with a new face. Su Lan killed Su Ying's family to steal her identity, unaware of the warlord captivated by the true Su Ying's voice and soul. Su Lan schemes to eliminate her. Twist ending.

ISrgbsRc64.title: Pampering His Wife Again
ISrgbsRc64.desc: Before rebirth, Su Ruonian mistook Fu Weichuan for her parents' killer and took her own life after learning the truth following his death. Reborn, she exposes Fu Yiming and Zhang Yuxin's affair and their schemes against her. In the end, justice prevails, and Ruonian and Weichuan marry in happiness.

PwBNzjsLut.title: A Matter of Sin and Love
PwBNzjsLut.desc: Christian adopted Elena—the crash-causing pilot's daughter—to atone for her father. Over decade, his hate turned to love. Through toxic care cycles, they overcame all odds to unite.

t0FjEfuPk8.title: Married To A Secret Billionaire
t0FjEfuPk8.desc: A love story between Madison and Steve who got married for reasons best known to them and how fate intervenes. Steve is the illegitimate son of a wealthy family who is rumored to be an idler, but the truth is, he is the owner and mastermind behind Magna Technologies, one of the biggest technology companies in the country. He married Madison to fulfill his mother's last wish and, to provoke Madison to conceal their marriage, he pretended to be a jobless man. Madison, on the other hand, married Steve for reasons best known to her. Both had hidden their true identities from one another and had gotten married for their own secret motives. However, fate has other plans for them as, during the course of their marriage, they gradually fall in love.

zzpB4kYSnE.title: Crazy Mr. Gu, The Substitute Twist!
zzpB4kYSnE.desc: Genius artist Jiang Li, haunted by the guilt of losing her beloved boyfriend Jiang Feng due to her own recklessness, encounters Gu Tingfeng, the CEO of Gu Corporation, who resembles Jiang Feng. Desperate for a connection, Jiang Li becomes Gu's devoted follower, enduring ridicule from his friends. Gu, however, ignores the taunts, and Jiang Li cares even less. But when Song Nianyao, the real-life inspiration for Jiang Li's substitute role, returns, she attempts to usurp Jiang Li's position. Unexpectedly, the usually compliant and timid Jiang Li stands her ground against Song.

gU0025jC8p.title: Enthralled in Passion
gU0025jC8p.desc: Once the heiress of a wealthy family, An Mingxi's life takes a turn when her family falls into bankruptcy and her father marries the mother of Yao Qianqian, a nouveau riche gold-digger. Grateful and deeply in love with her fiancé, Gu Huai, who once saved her life, she's unaware that he's plotting against her with Yao Qianqian, aiming to seize the inheritance left by her mother. Meanwhile, Gu Moqian, who harbors deep feelings for An Mingxi,压抑his emotions due to her relationship with his nephew. When An Mingxi catches Gu Huai and Yao Qianqian in a compromising position, she's enraged and attempts to revenge by seducing Gu Moqian, but ultimately chickens out at the last moment. Determined to obtain the inheritance, Gu Huai drugs An Mingxi, leading to an unintended intimate encounter between her and Gu Moqian, sparking an ill-fated love affair.

NhFjT7GQDW.title: A Heart in Bloom
NhFjT7GQDW.desc: Courtesan Emily , betrayed and reborn a frail maid, serves the aloof heir Michael  to fund her cure. Dance and cunning thaw his heart; plots, treachery and death test them both. Three years later she returns as star dancer—will love finally hold?

1rOJMuqp1V.title: Warlord Grandma in Modern Times
1rOJMuqp1V.desc: Once a female warlord in the early 20th century, Ruan Lan is shot while protecting her son Jin Ruilin. She awakens seventy years later to a shocking world: her son is now an elderly man, while she is a neglected heiress. Before she can come to terms with her fate, she meets her son's descendants…

KLUcArkOym.title: Secrets in the Coffin
KLUcArkOym.desc: After ten years away, Yang Guang returns home successful, hoping to bring his sister Yang Dahua and wife Manni to the city. He learns of Yang Dahua's death upon arrival. Hearing his sister's voice and noticing Erwa's strange behavior, Yang Guang defies Manni and opens the coffin publicly.

feqtDV2LXv.title: Don't Run, My Wife
feqtDV2LXv.desc: Yan Zhu is cast out by her family and must raise her son on her own. Fu Boyan, the head of a powerful family, is drawn back to her due to lingering feelings from an accident five years ago. Amid family grudges and rivalries, Yan Zhu’s emotions and dignity are put to the test. Fu Boyan stands by her side, helping her navigate the family’s schemes and the trials of love. A tangled romance filled with love, hate, and power struggles—how will they ultimately choose?

utLT6momHG.title: My First Love Is the Divine Lord
utLT6momHG.desc: Jiang Cheng grew up being bullied by her uncle's family, so she chose a career in funeral services for financial independence—much to her aunt's resentment. Just before quitting her job, the corpse she was handling suddenly came back to life, claiming to be a deity named Gu Wenhao. He insists she helps him complete three tasks before he can leave. The first: learn to fall in love and treat Gu Wenhao as a real partner. The second: help him find the person who killed him. Jiang Cheng teams up with Gu Wenhao to investigate a company murder case, discovering that the case is linked to his killer. Using the body's memories, she uncovers clues, only to realize that Gu Wenhao is deeply connected to the case. As her suspicion grows, Gu Wenhao continues to pursue her under the guise of dating.

gkf1XdpTtT.title: Forbidden Currents
gkf1XdpTtT.desc: College lovers Sophia and Noah are torn apart when his brother forces her into marriage. She secretly raises Noah 's child. Years later, after his brother's death, Noah returns as a cold CEO, outwardly indifferent but quietly protecting her. Their deep love proves unbreakable.

DCKAcQbjxU.title: Wedding Scapegoat
DCKAcQbjxU.desc: Chu Yan plans to use her wedding pranks to teach her disliked classmate Xu Ci a lesson, hiring thug Qiangzi to harass the bridesmaids. Her sister, Chu Man, returns from abroad and accidentally soils Xu Ci's outfit. After they swap jackets, Qiangzi mistakes Chu Man for Xu Ci, and targets her.

Ag5coSONBr.title: Hustler at Elite School
Ag5coSONBr.desc: Yun Ling knew money wasn't everything, but life was impossible without it. She seized every opportunity to climb higher. Her calm campus life was disrupted when a new sponsored student arrived. As the story unfolded, she realized her allies were playing a training game—with her as the subject.

BF2JUL4o8Z.title: A Cure Ahead of Time
BF2JUL4o8Z.desc: Medical master Gu Cheng develops a cancer-fighting drug and unexpectedly travels fifty years back. To save his mother and advance medicine, he introduces the drug early. Despite skepticism, repeated trials earn him acclaim, making him a leading figure and sparking a medical revolution.

jrNYToQvM7.title: Daddy, Surrender to the Thunderous Four!
jrNYToQvM7.desc: After giving birth to four children, a woman is separated from her children due to her treacherous younger sister's actions. Three of the boys are thrown into a river by her, while the girl is left behind. Years pass, and the three boys grow up to be exceptionally talented and embark on a mission to uncover their true identities, preparing for revenge. In the meantime, their mother, who miraculously survived a devastating fire, plays a pivotal role in their fight for justice.

v5hBJo8eSM.title: Accidentally Adopting a General as My Husband
v5hBJo8eSM.desc: In ancient times, General Shen Huaixu of the Wei Kingdom was betrayed and killed by treacherous figures while trying to save his fiancée, Su Yi. In an unexpected twist of fate, he travels through time to the modern era and encounters a surgeon named Su Yi, who shares the same name as his late fiancée. Coincidentally, he also resembles the missing eldest son of the Shen family.

KfGq5z5oUw.title: The Mystic's Journey
KfGq5z5oUw.desc: Lin Baqian, a young man from the foot of Qinglong Mountain, carries a mysterious destiny. After his mother and grandfather sacrifice themselves for him, he leaves the village at 18 to uncover the truth. On his journey, he faces dangers but finds trusted allies and a lifelong love.

F7NoMwuVLL.title: Younger Lover, Harder to Resist
F7NoMwuVLL.desc: When painting teacher Sophia Scott's husband's secretary announces her pregnancy, Sophia's life crumbles. She finds solace in Noah Clark, her husband's rival, whose passionate pursuit and protection help her expose family schemes and discover that their relationship had been planned from the start.

cwdpj4rDim.title: The Lost Heavenly Lord
cwdpj4rDim.desc: Immortal Ye Xuan is betrayed, his soul hidden and power split. A millennium later, he lives as a beggar with no memory. He is reawakened within the divine furnace, reclaims his past, and faces three trials to restore his power. Saintess Jiang Yao sacrifices herself to help him ascend again.

e8nFsmoMXi.title: Daddy, Mommy Needs Saving
e8nFsmoMXi.desc: The villain forces the heroine to give up the family heirloom to save the hero. She breaks up, is sent to a mental hospital, and gives birth. Five years later, their child seeks his father. The hero learns the truth, rescues her, they overcome obstacles, punish the villain, and reunite as a family.

yUbqN1T32z.title: Mr. Icy, Actually Boss Lady
yUbqN1T32z.desc: CEO Bai, disguised as male employee Bai Shengnan, inspects branches incognito. Liu Xiuxiu and Chu Sheng see her stellar performance as a threat and plot to frame her. Liu Xiuxiu frames Bai Shengnan for groping, forces a confession, and publicly humiliates her.

0LjevCEHIn.title: Boundless Love: The Reigning Passion
0LjevCEHIn.desc: Five years ago, under the influence of a drug, Feng Ling inadvertently offended Su Yun. Ever since, his heart has been hers. When fate brings them back together, Feng discovers Su Yun's unhappy marriage. Despite the boundaries of her wedlock, his love knows no bounds. Unbeknownst to them, her husband Zheng Sili catches them in a compromising position...

46XCeNSPCG.title: Sleeping for 30 Years, My Brothers Regret
46XCeNSPCG.desc: Stella, the Newsoms' beloved adopted daughter, was adored by her three brothers—but was discarded after they found their real daughter, Luna. Choosing to repay their kindness, the heartbroken Stella volunteered for her brothers' cryogenic experiment and vanished into a 30-year slumber.

Ah6anuzz8d.title: Secrets in the Vineyard
Ah6anuzz8d.desc: Amber and Lucas have been married for three years, appearing to be the perfect couple. However, Lucas uses Amber's money to support his mistress, Sophia, even gifting her a billion-dollar vineyard in Amber's name. When Amber discovers their affair, she strikes back decisively.

PyaC1qjhFJ.title: Blood Vows at the Palace
PyaC1qjhFJ.desc: Sophia Walker's family is slaughtered by Mason Williams, the boy she once saved. Reborn, she schemes to marry the Crown Prince for protection. On her wedding day, the reborn Seventh Prince Mason storms in, declaring both she and the throne belong to him alone.

YW8k1eAlrK.title: The Deadly Delivery
YW8k1eAlrK.desc: Shen Zhao sees a mysterious figure dragging a black bag near her building. Eerie shadows follow her in the elevator and at her door. She receives unexplained packages for three days. When the news reveals that killers send "bloody items" before striking, Shen Zhao realizes she's been targeted.

Nq5WvWjthn.title: Eternal Burial Rite
Nq5WvWjthn.desc: Zheng Xiuning begs Hall Master Hongjun to bury her father, his servant. He first aids servant Zhou Jiuyou, whose granddaughter Zhou Qingning dismisses Hongjun as fake and ignores burial warnings. Zhou Jiuyou becomes a zombie and kills his son. Hongjun returns to handle the matter.

sEiclENZZL.title: Love Begins with Goodbye
sEiclENZZL.desc: After regaining her sight, Emily Green discovers her boyfriend Daniel Bennett's betrayal with his first love. Given seven days to marry by her parents, she gives Daniel the same time to confess, but he fails her. She marries Michael Collins, who had quietly loved her, and finds true love.

CQkDbg5dLA.title: They Chose the Other Woman
CQkDbg5dLA.desc: After seven years of coldness from Thomas, Emily still believed her love could warm his heart—until she returned to find him celebrating another woman's birthday with their daughter. Heartbroken, she gave up, signed the divorce papers, gave up custody, and walked away for good.

rX7cZgqTo4.title: From Fake Heiress to True Victor
rX7cZgqTo4.desc: Once the cherished daughter of a noble house, Emily is cast out as a fake heiress and framed for poisoning, sentenced to three years as a maid. She is later brought back to marry a feared prince in place of the real heiress, and returns hardened—ready to clear her name and expose the truth.

1EY3guo9BC.title: Heiress Takes Back Her Home
1EY3guo9BC.desc: Harper Miller, the only legitimate daughter of the top family, discovers her mother beaten and framed as a mistress, while the maid has taken her mother's place. When her brothers and father side with the maid, Harper protects her mother, drives out the usurpers, and ensures they face punishment.

4qi369yAO1.title: Drunk Into the Tycoon's Bed
4qi369yAO1.desc: After a drunken mistake, Lin Yuan spends one night with Fu Mingxiu, a powerful Beijing elite. They reunite at a hospital, where Fu Mingxiu pretends to be her doctor and keeps pursuing her. When he learns she has no boyfriend, his obsession begins. Adapted from a novel by Yaoling on the Tomato Novel.

0UC3ZVtDtn.title: National Honor, Family Betrayal
0UC3ZVtDtn.desc: Professor Song Mulan develops a groundbreaking gene formula and receives a national medal. Her ex-husband Ma Zhongqiang and son Ma Xuan humiliate her, accuse her of theft, and abuse her. Her billionaire husband Zhou Hanchuan exposes the truth, arrests the Ma family, and vindicates her honor.

U3WCOIfjt4.title: My Online Lover's Worst Mistake
U3WCOIfjt4.desc: Fang Yan, once mocked for her weight and betrayed by her boyfriend and best friend, transforms her life after a near-drowning incident. As the heiress to the Fang Group, she rises from tragedy to become their stunning boss, determined to expose every lie and seek revenge.

MVa2dt7GIq.title: My Baby Daddy Was Never a Gigolo
MVa2dt7GIq.desc: Eight years ago, the heroine was betrayed by her fiancé, her father was imprisoned and committed suicide, and her best friend set her up for a one-night stand with the male lead. Returning for her son's treatment, she mistakes the male lead for a gigolo, sparking a hilarious romance.

0LweeOFbcg.title: My Simpleton Mother
0LweeOFbcg.desc: Intellectually disabled Lin Yanzhen bore twins for late husband but impoverished. Grandma abandoned sister to spoil brother. 20yrs later daughter became tycoon's heir, son denied his mother & tricked her into selling kidney for his wedding house.

FB0mme7Z8e.title: Undercover Mother's Revenge
FB0mme7Z8e.desc: Five years after her twin sons vanished, Sophia becomes a nanny in Noah's home. She discovers that Noah's adopted sons are actually her missing children—but her sons are being used as a blood source. Secretly, she plans their escape and brings down the Martin family.

Fxiyz8VfEv.title: Burning in His Obsession
Fxiyz8VfEv.desc: Shen Qingwu becomes He Wang's kept woman to find out who hurt her sister. After six months, as she plans to leave, she discovers that the ruthless He Wang loves her. He yields to love, entangling her with pleas. Adapted from the Tomato novel After Breakup, the CEO Gone Wild by A Ruan Bu Ruan.

OnrzAJJHxq.title: Married the Prince's Uncle Instead
OnrzAJJHxq.desc: The general’s orphaned daughter, Shen Yao, was granted an imperial marriage. In her past life, she married Crown Prince Xie Jingchu and suffered greatly. Reborn, she chose Prince Xie Yuan instead—he awoke, they fell in love, and Xie Jingchu later regained his memories, deeply regretting her loss.

SaTtQfyG9x.title: Fortune Knocks with a Daughter
SaTtQfyG9x.desc: Lin Feng, a food delivery man, is unexpectedly approached by Lu Yiwang, the female CEO of Tianyun Group, and her daughter, Lu Yaoyao. They ask him to pretend to be Yaoyao's father, offering him a reward of 200,000 yuan. Lin Feng agrees to the arrangement. Just then, his mother calls, urging him to return home for the Lin family ancestral ceremony. Lin Feng takes Yaoyao with him back to his hometown. Meanwhile, at the Lin family ancestral hall, Lin Feng's mother is being humiliated by his uncle, Lin Haitao, and his family...

oVYiwxQJ5k.title: My Strong and Protective Wife
oVYiwxQJ5k.desc: The unstoppable tomboy Xia Nan accidentally stumbles upon a hit scene and single-handedly saves a "fragile" gentleman from danger. To her surprise, he, Lu Zichen, pulls out a marriage contract and demands: "Ten million, marry me!" Xia Nan, confident and bold, replies, "From now on, big sister will protect you!"

fYm2CHBQmr.title: Spy Consort's Gamble
fYm2CHBQmr.desc: Modern-day agent Chu Yueli accidentally travels back in time to become the "silly girl" of a rural family. Struggling with a cold father, a cruel stepmother, and a cross-dressing fiancé, she plans to escape. But everything changes when she meets a limping prince who unexpectedly alters her path. Watch as she fights to change her destiny and rise above it all!

F1SXv8JLtA.title: Don't Slap It, Spin It
F1SXv8JLtA.desc: Tennis star Jonathan forces therapist Rachel into a secret affair to pay for her mother's medical bills. Rachel discovers Jonathan's fiancée, Laura. After conflicts and a near assault, Jonathan's family pressures him into a business marriage and retirement. Their future is uncertain amid turmoil.

GMOzv3VnYa.title: Married to the Villain Prince
GMOzv3VnYa.desc: Mu Zihan marries the dying Crown Prince Zhou Jing to save her brother. Accidentally awakening him, she discovers he suffers from the same poison as her brother. As she fights for his cure and he drops his guard, they uncover imperial darkness and his buried pain—then unite to overturn the corrupt.

bMivbOs59P.title: Matriarch's Secret Alliance
bMivbOs59P.desc: Emma Lewis receives an urn from her daughter-in-law. Disguised as a cleaner to investigate, she's mistaken for her son's wife by his mistress Ella, and humiliated. Emma allies with her real daughter-in-law Sophia, exposes Ella at a banquet, punishes her son, and together they reclaim control.

DdF8WUnCSs.title: The Caged Bird He Set Free
DdF8WUnCSs.desc: Framed by her foster sister Ji Yiyi, Ji Yue is committed to a psychiatric hospital. Tycoon Duan Jingsu hastily marries her to escape an arranged match, enraging Ji Yiyi. With his support, Ji Yue recovers, exposes the truth behind her grandmother's death, and gains fame through painting.

NK8u5yGUYo.title: Daddy Can't Stop Loving Mommy
NK8u5yGUYo.desc: Actress Lin Anran divorced CEO Xiao Yunchen after an unexpected pregnancy. Six years later, the Xiaos discover her daughter Lin Nuannuan is Xiao Yunchen's child. He saves them on set without recognizing his daughter. When the truth emerges, he declares his love. They remarry and have twins.

UiPboBYzuc.title: Never Cross the Reborn Empress
UiPboBYzuc.desc: Sophia helped Ethan seize the throne, but her family was killed as a result. Reborn, she uses her memory and medical skills to protect loved ones, and seek revenge while entangled with her ex-husband's brother. From the Tomato novel "Married Your Brother After Rebirth" .

8yO7eo2Vpt.title: Divine Emperor's Revenge
8yO7eo2Vpt.desc: Betrayed in his past life, Michael loses his powers and bloodline. Reborn, he cuts all ties and grows stronger through pain. As his powers awaken, former traitors beg for mercy—but face his wrath. Michael reclaims everything and ascends as the Heavenly Emperor.

ec1h90KCIL.title: A Match Made in Fate
ec1h90KCIL.desc: Zhong Xiran's first love Huo Xin chose money over her and went abroad. Heir to the Qi Group, Qi Sinian, rescued her and married her when her family faced crisis. He secretly loved her for 11 years. Huo Xin's return tests their marriage, but she finally recognizes her true love's Qi Sinian.

ShbIopks6h.title: Money, Power, No Love
ShbIopks6h.desc: Yue Qing, a professional stand-in for first loves, pursues revenge and power by aligning with the elite. Over two years, she aids Xie Yanzhi's rise while maneuvering between Fu Zexiu and Chen Qingxuan, becoming the richest woman. She rejects love, trusting only money and power.

MtJl5hDKvv.title: The Heiress's Secret Identity Unmasked
MtJl5hDKvv.desc: To face her father's challenges, the daughter of the richest man in the country takes on a disguise as a low-profile clerk and starts working in his company. Despite the sneers and sarcasm from some colleagues, she keeps her identity hidden and...

0iARPM90q0.title: Imprisoned in a Sinful Desire
0iARPM90q0.desc: "Killed my brother? Prison is just the start." He choked her neck。5yrs revenge plan backfired as he fell for her。She,innocent,wanted freedom but got entangled。"Demoness,kiss me now。"Forbidden love born from hate

2584KuVYUh.title: Torn by Family
2584KuVYUh.desc: After her parents' business went bankrupt, they accidentally became separated from the female lead and her younger brother during their escape from creditors. Later, the female lead suffered amnesia after a car accident while being adopted by her foster father, while her brother was found by their parents and brought back home. For years, the family never gave up searching for the female lead. However, when she finally appeared as the "blood bank" for her brother, they repeatedly mistook her for someone else and mistreated her. It wasn't until her blood was completely drained, almost leading to her death, that she barely survived and discovered the truth: her biological father was someone else, and the separation of the siblings wasn't a coincidence but a carefully orchestrated conspiracy.

bISRZl4OEW.title: The Seeress and Her CEO Darling
bISRZl4OEW.desc: Chu Niannian is known for her incredibly accurate fortune-telling. After years of seclusion, her master tells her that she must descend the mountain to find her fated soulmate and engage in a romantic relationship, or her life will rapidly shorten. As a superstitious and self-preserving little fortuneteller, Chu Niannian immediately packs up and heads down the mountain in search of a man. The moment she lays eyes on Wang Jinghuai, she knows he's the one destined for her. This man? She's determined to make him hers!

YM0itGRzDR.title: Delivery Man Becomes a Master
YM0itGRzDR.desc: Deliveryman Qin Feng bought a martial arts manual from a beggar as a child. After years of practice, he becomes a master unaware of his power. He accidentally enters a matchmaking contest, defeats all, and wins Chen Mengyao. Only when lives are threatened does he reveal his stunning skills.

d183PQS8bD.title: Heart Caged in Shadows
d183PQS8bD.desc: Sophia is trained as a spy by Prince Ethan and planted beside Mason. She falls for Mason, but when their love is discovered, Ethan forces her to choose: betray him or lose her sister. She betrays him. Years later, Mason returns victorious. What awaits them?

0qQ2ZbCxsM.title: Heaven's Door for Love
0qQ2ZbCxsM.desc: Lin Man, CEO of the Ling Group, hides her true identity for the man she loves, Chen Jiahao, and becomes a simple housewife. At their daughter's parent-child sports event, Chen Jiahao promises to attend but cancels at the last minute—only to show up with his sister's family and win the competition. Furious, Lin Man leaves with their daughter, but tragedy strikes when they get into a car accident. With both women in critical condition, Chen Jiahao faces a heartbreaking choice between his mother and his wife.

UDr1xFPP4f.title: The Parasite in the House
UDr1xFPP4f.desc: Nanny Wang Cuihua seized her employer's villa while tycoon Gu Qingshi was away and his wife Xu Nuo shopped, inviting socialite Liu Lili to meet her son Gu Qiang. Xu Nuo returned early. Wang Cuihua and Liu Lili slandered and humiliated her, unaware Liu Lili's identity was also fake.

3q0MIQU564.title: Love Found Through a Song
3q0MIQU564.desc: Chen Bailing, a 50-year-old single mother, connects with CEO Shang Feng on a singing app. Her son blocks their meeting, suspecting AI scams. Despite obstacles, they eventually meet. With Shang Feng's support, Chen Bailing rediscovers her worth and singing dreams.

wRp2NbHRHB.title: A Marriage Designed to Kill
wRp2NbHRHB.desc: I fall for a charming rich man, but on our wedding day, I discover he's part of a scam team plotting to kill me for insurance. My jealous best friend murders me first. Reborn, I avoid the scammer, end up with a real rich heir while drugged, and my friend ignores my warnings.

Mt5QPJE2aZ.title: Dad, I'm Cleaning Up the Family
Mt5QPJE2aZ.desc: Xiaocao abused→fled→adopted by Chen. Hid college letter due to poverty→Chen funded. Expert→returned→found parents bullied by son→Chen helped→betrayed. Son repented late→couple waits.

vJa6DkmqL6.title: The Villainess Gets the Guy
vJa6DkmqL6.desc: The heroine transmigrates into the novel she is reading and experiences emotional entanglement with her adoptive brother.

AlGGtSGhZ0.title: Rhythm of the Wind
AlGGtSGhZ0.desc: Shen Yunxi marries Lu Jie for love, but when their son is diagnosed with cancer, she's forced to raise money—only for Lu Jie to take it for himself. After saving her son, she's cast aside. Regaining her strength, she fights back at her son's graduation, only to be humiliated by both him and her husband. After divorcing, she joins forces with Huo Sinian to get revenge, making sure the father and son pay for their wrongs. In the end, Shen Yunxi and Huo Siniain form a powerful partnership and rise to the top.

ki9Fm8wX3m.title: Done Loving the Wrong Girl
ki9Fm8wX3m.desc: In college, Ye Tian fell in love with Qin Yiqing at first sight and bravely confessed his feelings, starting an eight-year relationship. But throughout their time together, Qin Yiqing remained entangled with her so-called "male best friend." Tired of the constant arguments, Ye Tian reached his breaking point when, on the day he planned to propose, Qin Yiqing once again left with Zhang Hanzhi at a single call. Disheartened and heartbroken, Ye Tian finally gave up…

ar9LqW1Ovb.title: The Heart-Hunting Queen
ar9LqW1Ovb.desc: Betrayed and heartbroken, Xia Fei vows revenge on scumbags but mistakenly targets innocent Gu Huainian from the countryside. Years later, he's a billionaire CEO while she's "The Queen" who punishes the wicked. When they meet again, he showers her with affection—even as she torments him relentlessly.

T72LUaYDWR.title: Escape the Bear's Claws
T72LUaYDWR.desc: Wang Mingyu is reborn on the day of a camping trip where she and her daughter will die in a bear attack due to others' selfishness. Her husband Jiang Zheng and her friend Su Moli dismiss her warnings. Armed with her past life's memories, she fights alone to save her daughter from this deadly trap.

EVxU7dEpDM.title: Dragon in Chains Ascends to Heaven
EVxU7dEpDM.desc: Chen Chuan and Ye Yuqi, a married couple, run a stall on the street. Over the past five years, Ye Yuqi's mother-in-law's heart condition has worsened, and Chen Chuan is unstable. While Chen Chuan was pounding his mother-in-law's back, a group of villains arrived, not only driving away their customers but also smashing their stall. Subsequently, Chen Chuan's mother took the money she had earned through hard work to give to the hoodlums, who not only were ungrateful but also knocked her to the ground. It turned out that they were looking for Ye Yuqi, the daughter-in-law. Ten years ago, the Lin family had run over and killed Ye Yuqi's fiancé, so she pretended to be Chen Chuan's girlfriend and lived with him. Now that the Lin family has found out, they must leave...

wv1SkZagn4.title: The Blind Heiress
wv1SkZagn4.desc:
After losing her parents in a suspicious car accident, Pei Zhizhi becomes blind and is taken in by her greedy uncle's family, who seek to claim her inheritance. When they fail to locate the fortune, they marry her off to a dying businessman for money. On her wedding day, her cousin humiliates her, leading to a head injury. Miraculously, Pei Zhizhi regains her sight but keeps it a secret after discovering her mother-in-law’s affair.
Years later, Pei Zhizhi builds a business empire in secret while maintaining the facade of a timid, blind wife at home. When her estranged husband, Fu Jiangning, returns and unknowingly falls for her alter ego, sparks fly. Suspicious of her true identity, he moves back home to test her, setting off a game of wit and deception.
As Pei Zhizhi unravels the mystery of her parents’ death and brings her uncle’s family to justice, she decides to reveal her secrets and request a divorce. But by now, Fu Jiangning is hopelessly in love, and the tables turn as he chase

SkCIrDt1mu.title: Awakening Night
SkCIrDt1mu.desc: After learning Noah’s obsessed with his sister-in-law Riley, Sophia divorces him. With her adoptive brother Liam’s help, she exposes Riley’s crimes and rebuilds her career. Only too late does Noah learn she once saved his life. She marries Liam, and her groundbreaking anti-cancer drug succeeds.

h27zFRvUas.title: Please Take My Ex Away!
h27zFRvUas.desc: In her previous life, Luo Wei suffered a car accident and unexpectedly found herself traveling back ten years in time. Given a second chance, Luo Wei is no longer weak in the face of the betrayal of her ex-husband and best friend. Alongside her, Lu Yichen, who also travels back to the past due to fate, decides to boldly pursue love this time. No matter what happens, he vows to protect Luo Wei.

VOaZqb4ebf.title: Chosen by My CEO After Betrayal
VOaZqb4ebf.desc: Su Yang is expelled by the Su family's true heiress and betrayed by her childhood friend. She hastily marries Huo Xiaofan, who has secretly loved her. After facing villains' schemes and misunderstandings, he confesses his feelings. They reconcile, earn his grandfather's approval, and find happiness.

dv2fd1LcWc.title: The Tale of the Rose: Breaking Free
dv2fd1LcWc.desc: Jiang Chuxia gave up her career to marry into the Zhang family, but found herself in the crosshairs of her mother-in-law Xu Fengxia's disdain and targeted harassment, while her husband Zhang Zhiwei stood by, indecisive and unable to mediate. It was only when Jiang Chuxia fell and her own life, along with her unborn child's, was in danger that she finally awoke to the reality of her situation. Determined to escape this prison, she vowed to break free from the chains that bound her.

zFzZMmW97q.title: Empress of Fate: Reborn to Rule
zFzZMmW97q.desc: Reborn after betrayal, Lily aligns with Emperor Noah to change her fate. Together they defeat conspiracies from Ethan and Consort Lewis. Through schemes and battles, Lily protects her family and wins the Emperor's love, becoming the first empress.

jzUA8X53vv.title: The Heiress Built Her Case
jzUA8X53vv.desc: Policewoman Joy Young dies on duty and awakens as the Walker family's true heiress—she was abused for years, then framed by a fake heiress and killed by kidnappers. Now she seeks justice while investigating Walker Group. But doubts about her past life emerged, and her childhood friend clings to her.

YXQNz9aIwY.title: The Queen's Test Punishing the Jerks
YXQNz9aIwY.desc: Xia Zhiqiu travels back to ancient times and becomes the queen of the Kingdom of Women. She secretly conceals her royal identity while conducting a selection of consorts, intending to test the loyalty of the candidates.

kMb8lfB7aC.title: Shadows of Betrayal
kMb8lfB7aC.desc: A tale of betrayal, revenge, and hidden truths unfolds as Lin Qianye, deceived into believing the Mu family destroyed his own, aligns with their rivals. Meanwhile, Mu Xuechen silently endures humiliation and hardship to protect him and care for her comatose parents. As their paths cross again, will the truth come to light, or will misunderstandings continue to tear them apart in this gripping drama of love, sacrifice, and family loyalty?

BRvOzJu7Ox.title: The CEO's Rural Wife
BRvOzJu7Ox.desc: Su Ningning and Gu Yuhan have a flash marriage. After getting their marriage certificate, Gu Yuhan goes abroad, and a year later, he returns to the country. At a hotel, he encounters Su Ningning, who is being bullied, and steps in to save her. However, neither of them recognizes the other. Gu Yuhan's grandmother secretly supports their relationship. Su Ningning faces hostility from Jiang Wan, who even impersonates her, but in the end, the truth comes out, and Su Ningning and Gu Yuhan have a perfect ending.

K4UoY3LE0R.title: My Mystic Genius Wife
K4UoY3LE0R.desc: A mystical prodigy, Li Qianqian, who's a master of Feng Shui, is kicked off her mountain by her master due to her knack for destroying houses. Tricked by her senior sister, she ends up as a "lucky bride" for Fu Tingchen, meant to bring him good fortune. After mistakenly drinking the nuptial wine, they share a passionate night. Li Qianqian flees in a panic and finds a job as a real estate agent. With her extraordinary Feng Shui skills, she can sell any property. Meanwhile, Fu Tingchen is determined to find and take responsibility for his "lucky bride." However, her senior sister impersonates Li Qianqian. Fu Tingchen, feeling obligated, keeps her by his side. But as time passes, he grows increasingly disgusted with the manipulative sister and finds himself drawn to the kind and genuine Li Qianqian.

Rt8ROzdf1i.title: The Bond Beyond Reach
Rt8ROzdf1i.desc: Shen Niannian, diagnosed with heart failure as a child, was expected to die before 25. Her mother, Yu Huan, was heartbroken, while her father, driven by sexism, decided to sell her. Despite her frailty, Yu Huan fought to find and protect her daughter, even after being beaten and injured.

QRm0NbBKO7.title: The Takeback Queen
QRm0NbBKO7.desc: Emily Parker builds her family brand Cloud Fashion Design into a success, only to be betrayed by her adopted sister and children. Just as she hits rock bottom, Emma Jenkins—the girl she once helped—returns as a top CEO, backed by her tycoon father, to help her reclaim her career and find happiness.

MSygPp85Ah.title: The Oracle Shakes the Capital
MSygPp85Ah.desc: Noah holds power from a wheelchair until the Fords break their contract. Divine punishment strikes—their empire falls overnight. The Clarks beg for mercy. A Buddha's-hand citron sparks a war among 5 clans. He vanishes on a golden lotus, prophesying his return that will decide the city's fate!

wquWEFBMSd.title: Forbidden Desire：My Mated Stripper
wquWEFBMSd.desc: James lets foe Lawrence marry his mom to avenge dad's death. Infiltrating his strip club empire, he finds ex Audrey—once pure, now seductive dancer in Lawrence's arms. Will she become stepmom? He vows to expose her, but old flames linger.

AZa93pmled.title: Against All Odds, Love Ignites
AZa93pmled.desc: Ji Yinyin, troubled by her late mother and reckless father who even tries to sell her to an abusive rich man, escapes and saves a middle-aged woman from thugs. She discovers the woman is Mu Yunfan's depressed mother. When her father confronts her, Mu Yunfan steps in to protect her.

ZhljBxykSa.title: I Got a Billionaire Groom Instead
ZhljBxykSa.desc: On her wedding day, Skyler discovers an affair between her fiancé and her best friend. However, it does not matter because she gains a billionaire as her groom due to these two betrayers.

58UX2PKHiW.title: Return of the Fierce Heiress
58UX2PKHiW.desc: Betrayed by her father and stepmother, Xia Xiaoxiao returns as a CEO to seek revenge. Her father tries to marry her off to the comatose Sheng Mingxuan, unaware she’s setting a trap. At a banquet, she exposes her stepmother. As her enemies fall, her husband wakes—revealing they were once in love.

oIpcGb2ZTM.title: My Husband, the Dragon Lord
oIpcGb2ZTM.desc: A hot spring encounter leaves CEO Sophia Smith pregnant. Five years later, she launches a city-wide husband hunt. Her daughter brings home the man from that night—Lucas Young, who seems to be a humble farmer. Sophia marries him, only to discover he's the Supreme Master of the Dragon God Temple!

JPe4ypu0qb.title: Playing Poor Together
JPe4ypu0qb.desc: Tang Yeli, seeking Tang Corp shares, marries Gu Yanzhi, a CEO, while posing as a beggar. Hiding their wealth, they face broken engagements and workplace schemes. When their identities are revealed at charity and company events, Gu's mother accepts them, and they finally find happiness together.

QtMQfwrIij.title: Spoiled by My CEO Darling
QtMQfwrIij.desc: Fu Yanshen, president of Fu Group, by accident, ran into his former classmates, but is now in trouble with Jin Cancan.

l3TirOOOqd.title: The Prince is Always Jealous
l3TirOOOqd.desc: Yun Ling, a genius in modern medicine, dies unexpectedly and finds herself transported to another dynasty, where she becomes Yun Linglong, the eldest daughter of the Yun family. The emperor decrees that Yun family's young lady must marry the temperamental Prince Rui, Su Qingyu. Yun Linglong's father, unwilling to let his beloved second daughter, Yun Qingcheng, marry the prince, forces Yun Linglong to marry Su Qingyu instead. Yun Linglong reveals that the poison Su Qingyu is suffering from is extremely rare, and it's not something just anyone could obtain. The antidote is also complicated, but she promises to cure him as long as he spares her life, and after a year, she can divorce him. Su Qingyu agrees.

6SbkoaBIQL.title: The Queen Is Actually My Birth Mother
6SbkoaBIQL.desc:
"This story follows the extraordinary journey of Xiao Feng, an eight-year-old boy searching for his true family. In the modern world, Xiao Feng lives in a nominal foster home, but his foster parents plan to harvest his kidney to save their own daughter. During his escape, he accidentally time-travels to the ancient kingdom of Daqian.
In Daqian, Xiao Feng meets Feng Ming, his aunt tasked with finding him. She rescues him from human traffickers, and his modern belongings and unconventional behavior pique her curiosity. Xiao Feng learns he might be the long-lost son of the Empress, while Prince Zhao schemes to depose the Empress and claim the throne, citing the Emperor’s lack of heirs.
At the palace, Xiao Feng faces a series of challenges: clashes with Prince Zhao, a blood identification ceremony to prove his lineage, and ultimately confirming his royal status through a jade pendant matching the Empress’s. Meanwhile, the Emperor is poisoned with cinnabar, and Xiao Feng uses his modern kno

njhIARdAiQ.title: Kiss of Vengeance
njhIARdAiQ.desc: After her sister is driven to suicide and her mother is left comatose, Lily Walker drops out of school to infiltrate the Cloud Summit Club. Her goal: to use powerful David Mitchell for her revenge. Pretending to be fragile, she plays her part—until his fierce devotion makes her fall for real.

lBLyOPgTJG.title: Card Shark Against Gambling
lBLyOPgTJG.desc: Shark King Ethan Smith returns to the casino to save his son. At a border casino, he exposes a scam, clashes with Marvin and Edson Wilson, and uncovers links to his wife's death. With SWAT officer Lily Parker, he travels to Aurelian Sand, survives deadly traps, and defeats the mastermind Jacob Lee.

3OlXNYM4yV.title: Stolen Formulas, Debts Repaid
3OlXNYM4yV.desc: Su Qinghe, heir to the Celestial Medical Sect, returns to her family but finds them favoring adopted daughter Su Qingwan, who uses a system to steal Su Qinghe's prescriptions and frame her. After being falsely accused and dying, Su Qinghe is reborn and vows to expose the truth and seek revenge.

9WiTq0pj6C.title: I Am Dying Anyway
9WiTq0pj6C.desc: After his boss berates him, his wife cheats, and he's diagnosed with cancer, Han Zuwei bets everything and wins 100 million. He saves a VIP's son, earning a manager job. His cancer was a mistake. Emboldened, he ensures those who wronged him get their deserts.

maHVzXlKGg.title: Buried with My Love
maHVzXlKGg.desc: Lauren Murphy endures years of treatment to conceive but is betrayed when her husband visits his lover for prenatal care. Abandoned by her in-laws and facing a tragic loss, she makes a painful, solitary decision and leaves them behind.

41oR8Ey7N0.title: Planned to Fall, Yet Made History
41oR8Ey7N0.desc: The male lead, Chu Yang, who comes from the modern world, is mistakenly summoned by Su Daji from a parallel universe. She uses a magical artifact called the Spirit Record, thinking he is the remaining soul of King Zhou. To return to the modern world, Chu Yang strikes a deal with Su Daji, using the Spirit Record's ability to summon historical figures. He pretends to be the emperor of the Great Chu Dynasty and leads the already crumbling kingdom to its downfall. To do this, Chu Yang intentionally summons Confucius, Du Fu, and various warlords to battle, but by coincidence, he wins three consecutive matches. Later, angered by the warlords sacrificing the common people and recruiting the Warrior Saint of the Wokou as an ally for victory, he calls upon the warrior Lü Bu to defeat them. This earns him the title of a mighty ruler in the eyes of the court, prompting Jin Wang, who plans to rebel and claim the throne, to take extra caution and plot against Chu Yang.

DwWN9rhoAY.title: Reborn to Raise and Rise
DwWN9rhoAY.desc: In her past life, Emily Green, Sea City's top businesswoman, suffered greatly—her son was murdered by her mother-in-law and brother-in-law, and her daughter, Gracie, was sold to traffickers by her mother-in-law. As she mourns over their photos, her assistant brings news about her daughter.

Gd1hOxXx8s.title: Little Martial Master Rises(Dubbed)
Gd1hOxXx8s.desc: Elijah Miller, once cultivator Lincoln, loses his parents to enemy Aubrey and reincarnates as the youngest son of the Miller martial family. To protect his sister, he defeats rival clans, warlords, and foreign warriors, awakens his immortal power to defeat Aubrey, then vanishes, hinting at rebirth.

bWrassnpDz.title: She Danced Her Way Back
bWrassnpDz.desc: Ballerina He Baihui is framed by sister He Baishu, stripped of her title, and crippled. Reborn on the competition day, she discovers He Baishu copies her moves while their father enables her theft of their mother's legacy. With CEO Shen Huaichuan's help, she exposes He Baishu and triumphs.

nF3B2J6Rmz.title: Buried with My Love(Dubbed)
nF3B2J6Rmz.desc: Lauren Murphy endures years of treatment to conceive but is betrayed when her husband visits his lover for prenatal care. Abandoned by her in-laws and facing a tragic loss, she makes a painful, solitary decision and leaves them behind.

20Tp68Re2E.title: But I'll Rise
20Tp68Re2E.desc: Zhang Ye hits rock bottom due to unemployment and the mounting pressures of life. When his mother finds out that Li Qian is flirting with another man, she confronts her, but Li Qian insults her in return. To spare his mother the worry, Zhang Ye lies about finding a job, and his mother, relieved, praises him. Li Qian, however, kicks Zhang Ye's mother out and mocks him for being useless. Overcome with guilt and despair, Zhang Ye contemplates ending his life. By chance, he encounters a stray fox and, feeling a strange connection with the animal, buys it some food before preparing to take his own life.

j2Obdw55le.title: The Invincible Crown Prince
j2Obdw55le.desc: A struggling young man from 2023 transmigrates into Chen Yuanxiao, the 13th prince. Though he wants to avoid the crown prince's struggle, he faces mysterious assassination attempts and threats to his beloved. Realizing the danger, Chen Yuanxiao must become crown prince to protect his family.

V2h0ReotM6.title: His Sweet Pregnant Wife
V2h0ReotM6.desc: A struggling university student, Bella, unexpectedly has a one-night stand with Ian, a cold and reserved CEO with fertility issues, and ends up pregnant with triplets. From then on, she is showered with endless love and care from Ian's family.

awfD4uYv28.title: The Surgeon Who Tamed the Regent
awfD4uYv28.desc: Medical PhD Harper Walker transmigrates after a cliff fall, discovers a medicinal space, and saves the poisoned war god regent Sebastian. Using her skills, she earns wealth, fame, and a powerful ally to punish her unfaithful fiancé. She proposes marriage: "Your ailment requires lifelong care!"

Yg9MPf4HSl.title: Amnesiac CEO: Daddy in Disguise
Yg9MPf4HSl.desc: Five years ago, Yu Shuyun was betrayed by her stepsister and fiancé, spent a drunken night with Li Huaiyu, and became pregnant. Forced to flee abroad, she gave birth to her son, An'an. Now back to seek revenge and uncover her mother’s murder, she reunites with Li Huaiyu, who has lost his memory due to an injury. Claiming he’s a nanny, Shuyun keeps him close, but as they grow closer, Huaiyu regains his memory and secretly investigates An'an’s parentage. Meanwhile, Shuyun discovers her mother’s death is tied to a deeper conspiracy involving Huaiyu’s mother, who was also murdered. Their shared enemies are revealed, and after joining forces for revenge, Huaiyu confesses his love and proposes.

EoR7mhZB7h.title: The Dragon King's Command Ⅲ
EoR7mhZB7h.desc: Guided by a master,  Michael becomes the lord of the Dragon's Palace, but is falsely accused and imprisoned. In jail, he seizes an opportunity, wins over the inmates, tasked with mediating the conflict between the northern and southern martial arts worlds.

Y9YQEHCl6q.title: Butcher Girl's Lucky Break-Up
Y9YQEHCl6q.desc: Years of war have decimated the population, and the law requires women to marry by 18. Lily is betrothed to the impoverished Ethan, giving his family much-needed support. After passing the exams, he seeks to break the engagement, but Lily boldly sets compensation terms, seizing control.

GbKu6lqJUL.title: Mrs. Lin, Your CEO Husband is Moonlighting!
GbKu6lqJUL.desc: On the brink of marriage, Lin Qianqian discovers her fiancé cheating with her best friend. Without hesitation, she calls off the wedding and starts fresh as the boss of a humble wonton shop. When fate reunites them, her ex mocks her modest life—until she introduces her new employee: none other than a billionaire CEO, now her loyal "assistant" and husband. How did the tables turn so dramatically? A tale of betrayal, revenge, and sweet twists.

J7QtaqvVhn.title: Time Travel to Save My Parents
J7QtaqvVhn.desc: The CEO of Gu Group, Gu Xiaoran, and the biological mother of his son, Lu Tongtong, are kidnapped and killed by criminals. Doudou witnesses the whole event and cannot accept the death of her parents. She convinces her uncle to use a time machine to send her back to the time before her parents' death in an effort to save them and change the outcome. To successfully complete her mission, Doudou brings a handheld computer and possesses the ability to sense the future. However, Doudou only has one month. If she fails to complete the task, she will disappear, and her parents' tragic fate will repeat. After traveling back in time, Doudou stays close to Lu Tongtong, helping her outsmart the scummy man and woman, while constantly creating opportunities for Lu Tongtong and Gu Xiaoran to meet. Through Doudou's relentless efforts, the identity of the murderer gradually comes to light, and Gu Xiaoran begins to fall in love with Lu Tongtong.

lv1cJOJVFA.title: Revenge and the Choice of Love
lv1cJOJVFA.desc: Yu Xinghua is persecuted by Yu Yue and accidentally loses her memory, only to be saved by Li Zhongkai. Upon meeting Yu Xinghua, Li Zhongkai notices that she bears a striking resemblance to his ex-girlfriend, and the two eventually marry. Meanwhile, Yu Yue secretly plots to inherit the family fortune, while Yu Qingqing frequently schemes to frame Yu Xinghua. Gradually, Yu Xinghua realizes that she is not receiving equal respect from Li Zhongkai. After being framed again, she begins to fight back. With the help of Shang Lu, Yu Xinghua regains her memory. In the end, she successfully defeats Yu Yue, exposes the conspiracy between Yu Qingqing and Yu Yue, and Li Zhongkai begins to regret his actions and apologizes to her. Faced with his persistence, Yu Xinghua decisively rejects him and focuses on her personal growth. Meanwhile, Shang Lu makes his intentions clear and decides to pursue Yu Xinghua.

4Jrnj35BDX.title: CEO, Go See a Love Doctor
4Jrnj35BDX.desc: Sweet and outspoken, Emily grew up in an orphanage after being separated from her brother Daniel. She married James for love—yet he only agreed to this marriage for his grandmother's sake. As his heart gradually awakened to her, she chose to leave—but love found its way back.

AP1GXVpYaF.title: Dumping My Billionaire Husband
AP1GXVpYaF.desc: While delivering takeout, Su Yan discovers her "poor" husband is actually a billionaire. She catches him gifting his childhood sweetheart jewelry worth millions, dismissing her feelings as petty. He expects her to beg, but she serves him with divorce papers instead.

Nfv3bkLOV5.title: Fight for the Top
Nfv3bkLOV5.desc: Cheng Xuan defeats former champion Lin Sen to become the first female boxing champion in history. However, during the award ceremony, she's exposed for using performance-enhancing drugs, causing public outrage. To escape, she hides her identity, adopting the name Chen Xuan, and flees with her mother. Five years later, Cheng Xuan arrives in Zhongxia City, working as a cleaner at Hengli Gym. She marries and has a child with Rong Yan, who goes by the alias Lu Chuan. Meanwhile, Wang Wei, the heir of the Wang family, tries and fails to win the heart of boxing coach Song Jiaojiao, later causing trouble at Hengli Gym. With some clever moves from Cheng Xuan, Song Jiaojiao successfully fights back. After his defeat, Wang Wei hires Jack, a nominal disciple of Lin Sen, to challenge Song Jiaojiao again. This time, she struggles, but just when things seem hopeless, Cheng Xuan steps in to save the day…

dVHPQIludC.title: Second Life, Bitter Lessons
dVHPQIludC.desc: In her past life, a mother's decision to prevent her daughter from reconnecting with her wealthy father led to years of resentment. Seeking revenge, the daughter ensured her mother's tragic end. Reborn, the mother decides to live for herself but discovers her daughter is also given a second chance. This time, she allows the reunion—but with a price, demanding compensation from the father. The daughter believes she’ll finally live a life of luxury, only to find out her father wants her for her skin to save his new son. Too late, the daughter regrets it all.

uLn4IG3itp.title: The Reborn Lady: Revenge and Rise
uLn4IG3itp.desc: Reborn, Emily Parker swaps marriages with her half-sister Sarah, who weds scholar David Wilson, while Emily marries General Michael Brown. Using past-life memories, Emily saves Michael, exposes David’s betrayal, and foils a rebellion. Love blooms with Michael, while Sarah’s greed leads to ruin.

9qWwN94sGg.title: He Gave Me Starlight
9qWwN94sGg.desc: After being betrayed by a scumbag ex, Shen Xingli gets drunk and ends up in a one-night stand with her best friend's uncle—leading to a forced marriage. Afterward, Sang Muye treats her like his whole world, even punishing his own brother for her. They become the light of each other's lives.

jiVGJwsV1F.title: Married Into His Protection
jiVGJwsV1F.desc: Born to the Young family but raised by the Walker family, she belongs nowhere. Married by arrangement to tycoon Owen, she faces hostility from all sides—until he steps in: "She's my wife. No one harms her." Adapted from "Newlywed, Slowly Loving" by Jie Jie.

KI7tXPDsiY.title: The Family She Almost Lost
KI7tXPDsiY.desc: Xu Jingrou coldly treats Gu Qingze and their daughter due to her obsession with her first love. Gu Qingze plans to leave. Daughter Tiantian gives her three chances, which she wastes. Xu Jingrou awakens, exposes An Lingyue's plot, transfers shares, and reconciles for a happy reunion.

QCVfwSaPnK.title: Real Heiress Back for Blood(Dubbed)
QCVfwSaPnK.desc: In my past life, the nanny's daughter used my card to pretend to be a heiress. She framed me for exam cheating. When my father sought to clear my name, she reported him for bribery. Our company collapsed. I died on the streets. Opening my eyes again, I'm back in my senior year.

XEtlL3wnai.title: Half-Blood, Whole Queen
XEtlL3wnai.desc: As a wolf-hunter hybrid raised by her mother, I have never met my father. Bullied and rejected by both wolves and hunters, I am framed by enemies. Can I defy my fate, grow continuously, and become a ruler?

fz4CFzVOGi.title: Written in the Wind
fz4CFzVOGi.desc: After breaking up with Fu Yan to marry Fu Yun, Shi Chu faces mistreatment from the Fu family. Fu Yan misunderstands her motives, believing she struck a deal with them, while Zhou Ning'er repeatedly schemes against her. After a near-fatal fall into the sea, Shi Chu is saved by the Ye family. Upon returning, she exposes Zhou Ning'er's malicious acts and the truth behind Fu Yun's car accident. As Zhou Ning'er intensifies her scheming, Fu Yan comes to Shi Chu's rescue. The two finally clear their misunderstandings and find their way back to each other.

nn2vwvBtur.title: Rejected for My Looks?
nn2vwvBtur.desc: Design genius Shen Qi, disfigured and abandoned, is rescued by Fu Tingshen. Regaining beauty, they marry swiftly to take revenge, crushing enemies face-to-face.

ZfIuv2YNKq.title: Revenge on My Betraying Bestie
ZfIuv2YNKq.desc: Zhang Ya has a fake rich-girl best friend who married into a wealthy family. In her past life, the friend secretly had an affair, stole a project proposal, transferred one million from the company account, and moved company assets with her lover. After being caught by her husband, the friend framed Zhang Ya for everything, causing her husband to hate Zhang Ya to the core and issue a citywide manhunt. During her escape, Zhang Ya realized the true nature of her friend, but it was too late—she was still killed by the friend and her lover. When Zhang Ya reopened her eyes, she was reborn on the day her friend went out to have an affair. This time, she swears not to be a victim! She sets a trap, making her friend pay for her actions, ensuring that blood debts are paid in blood.

0ShxcYaCyI.title: My Dad, the Tycoon
0ShxcYaCyI.desc: The heroine, unexpectedly pregnant and shamed by her family, is sent to prison to take the blame for her sister. After release, she meets a withdrawn little girl—her own daughter. Unaware, she becomes the girl's nanny, while the father gradually falls in love with her again.

gLDBu9YWLe.title: Hooked at First Sight
gLDBu9YWLe.desc: After a career setback, North City lawyer Emily Taylor takes a trip and unexpectedly meets B&B owner Elijah, sparking a romance. Their three-month fling deepens into true love as Elijah follows her home, supporting her through challenges. Together, they achieve career success and lasting love.

GLilD9ujl9.title: The Bomb Disposal Expert
GLilD9ujl9.desc: Retired bomb disposal expert Sophia, struggling with PTSD, is urgently called to defuse a bomb at the airport to ensure the safe landing of Mr. Wilson, a key national figure. Despite facing obstruction en route, she successfully neutralizes the threat and brings the culprits to justice.

Zx4xZRHcVX.title: Married Strangers Meet Again
Zx4xZRHcVX.desc: Lu Jinye and Ning Qianxue marry after a one-night stand but are separated by family turmoil. She raises their child alone. Reuniting six years later, they face harassment and schemes while developing feelings, each mistakenly believing the other wants divorce. They reconcile happily.

mw74vodf8g.title: The Emperor's Personal Doctor
mw74vodf8g.desc: Famed healer Xu Qing's life takes an unexpected turn when he accidentally destroys hundreds of precious essence bottles, leading to his untimely death. However, fate has other plans as he wakes up in the past, in the imperial palace, and finds himself in the Empress's bed! His unmatched massage skills quickly win the Empress's favor, but things spiral out of control when he's sent to meet the Emperor—who turns out to be a stunning beauty. When Xu Qing inadvertently barges in on the Emperor while she's bathing, a sword is drawn, and his life hangs in the balance, setting the stage for chaos and danger!

VfjJTqZGw1.title: Love, Until It Hurts
VfjJTqZGw1.desc: I thought true love had arrived, but it turned out to be the beginning of pain.

HUjxqA85XH.title: Mistaken Surrogacy, Christmas Destiny
HUjxqA85XH.desc: She gave everything for love, only to be betrayed while pregnant. Four months along, Rose is cast out by her cheating husband. But the baby belongs to Brad, a magnetic billionaire. Rose and Brad strike a deal: a flash marriage, shared revenge. Fighting side by side, vengeance turns into tender love.

VilQQHVjq3.title: I Cut Them Off, They Begged
VilQQHVjq3.desc: Sophia Lewis cared for houseguest Lily Miller for a year, only to be betrayed by Lily's twisted diary that ruined her reputation and led to her death. Reborn, Sophia refuses Lily's exploitation, exposes her lies, and strikes back when Lily accuses her again on exam results day.

fQSLw6hWRE.title: Culinary Queen's Revenge
fQSLw6hWRE.desc: Bai Ruohan, gifted in cooking, is adopted by chef Bai Yaozu. Threatened by her own daughter's lack of talent, Luo Yuling frames Ruohan, who is forced out. With Xia Boyuan's constant support and Davis's help, Ruohan becomes the world's top chef and makes Luo Yuling pay.

IZ30Y8VUE3.title: But Daddy I Love Him
IZ30Y8VUE3.desc: After losing her memory, a woman is saved by men who hide her identity by making her their bodyguard, known to outsiders as a strong "cat woman." The male lead enters a fake marriage to expand his business, but when his fiancee discovers the bodyguard's true identity...

qroNTEsa4r.title: The CEO's Ruthless Seduction
qroNTEsa4r.desc: Sarah Wilson, orphaned and raised by the Greens, finds her fiancé Daniel Green pulling away from her before their wedding. After falling into a pool, she is saved by Daniel's friend James Parker, who has long loved her. Through his ruthless pursuit, she slowly falls for him and finds happiness.
